- Experience in 3D software such as Blender and/or 3DsMax, Vray for good understanding of 3D workflows
- Experience in photorealistic 3D visualizations of products (focus on furniture) is a plus
- Enjoy working with people and communicating in a solution-oriented manner
- High social and communication skills, flexibility and reliability
- Structured, independent, and goal-oriented working style
- Strong sense of responsibility and assertiveness
- Fluent English (business level)
OUR TOP 3 REASONS:

- Corporate culture characterized by cooperation and co-design
- Responsibility right from the start
- Short decision-making processes in a growing and international company

After an intensive induction phase, we will of course support you with your relocation to Hanoi and be on hand to answer any questions you may have. Apply now with your complete application documents, your earliest possible starting date and your salary expectations.
WE LOOK FORWARD TO RECEIVING YOUR APPLICATION.

-------------------

Wir sind schnell. Wir sind farbenfroh. Wir sind laut und leise. Wir lieben, was wir tun, und leisten täglich einen wichtigen Beitrag zum Erfolg unserer Kunden. Wir schaffen Qualität und zählen zu den führenden Medien- und IT-Dienstleistern in Europa. Von Deutschland und unseren Standorten in Asien aus beraten und unterstützen wir internationale Kunden aus verschiedensten Branchen – etwa Werbung, Fotografie, Handel und Industrie. SCHNELLMEDIA steht für Know-how und Zukunft. Unsere Leidenschaft gilt der professionellen Bildbearbeitung, der Online- und Printproduktion sowie der echten 3D- und KI-Visualisierung.

Wir sind SCHNELLMEDIA und haben viel vor. Ein starkes Team braucht starke Persönlichkeiten – daher suchen wir einen

3D Production Manager (m/w/d)
Hanoi (Vietnam) sowie Hamburg, Berlin, Amsterdam, Paris, Madrid, Lissabon, Mailand, London, Stockholm

DEINE AUFGABEN:

Führung eines motivierten 3D-Produktionsteams (Bereiche: Home & Living, Fashion, Einzelhandel)
Steuerung der täglichen 3D-Asset-Produktion sowie Sicherstellung reibungsloser Abläufe und effizienter Workflows
Aufbau, Weiterentwicklung und Motivation des Teams in Hanoi
Überwachung, Sicherstellung und Optimierung von Prozessen
Organisation und Koordination der Zusammenarbeit zwischen dem Standort vor Ort und der deutschen Zentrale
Aktive Mitgestaltung der Weiterentwicklung unseres Unternehmens

DEIN PROFIL:

Führungserfahrung
Erfahrung mit 3D-Software wie Blender und/oder 3ds Max sowie V-Ray für ein fundiertes Verständnis von 3D-Workflows
Erfahrung in der fotorealistischen 3D-Produktvisualisierung (Schwerpunkt Möbel) ist von Vorteil
Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Menschen und lösungsorientierter Kommunikation
Hohe soziale Kompetenz und Kommunikationsstärke, Flexibilität sowie Zuverlässigkeit
Strukturierte, eigenständige und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise
Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Durchsetzungsstärke
Fließende Englischkenntnisse (verhandlungssicher)

UNSERE TOP-3-GRÜNDE:

Eine von Zusammenarbeit und Mitgestaltung geprägte Unternehmenskultur
Verantwortung von Anfang an
Kurze Entscheidungswege in einem wachsenden, internationalen Unternehmen
Nach einer intensiven Einarbeitungsphase unterstützen wir dich selbstverständlich bei deinem Umzug nach Hanoi und stehen dir bei Fragen jederzeit zur Seite. Bewirb dich jetzt mit deinen vollständigen Unterlagen unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.

WIR FREUEN UNS AUF DEINE BEWERBUNG.

Ergänzende Informationen:
Anforderungen an den Bewerber:
Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Visualisierungs- und Animationssoftware Blender, Grafikprogramm 3D Studio Max/3ds Max, 3-D-Design, Grafik-Design (Gebrauchsgrafik)

title: tecnico della gestione post vendita
description: Per iniziativa -in ambito Space Economy- supportata da una holding di un investitore attivo nell'energy, con forte focus sulla crescita e lo sviluppo, ricerchiamo un/una: Product & Solution Manager IoT (Satellite Connectivity & Wholesale) Il core del ruolo sarà costruire e creare sinergie commerciali a mercato per l'offerta satellite-enabled della venture. Ossia servizi per il monitoraggio e la tracciabilità di asset e sistemi (IoT/asset tracking/remote monitoring) e una linea di business di connettività satellitare in logica wholesale (offerte rivendibili tramite partner, con livelli di servizio e prezzi chiari). La persona lavorerà a stretto contatto con il founder space per trasformare i bisogni dei clienti in scelte di prodotto e di servizio (copertura, prestazioni attese, priorità di sviluppo). Responsabilità principali - Definire roadmap, posizionamento e 'pacchetti' dei servizi commerciali satellite enabled. - Disegnare e lanciare offerte wholesale: modelli di partnership, livelli di servizio (SLA) e pricing. - Raccogliere esigenze da clienti/partner e tradurle in requisiti operativi e deliverable per i team coinvolti. - Identificare verticali prioritari, sviluppare opportunità commerciali e portare i pilot a contratti ricorrenti. - Selezionare e validare componenti e partner necessari all'erogazione del servizio (dispositivi/terminali e servizi di piattaforma/ground). Requisiti - Esperienza solida in product/solution management, business development o solution selling su servizi satellitari e/o soluzioni IoT abilitate dal satellite. - Capacità di valutare la sostenibilità di un'offerta in termini di copertura, livelli di servizio, vincoli operativi e pricing (approccio concreto, orientato al mercato). - Esperienza o forte attitudine al wholesale: creazione di offerte rivendibili e gestione di ecosistemi partner/reseller. - Familiarità con soluzioni IoT e modelli digitali (piattaforme, subscription, integrazioni). - Esperienza in ambito CubeSat (anche lato prodotto/servizio o go-to-market). - Laurea in Ingegneria (Aerospaziale/TLC/Informatica/Elettronica) o Gestionale Location: Milano, Italia Package: RAL 70-100K€ + benefit Contratto: CCNL Commercio #LI-CP Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. title: supervisore di contact center
description: Per grande azienda industriale, ricerchiamo un Senior IT Service Desk che contribuirà alla continuità operativa degli uffici e degli stabilimenti produttivi, assicurando un supporto informatico tempestivo ed efficace agli utenti. La posizione prevede un ruolo operativo, con autonomia nella gestione delle richieste e capacità di definire le priorità in funzione dell'impatto sulle attività aziendali e sulla produzione. Le principali attività Fornire supporto IT di primo livello su PC, laptop, telefoni, periferiche, stampanti e dispositivi utilizzati negli stabilimenti, incluse le stampanti per etichette. Installare, configurare e sostituire hardware e software standard, supportando gli utenti nell'utilizzo delle applicazioni aziendali. Supportare onboarding e offboarding IT, predisponendo postazioni e accessi di base. Collaborare con i team IT locali e di gruppo, nel rispetto delle procedure aziendali e delle policy di sicurezza. Buona conoscenza di Windows client, Microsoft 365 e delle attività di troubleshooting hardware e software. Conoscenza di base di Active Directory, sistemi di stampa e connettività LAN e Wi-Fi. Familiarità con strumenti di ticketing, assistenza remota e principi di sicurezza informatica. Capacità di lavorare in autonomia, comunicare con utenti di diverse funzioni e gestire le priorità con un approccio pratico e orientato al servizio. Diploma tecnico o formazione equivalente in ambito informatico. Conoscenza della lingua inglese adeguata all'interazione con colleghi e team IT di gruppo. title: cuoco/cuoca
description: Gi Group, prima Agenzia per il Lavoro italiana con oltre 200 filiali sul territorio nazionale e più di 1.800 professionisti, ricerca per struttura di ospitalità contemporanea con sede a Venezia una figura di: HEAD CHEF _VENEZIA La risorsa guiderà la cucina della sede di Venezia, una location dal carattere giovane e internazionale, dove si dorme, si mangia e si vive la città. title: Industrial Design Engineer (m/w/d) (Industrie-, Produktdesigner/in)
description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Industrial Design Engineer

Stellenbeschreibung:
Gelebte Werte haben für Sie eine Bedeutung?

Lebens-Qualität am Arbeitsplatz ist Ihnen wichtig?

HOPPE, europaweit Marktführer in der Entwicklung, Herstellung und Vermarktung von Beschlagsystemen für Türen und Fenster, ist mit rund 2.200 Mitarbeitern international tätig. In dem eigentümergeführten Familien-Unternehmen ist die wertebasierte und sinnorientierte Unternehmensführung die Basis unseres täglichen Arbeitens.

Wir machen Wohnkultur im Detail. Seit Jahrzehnten schaffen wir hochwertige Beschlaglösungen für Fenster und Türen, die weltweit eingesetzt werden.

Jetzt gehen wir den nächsten Schritt: Wir vergrößern unser Team in der Entwicklung / Konstruktion und suchen dafür zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen:

Industrial Design Engineer (m/w/d)

Bei uns gestalten Sie die Designsprache zukünftiger HOPPE-Produkte aktiv mit und begleiten neue Produktideen von der ersten Handskizze bis zur Serienreife.

Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehören:

- Begleitung von Designprojekten als Grundlage für die nachfolgende Konstruktion
- Erarbeitung innovativer Designkonzepte mittels Handskizzen, digitaler Zeichnungen und 3D-Formstudien
- Weiterentwicklung einer konsistenten Designsprache über verschiedene Produktlinien hinweg
- Erstellung fotorealistischer Renderings und Visualisierungen für Produktpräsentationen, Marketingmaßnahmen und Kundenprojekte
- Aufbereitung von Designvarianten für interne Entscheidungsvorlagen sowie Kundenpräsentationen
- Begleitung von Designprojekten von der ersten Idee über die Konzeptentwicklung bis zur Markteinführung
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Produktmanagement, Vermarktung, Werbung sowie Konstruktion und Vorentwicklung
- Frühzeitige Abstimmung zur technischen und fertigungstechnischen Umsetzbarkeit neuer Produktideen
- Mitwirkung bei Design-Reviews sowie Bewertung von Prototypen und Vorserienteilen hinsichtlich Designqualität und Anmutung
- Aktive Rolle im produktbezogenen Freigabeprozess für gestalterische Fragestellungen
- Branchenübergreifende Beobachtung von Designtrends und Adaptierung auf HOPPE
- Aktive Mitarbeit in Produktentwicklungs-Projekten

Wir freuen uns auf ein Gespräch mit Ihnen, wenn Sie – mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung und aufbauend auf einem Studium im Bereich Industrial Design oder Produktdesign – folgendes mitbringen:

Wissen

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Industrial Design, Produktdesign oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
- Kenntnisse moderner Design- und Visualisierungsmethoden
- Verständnis von Werkstoffen, Oberflächen und Fertigungsprozessen
- Grundlegendes technisches Verständnis für die Zusammenarbeit mit Produktentwicklung und Fertigungstechnologie

Wollen

- Ausgeprägtes gestalterisches Gespür gepaart mit technischem Verständnis
- Hohe Kommunikations- und Moderationsfähigkeit zur Vermittlung zwischen gestalterischen und technischen Anforderungen
- Leidenschaft für Gestaltung und Produktentwicklung
- Eigenständige, strukturierte und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise
- Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit
- Bereitschaft zu standortübergreifender Zusammenarbeit und gelegentlichen Dienstreisen

Können

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Industrial Design, vorzugsweise im Bereich Beschläge
- Sicherer Umgang mit Design-, Rendering- und Visualisierungssoftware (z. B. SolidWorks, KeyShot, oder vergleichbare Anwendungen)
- Erfahrung in der 3D-Formgestaltung und Entwicklung von Designstudien
- Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten
- Fähigkeit, gestalterische und technische Anforderungen erfolgreich miteinander zu verbinden
- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und fließende Englischkenntnisse

Das erwartet Sie bei HOPPE:

- Eine verantwortungsvolle Position mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum
- Die Möglichkeit, die zukünftige Designsprache unserer Produkte aktiv mitzugestalten
- Mitarbeit an internationalen Entwicklungsprojekten
- Arbeiten in einem wirtschaftlich stabilen, werteorientierten Familienunternehmen mit echter Wertschätzung
- Offene Kommunikation und ein partnerschaftliches Miteinander
- Langfristige Perspektiven und persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

Die Stelle ist grundsätzlich an einem unserer Standorte in Deutschland (Stadtallendorf, Bromskirchen, Crottendorf) oder auch an unserem Standort in Italien (Schluderns) zu besetzen.

Bitte senden Sie Ihre vollständige Bewerbung unter Angabe Ihres frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und Ihrer Einkommensvorstellung an lena.dreyer@hoppe.com (https://mailto:lena.dreyer@hoppe.com)

35260 Stadtallendorf

title: Fahrer (m/w/divers) für Showtruck gesucht (Berufskraftfahrer/in)
description:
.....gesucht wird ein "bewirtender" Berufskraftfahrer oder "kundenorientierter" Gastronom mit Lkw-Führerschein.....

Wir suchen einen zuverlässigen und erfahrenen Lkw-Fahrer mit Führerschein C/CE für unseren Showtruck, der sich um die sichere und effiziente Beförderung unserer Gastronomie-Einrichtung kümmert und nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs ist, insbesondere in Italien und Frankreich.

Als Lkw-Fahrer werden Sie für die Bedienung und Wartung des Fahrzeugs verantwortlich sein und sicherstellen, dass alle Aufgaben im Zusammenhang mit dem Auf- und Abbau der Gastronomie-Einrichtung reibungslos durchgeführt werden. Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehören die Fahrt zu den Veranstaltungsorten, der Auf- und Abbau der Einrichtung, der Ausschank und die Betreuung der Gäste. Wir suchen einen Kandidaten mit ausgeprägten Fahrkenntnissen, excellenten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und einer tiefen Erfahrung im Umgang mit Lkw und Gastronomie-Einrichtungen.

Die Stelle erfordert eine hohe Flexibilität und die Bereitschaft, nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs zu sein. Wenn Sie eine Herausforderung suchen und sich für eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit begeistern, dann sind Sie bei uns richtig.

Zum Aufgabengebiet gehören voraussichtlich aber nicht ausschließlich:

- Mitreisetätigkeit an 6-10 Monaten am Stück im Jahr, ausdehnbar auf 12 Monate im Jahr, wenn erste Teilsaison stimmt
- Erfahrung im Betrieb/Mitreisen bei Schaustellerbetrieben, Eventbereich
- leichter Auf- und Abbau von Gerätschaften während der Tour
- Eventunterstützung von Organisation vor Ort
- Terminplanung Tour
- Ausschankbetrieb
- Führerschein Klasse CE

Persönliche Voraussetzungen:

- Unabhängigkeit
- Altersvorgabe 30-58
- technisches Verständnis Light&Sound und LKW-Technik
- englisch fließend, jede weitere Fremdsprache ist willkommen
- Persönlichkeit: präsent, kommunikativ, selbstbewusst

Interfaccia operativa, sotto supervisione, con laboratori esterni, consulenti regolatori ed enti certificatori. Collaborazione trasversale con team R&D, Qualità e Operations. Buone capacità organizzative, relazionali e comunicative. Padronanza di MS Office e sistemi di gestione documentale elettronica. Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese (necessaria per la comprensione e gestione di testi tecnici). Ci ha incaricati di ricercare un/a Senior Pre Sales Engineer - Networking che verrà inserito/a all'interno della Technology Unit NDCS della Business Unit PPS (Public & Private Sector) e opererà nell'area di Prevendita, contribuendo alla definizione di soluzioni innovative in ambito Networking, Data Center, Security e Cloud per clienti Enterprise e Pubblica Amministrazione. L'obiettivo del ruolo è supportare le strutture commerciali nella qualificazione delle opportunità, nella progettazione delle soluzioni e nella predisposizione delle offerte tecnico-economiche, collaborando con vendor, partner e team di delivery. Principali responsabilità - Supportare le attività di prevendita tecnica nell'ambito di gare, offerte e opportunità - commerciali in tecnologia multivendor. - Analizzare i requisiti tecnici e di business dei clienti. - Definire architetture e soluzioni infrastrutturali in ambito Networking e Data Center. - Predisporre documentazione tecnica, High Level Design, allegati di gara e documenti di - offerta. - Collaborare alla definizione della soluzione economica e alla stima degli effort progettuali. - Interfacciarsi con vendor e distributori. - Supportare PoC, workshop, demo e presentazioni tecniche. - Collaborare con Delivery e Operation. - Contribuire all'evoluzione dell'offerta aziendale. - Supportare il coordinamento tecnico di offerte complesse. Competenze tecniche richieste - Architetture IP Enterprise e Service Provider. - Routing e switching (OSPF, IS-IS, BGP, MPLS, Segment Routing). - Tecnologie LAN, WAN e Data Center. - Esperienza su soluzioni Cisco, HPE ed altri vendor. - SD-WAN e SDN. - Wireless Enterprise. - Cloud e Network Security. - Processi ITIL e Service Management. Requisiti - Esperienza di almeno 8-10 anni in attività specifiche nel ruolo di cui al profilo richiesto - Esperienza nella definizione di soluzioni complesse. - Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. - Disponibilità a trasferte. Sede di Lavoro: Milano CCNL Metalmeccanico, Livello B3 O Quadro A1 RALT (fisso + variabile): 70.000€ SW fino al 50%, Ticket da 9 euro. La nostra organizzazione opera nel rispetto della parità di genere e con l'impegno di sostenere l'inclusività e la diversity. description: Grafton LifeScience* is a dedicated team focused on enhancing the experiences, skills, and potential of candidates in Sales & Marketing, Clinical Research, Regulatory, and Operations within the Pharmaceutical and Medical sectors. We also specialize in roles related to customer support in the health-impacting distribution field (Pharmacies and Parapharmacies). In partnership with an integrated CDMO with around 60 locations worldwide, specializing in integrated sterile liquid and lyophilized product development and commercial manufacturing, we offer an opportunity for Production Quality Specialist Summary: The main function of a Quality Specialist is to ensure compliance within the Manufacturing Department by managing documentation, CAPAs, deviations, and audits. This role supports continuous improvement initiatives and collaborates across departments to uphold quality standards in a fast-paced, regulated environment. Job Responsibilities: - Provide documentary support to the production department. - Manage CAPAs using the TrackWise system. - Coordinate the opening and management of Change Control Forms (CCFs). - Collaborate with the Quality System Department to review and update SOPs. - Conduct and manage departmental training activities. - Prepare and present compliance documents and procedures. - Identify and resolve quality issues in collaboration with relevant teams. - Manage internal, customer, and regulatory audits. Do you have these skills and requirements? Requirements: 1-2 years Previous work experience (not necessarily in the same role) in sterile manufacturing/production departments Knowledge of GMP regulations English (written and spoken) B2 Preferred skills: Participation in regulatory audits Participation in internal and external audits Quality Assurance in a manufacturing/production environment Qualifications: Bachelor's degree (3-year) in a scientific discipline Contract Offer: Fixed-term agency contract 05/10/2026- 05/04/2026. CCNL Chimico-Farmaceutico, livello D1. Working time weekly: Monday to Friday daily / flex 8.30-9.30 Place of work: Ferentino (FR) Grafton LifeScience is a specialization of Gi Group Spa authorized to operate by the Ministry of Labor and Social Policies (Authorization No. 26/11/2004 PROT. 1101 - SG). title: COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2) (Kapitän/in)
description:
The MV Louise Michel is a former French Navy boat we’ve customized to perform search and rescue. Measuring 30 meters in length and capable of up to 28 knots, she was bought with proceeds from the sale of Banksy artwork - who then decorated her with a fire extinguisher. She is operated and crewed by a team of international activist rescue professionals.

- Main responsibilities: handling the ship, overview, control of the vessel and crew safety
- You have the final responsibility for all nautical and technical decisions concerning the operation as well as related crew intructions
- responsible for the ship’s administration (bunkering, crew-lists, customs clearance, detailed operational documentation, daily reports and statistics).
- shiphandling in harbour and during SAR-operations. Together with the officers you will familiarise the crew on the bridge and introduce them to the watch system.
- You will provide the crew with trainings and drills in emergency situations (e.g. what to do in case of fire, POB, ingress of water, unwanted visitors).
- You will work closely with the Head of operations during SAR operations, double checking all decisions against crew and ship safety as well as stability (and guest safety in case of guest already on board).
- You will work closely with the officers and chief engineer

Required:

-EC/EEA-Citizen Passport valid for at least 6 months

-Covid certificate with EU QR code needed, latest vaccine or recovery certificate no older than 180 days or a booster (other nationalities can be transferred to EU certificate)

-Seafarer Medical Certificate (fitness for sea service) according STCW I/9 (Deck Service)

-Proficiency in basic safety (STCW VI/1)

-Proficiency in survival craft and rescue boats other than fast rescue boats (STCW VI/2-1)

-Proficiency in Advanced fire fighting (STCW VI/3)

-Medical First Aid (STCW VI/4-1)

-Medical Care (STCW VI/4-2)

-GMDSS Radio Operator GOC (STCW IV/2)

-COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2)

-German Endorsement for COC Master Course

-Seafarer's book or the German Seafarer's ID Card

-Excellent and fluent English language skills

-Confidence in decision-making, strong team leading skills, and the ability to cooperate well within a team of volunteers with various levels of nautical experience and skill.

Desired:

- Previous SAR experience
- Italian, French and Arabic language skills

title: Service Engineer
description:
Voor een internationale speler binnen de chemische industrie zoeken we een Technical Service Engineer voor de Belgische markt. Het betreft een vaste functie bij onze opdrachtgever. Je werkt volledig remote en rapporteert aan het team in Nederland. Eén keer per maand ben je aanwezig op het Nederlandse kantoor voor teamoverleg.


Je maakt deel uit van een klein team van drie collega’s in België. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met een ervaren Account Manager die als mentor zal optreden. Daarnaast stem je regelmatig af met technische experten en het laboratoriumteam in Nederland, wat grotendeels vanop afstand gebeurt.

Als Technical Service Engineer ben je de technische partner voor klanten in België. Je ondersteunt hen bij het optimaliseren van processen, adviseert over technische oplossingen en bouwt duurzame relaties uit. Op termijn krijg je de mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar een rol als Account Manager.

Function

  • Bezoeken van klanten en ondersteunen bij technische vraagstukken.
  • Adviseren over procesverbeteringen en technische oplossingen.
  • Testen, implementeren en opvolgen van oplossingen bij klanten.
  • Monitoren en optimaliseren van bestaande processen.
  • Opbouwen en onderhouden van langdurige klantrelaties.
  • Samenwerken met commerciële en technische collega’s in België en Nederland.
  • Signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en opportuniteiten.
  • Bachelor of master in Chemie, Chemische Technologie, Procestechnologie of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
  • Enkele jaren relevante ervaring binnen de chemische sector.
  • Affiniteit met chemische processen en industriële productieomgevingen.
  • Sterke combinatie van technische expertise en commerciële/sociale vaardigheden.
  • Zelfstandig, proactief en zelfsturend.
  • Klantgericht, communicatief sterk en oplossingsgericht.
  • Goede kennis van het Nederlands en Engels. Frans is een plus.

title: Kiemsargis
description:
1.    Palaikyti švarą ir tvarką mokyklos teritorijoje.
2.    Kasdien nušluoti takelius, šaligatvius, iškaupti žolę takeliuose ir žaidimų aikštelėse, surinkti šiukšles (1–2 val. prieš ateinant vaikams).
3.    Vasaros, rudens ir pavasario laikotarpiu prižiūrėti bei laistyti gėlynus, pjauti žolę.
4.    Prižiūrėti ir tinkamai eksploatuoti naudojamą techniką: žoliapjovę, žoliapjovės traktorių, trimerius (valyti, tikrinti techninę būklę, atlikti smulkų remontą, laiku informuoti apie gedimus).
5.    Užtikrinti tinkamą technikos saugojimą, laikymą ir priežiūrą ne darbo metu.
6.    Vykdyti kuro sunaudojimo apskaitą, racionaliai naudoti kurą ir kitas eksploatacines medžiagas.
7.    Žiemą nukasti sniegą nuo takelių, šaligatvių, žaidimų aikštelių, įėjimų į pastatą, barstyti takelius smėliu.
8.    Kasdien apžiūrėti inventorių; esant gedimams – remontuoti savo jėgomis arba informuoti pavaduotoją ūkio reikalams.
9.    Perdažyti lauko įrenginius, atlikti smulkų jų remontą.
Kiemsargio atsakomybė: už mokyklos teritorijos priežiūrą ir tvarką; už sanitarinių higieninių reikalavimų vykdymą; už saugos darbe ir priešgaisrinės saugos reikalavimų laikymąsi; Už patikėtos technikos, įrankių ir inventoriaus saugumą, tinkamą naudojimą bei priežiūrą; už kuro ir eksploatacinių medžiagų racionalų naudojimą; už aukščiau išvardintų pareigų vykdymą.
Kiemsargis privalo: vykdyti mokyklos direktoriaus, pavaduotojo ūkiui arba įgaliotų asmenų su darbu susijusius nurodymus. Mokėti saugiai dirbti ir netrukdyti saugiai dirbti kitiems. Laiku tikrintis sveikatą. Laikytis įstaigos vidaus tvarkos taisyklių, darbe nevartoti alkoholinių gėrimų bei narkotinių medžiagų. Laikytis įrenginių naudojimo instrukcijų reikalavimų, asmens higienos reikalavimų.

Apmokėjimo sekimas iki pinigų gavimo.

title: Electrical Engineer (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
description:
Electrical Engineer (m/f/d) in Mamer

OG Recruitment is your consulting agency for the recruitment of specialists in Luxembourg and the entire border region. We are exclusively concerned with direct placements with our clients. No temporary employment.

On behalf of our renowned client with headquarters in Mamer (L) we are looking for an Electrical Engineer (m/f/d) for mechanical and electrical satellite systems.

The position will be filled directly and permanent with the client.

Our client is an innovative, Luxembourg based high-tech company with several state-of-the-art divisions.

Your tasks

- Design electrical installations and controller solutions for the satellite ground segment and the rubber industry testing equipment:
- Define, document, implement and test new features and technologies in existing or new products,
- Create electrical concepts and drawings,
- Identify, assess and mitigate safety risks related to electro-mechanical machinery and define electrical safety concepts to address those,
- Start-up in-house designed machinery and commercial components.
- Interact with internal & external customers and suppliers in order to promote, improve and troubleshoot the customers electrical and automated solutions:
- Present, explain and defend important features and concepts in discussions with the customers and use their feedback to improve and troubleshoot the products,
- Interact with suppliers to select components and perform obsolescence management.

Your profile

- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering or automation engineering
- 3 to 5 years of experience in a relevant field of activity, including good understanding of electrical and electro-mechanical installations and power electronics
- Design of electrical installations, including electro-mechanical devices such as motors, and related drawings (EPLAN P8)
- Ability to perform safety analyses of electro-mechanical machinery (using tools such as Safexpert, Sistema) and to design electrical systems fulfilling the common safety norms (such as the machinery directive 2006/42/EC)
- PLC software development is considered a plus (e.g. PLCopen Structured Text ST)
- Good team spirit
- Ability to adapt to new situations and work with various type of stakeholders and partners to achieve the desired results
- Ability to work in an English-speaking environment including technical discussions and documentation activities, German, French and Luxembourgish being considered as a plus

What we offer

- A permanent employment contract directly with the client
- Attractive salary
- Great working atmosphere and modern, multi national working environment
- Dynamic environment
- Attractive career development opportunities

- You are welcome to apply online and click on the "Apply" button
- If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact us by phone or e-mail.
- We will review your documents and arrange a telephone call or personal meeting to get to know you.

Discretion comes first

title: Group PMO (Project Management Officer) (m/f)
description:
Description de tâches:

Group PMO (Project Management Officer)
We are a 100% independent, family-owned Luxembourgish company with over 175 years' experience in the fast-moving consumer goods industry (tobacco products, smoking accessories, vaping, CBD and other nicotine products such as nicotine pouches). Within a dynamic environment towards more reduced risk products, we have embarked on an innovative journey to further strengthen our position in Europe, to grow worldwide and to enter new nicotine categories.
To support our current growth, we are looking for a :

Group PMO (Project Management Officer) (m/f/x)
Hollerich - Luxembourg

In this position, you will be responsible for establishing, coordinating, and continuously improving the Group project and program management framework. The role provides governance, standards, transparency, reporting, prioritization support, and delivery assurance across strategic initiatives, ensuring that projects are aligned with Group objectives, resources are used effectively, risks are escalated appropriately, and executive decisions are supported by reliable information. This role applies to all Group projects and programs, excluding IT-specific initiatives.

Your Responsibilities:

• Define, maintain, and improve the Group PMO framework, including project governance, methodologies, templates, standards, tools, and reporting practices.
• Support the prioritization, selection, and monitoring of Group projects and programs in line with strategic objectives, business value, capacity, and risk profile.
• Provide portfolio-wide visibility on project status, milestones, resources, budgets, risks, dependencies, issues, and benefits realization.
• Prepare consolidated executive dashboards, portfolio reports, steering committee materials, decision papers, and escalation summaries.
• Coordinate governance bodies and project review cycles, ensuring clear decision-making, action follow-up, and timely escalation of critical topics.
• Support project and program managers with planning discipline, delivery methodology, risk management, dependency management, and issue resolution processes.
• Monitor portfolio performance and challenge inconsistencies, gaps, delays, budget deviations, or unclear ownership across initiatives.
• Promote consistent project management practices, continuous improvement, simplification, and standardization across the Group.
• Facilitate alignment between business units, functions, and local entities to ensure coordinated execution of Group priorities.
• Develop internal PMO capabilities, knowledge sharing, project management maturity, and best practices across the organization.

Your Profile:

• Master's degree in Business Administration, Management, Finance, Engineering, Project Management, or a related field.
• Minimum 10 years of experience in project management, program coordination, portfolio management, PMO, business transformation, consulting, or a related role.
• Proven experience in establishing or operating PMO frameworks in an international, multi-function, or multi-entity environment.
• Strong understanding of project governance, portfolio reporting, planning, budgeting, risk management, resource management, and benefits tracking.
• Experience preparing executive-level reporting and supporting steering committees or senior management decision-making.
• Professional certifications such as PMP, PMI, PRINCE2, Agile, Lean Six Sigma, PgMP, PfMP, or equivalent are considered an advantage.
• Fluent English is required, additional languages relevant to the Group's footprint are an asset.

What We Offer:

• An exciting opportunity to join an international and growing industrial group.
• A key role within a strategic and innovative product category.
• A collaborative environment focused on performance, development, and continuous improvement.
• Competitive compensation and benefits package.
• Professional growth opportunities within the Landewyck Group.

All applications will be treated in the strictest confidence.

title: Lead System Engineer (m/w/d) Automotive Entwicklung – Luxemburg / Remote (1720) (Ingenieur/in - Fahrzeugtechnik)
description:
Ihre Karriere in der Steuerung komplexer Systementwicklungsprojekte.

Mit BRÜGGEN ENGINEERING übernehmen Sie eine zentrale Rolle in der Entwicklung elektronischer Fahrzeugsysteme. Sie steuern die Systementwicklung von den Kundenanforderungen bis zur Systemfreigabe, koordinieren Releases und Entwicklungsumfänge und führen das Systemprojektteam fachlich. Der Tätigkeitsschwerpunkt liegt im Remote-Arbeiten mit regelmäßigen Projekteinsätzen in Luxemburg.

So tragen Sie zu unserem gemeinsamen Erfolg bei

- Systementwicklung: Sie verantworten die termingerechte Bearbeitung der Systems-Engineering-Arbeitspakete von der Anforderungsdefinition bis zur Systemfreigabe
- Entwicklungsplanung: Sie planen Arbeitspakete, Zuständigkeiten, Abhängigkeiten, Ressourcen, Termine und Meilensteine und steuern die Umsetzung über Releases und Sprints hinweg
- Releaseplanung: Sie definieren Produkt- und Release-Umfänge, koordinieren Änderungen und stellen die technische Reife für anstehende Releases und Meilensteine sicher
- Anforderungsmanagement: Sie steuern die Entwicklung von Stakeholder- und Systemanforderungen und gewährleisten deren Qualität, Priorisierung und durchgängige Rückverfolgbarkeit
- Systemintegration: Sie stellen die konsistente Umsetzung der Anforderungen und Architekturspezifikationen in Software, Hardware und Test sicher
- Schnittstellen: Sie koordinieren die technische Abstimmung mit Kunden sowie Software, Hardware, Test, funktionaler Sicherheit, Cybersecurity, Fertigung und weiteren Fachbereichen
- Teamsteuerung: Sie führen das Systemprojektteam fachlich, verfolgen Risiken und Entwicklungsfortschritte und vertreten den Systemstatus in Kunden-, Release- und Projektbesprechungen

Das bringen Sie mit

- Qualifikation: Abgeschlossenes Studium in Mechatronik, Elektrotechnik, Elektronik oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung
- Berufserfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Automotive, Automobilelektronik, E-Mobilität oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld sowie Erfahrung in der fachlichen Steuerung von Projekten oder Teams
- ECU-Entwicklung: Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung elektronischer Steuergeräte, idealerweise im Bereich Hochvolt-Inverter
- Systems Engineering: Solide Kenntnisse in Systems Engineering, Anforderungsmanagement, Systemintegration und Release-Prozessen sowie ausgeprägtes prozessorientiertes Denken
- Normen: Kenntnisse relevanter Automotive-Standards wie ISO 26262 und Automotive SPICE
- Tools: Erfahrung mit Projekt-, Anforderungs- und Ticketmanagementsystemen wie Microsoft Project, Polarion, DOORS, JIRA oder IBM Rational RTC
- Kommunikation: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, interkulturelle Kompetenz sowie Bereitschaft, rund 30 % der Tätigkeit vor Ort in Luxemburg zu arbeiten

Was wir bieten

title: Contrôle de Gestion / Chargé(e) de Pilotage Commercial - AXA Luxembourg - CDI (m/f)
description:
Contrôle de Gestion / Chargé(e) de Pilotage Commercial - AXA Luxembourg – CDI

Notre environnement de travail

Fière d'appartenir au Groupe AXA, une marque d'assurance internationale et un leader mondial des services financiers, la société AXA Assurances Luxembourg est un acteur majeur du secteur des assurances au Grand-Duché.
Nous aidons nos clients à traverser les petites et grandes difficultés de la vie. Chaque jour, nous agissons ensemble pour inventer la meilleure manière de les protéger et voulons donner à chacun les moyens de vivre une vie meilleure.
Un challenge qui donne le sourire et envie de se lever le matin !

Chez AXA, nous sommes persuadés que pour bien prendre soin de nos clients, nous devons commencer par bien prendre soin de nos collaborateurs. C'est pour cette raison que nous menons une politique RH engagée qui favorise la diversité, qui préserve l'équilibre vie privée-vie professionnelle et accompagne le développement des compétences et des carrières.
Quelle que soit l'équipe que vous rejoignez au sein de notre organisation, certaines choses sont vraies pour nous tous : une culture forte fondée sur la confiance, le respect et où nous sommes bienveillants les uns avec les autres, parce que c'est la meilleure façon d'être les meilleures versions de nous-mêmes. Nous cherchons toujours à attirer des talents dans notre entreprise, tout en continuant à développer notre personnel existant.
  
Vos missions

Au sein du département Finance d'AXA Assurances Luxembourg S.A., la fonction est rattachée au service Contrôle de gestion et Pilotage Commercial. Votre rôle consiste à participer au suivi et au pilotage de l'activité commerciale.

Dans ce rôle, vous serez amené(e) à :

Responsabilités récurrentes :

• Définir les objectifs de chiffre d'affaires des points de vente, en cohérence avec le plan stratégique de la société.
• Assurer le suivi mensuel de la performance commerciale, au niveau total, par réseau de distribution, par point de vente et par ligne de business : chiffres d'affaires, nouvelles affaires, chutes, taux de rétention, prime moyenne.
• Analyser les variations par rapport aux objectifs et par rapport à l'année précédente, en coordination avec la Direction Commerciale, en comprendre la cause et définir des plans d'actions adéquats pour sécuriser la réalisation des objectifs.
• Définir les actions commerciales dites « challenges » en coordination avec la Direction Commerciale : définir les critères en cohérence avec les priorités du plan stratégique, en prenant en considération les aspects de disponibilité des informations, de communication fluide et transparente avec les réseaux et les contraintes de compliance.
• Assurer le suivi des actions commerciales, notamment mesurer la performance commerciale (taux de conversion, etc).
• Suivre la rentabilité des points de vente en coordination avec l'actuariat business et notamment, calcul de l'intéressement technique pour les points de vente concernés.

Responsabilités ad-hoc :

• Mener des analyses ciblées, à la demande et en conjonction avec la direction commerciale, par exemple sur le taux de multi-détention, l'impact d'une campagne marketing sur le chiffre d'affaires…etc
• Participer aux réflexions et mesures d'impact en cas de modification des conventions et des schémas de rémunération des intermédiaires, en étant vigilant et critique face aux contraintes règlementaires et à l'enjeu de rester attractif pour nos clients & intermédiaires.

Assurer un lien continu entre les Directions Finance et Commerciale :

• Favoriser une culture financière au sein de la Direction Commerciale en apportant un angle financier aux réunions de suivi commercial en fournissant aux ARMAs les outils et tableaux de bord nécessaires à l'animation du réseau. Le cas échéant, organiser des formations ciblées.
• Analyser la performance commerciale, à la lumière des informations remontées du terrain.

Assurer un lien avec la Direction IT / Equipe Data :

• Solliciter la Direction IT / Equipe Data pour la production des rapports et des extractions nécessaires à l'exécution des missions.
• Veiller à la qualité des données mises à disposition des équipes commerciales et des intermédiaires, notamment les données de rémunération des intermédiaires.
• Mise en place de contrôles et de réconciliations avec les reportings Finance.

Votre profil  

• Vous êtes titulaire d'un master à orientation économique, en mathématiques ou statistiques.
• Vous bénéficiez d'une expérience de 3 à 5 ans au sein d'une Direction Finance ou d'une Direction Commerciale. L'expérience dans le secteur financier ou assuranciel représente un atout.
• Vous maitrisez Excel et les outils de bases de données.
• Vous manifestez une forte appétence, à la fois commerciale et pour l'analyse et les chiffres. Vous manifestez une aisance pour manipuler, synthétiser et expliquer les chiffres.
• Vous avez une fibre commerciale et une excellente orientation client.
• Vous possédez d'excellentes capacités à travailler en équipe avec plusieurs Directions.
• Vous travaillez en autonomie et vous bénéficiez d'une excellente capacité d'organisation.
• Vous maîtrisez le français et l'anglais.

Vos avantages

Vous avez envie de mettre votre énergie et votre talent au service de nos clients et de la société dans son ensemble ? Faites partie de notre grande famille en rejoignant :

• Un cadre stimulant où la formation continue permet sans cesse d'enrichir ses compétences et développer son employabilité ;
• Une entreprise très attachée à la qualité de vie au travail de ses salariés et qui offre de nombreux avantages collaborateurs (télétravail, programme de Well-being et santé, activités sportives en dehors du temps de travail, 35,5 jours de congés, etc.) ;
• Une entreprise responsable menant une politique volontaire pour reconnaître et valoriser les différences individuelles dans un environnement de travail inclusif ;
• Une compagnie où sont organisés des événements culturels, sportifs et conviviaux tout au long de l'année (Staff Days, visites des musées gratuites, city trips etc) ;
• Un employeur citoyen qui agit en faveur de causes sociétales et environnementales en tant qu'assureur, investisseur et entreprise notamment au travers de l'association AXA Atout Cœur.

description:
SD-26155- POST-DOC SOIL HEALTH AND REMEDIATION

Fixed term contract | Belvaux | 24 Months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defense technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

As part of LIST's SUSTAIN unit (Environmental Sustainability Assessment and Circularity), the Environmental Policies (EPS) group provides science-based input to the definition and implementation of environmental policies at national and EU level, in particular policies around chemical safety, soil pollution, circular (bio-)economy (e.g. construction, textile, water), and climate - and feeds, at the interface of science, technologies and policies, the regulatory perspective into RDI projects around these topics.

As postdoc (R&T Scientist), you will further strengthen the activities around soil health and the management of contaminated sites via contributing to:
• The further development (implementation-phase) of an Urban Soil Living Lab in Luxembourg (Horizon Europe project URSOILL - Innovative Solutions for Sustainable Urban Soil Restoration Through Living Labs) and participation in a working group on soil remediation and stabilization with nature-based solutions, especially phytoremediation and phytomanagement. Main tasks: literature review; design of field experiments and monitoring protocols across multiple urban sites; support and supervision of fieldwork; data analysis and interpretation; stakeholder engagement in the Living Lab; and scientific publications and project deliverables.
• The establishment of a cross-border network of ‘Lighthouses' of phytomanagement for soil remediation, biodiversity and the regenerative economy in the Greater Region (Interreg project Light4Green),
• Scientific and regulatory support, e.g. via bibliography and the preparation of a review article, on nature-based remediation solutions for Persistent organic pollutants (POPs) contamination (Interreg project Naturem),
• The set-up of a laboratory for testing and evaluating soil remediation technologies (especially bioremediation and phytoremediation),
• Support the definition, submission and implementation of research and collaborative project proposals of the group, and participate to the network of LIST's different activities around soil protection.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!
Education

• You hold a Master's degree and a PhD in soil or environmental sciences/engineering, or another relevant natural science or engineering domain.
• You have practical and solid experience in the design, testing, evaluation and application of nature-based soil remediation technologies, e.g. phytoremediation, bioremediation, mycoremediation.
• Interdisciplinary thinking, well-developed communication skills (oral and written) and team spirit to successfully integrate into the multicultural, multilingual and multidisciplinary work environment at LIST and effectively communicate with LIST's partners,

o First experience in an RTO/academic environment, scientific/technical consulting, authorities, or industry on contaminated site management, pollution risk assessment or remediation
o Knowledge of Luxembourg and the Greater Region

Language skills

• Fluency in English, both oral and written. Other relevant languages, especially French, German, or Luxembourgish are a strong asset.

• An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects
• Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society

www.XXXX.lu | XXXX on LinkedIn

Purpose of the job / project

Ready to play a key role in shaping the future of health data access and trusted data sharing in Luxembourg and beyond?
Join our team and contribute to strategic national and European initiatives that advance secure, compliant, and efficient access to data for research, innovation, and public policy. title: Cash Management & Credit Risk Officer (m/f)
description:
Cash Management & Credit Risk Officer

BDO Luxembourg is looking for a Cash Management & Credit Risk Officer to join to the internal Finance department.

Who are we?

BDO is present in over 169 countries and we offer an extensive range of services in the areas of Audit, Tax, Advisory, Accounting, Business Services and Outsourcing. At BDO Luxembourg, our mission is to provide our clients with the expertise of our global network tailored to the unique needs of the Luxembourgish market, delivering personalized services and building valued relationships. With over 700 employees representing more than 40 nationalities, we embrace diversity and encourage skills and people development among our employees. Our core values, honesty, integrity, quality, respect and responsibility, define our culture. Hence, our People can expect to grow in a stimulating work environment that supports professional development and fosters inclusivity.

Position Summary

The Cash Management & Credit Risk Officer is responsible for optimizing the Company's cash flow by managing accounts receivable, reducing credit risk, improving collection performance, and supporting treasury activities. The role combines operational cash collection, credit risk management, reporting, business partnering, legal recovery coordination, and continuous process improvement.

What will you do?

Cash Collection & Accounts Receivable

• Manage customer accounts, handle accounts receivable, and ensure the timely collection of outstanding invoices.
• Coordinate reminder campaigns and follow up on payment commitments.
• Escalate overdue cases in line with the Cash Recovery Policy.
• Negotiate payment arrangements and coordinate legal recovery when required.
• Resolve payment issues in collaboration with Partners, Project Managers and client teams.

Credit Risk Management

• Implement a client credit rating system.
• Maintain and update client and group risk ratings.
• Monitor payment behaviour, financial exposure and insolvency indicators.
• Recommend credit terms, collection strategies and risk mitigation actions.
• Monitor customer insolvency risks, in particular by conducting checks with the Luxembourg Commercial Register (LBR).

Cash Management & Reporting

• Produce dashboards and KPI reports (DSO, ageing, cash collection, risk ratings, exposure, legal recovery and forecast accuracy).
• Contribute to the preparation of PowerBI reports.
• Present analyses and recommendations to Management and the Cash Recovery Committee.

Business Partnering

• Advise Partners and business teams on receivable management and credit risk.
• Promote timely billing, proactive collections and effective dispute resolution.
• Ensure compliance with the Company's Cash Recovery Policy and applicable legislation.

Process Improvement & Governance

• Continuously improve collection processes, reporting, workflows and internal controls.
• Contribute to the digitization of processes, particularly through AI.
• Maintain the Cash Recovery Policy, credit procedures and risk models.
• Coordinate with Partners, Treasury, Finance and external legal advisors.

Shared Service Center Coordination

• Act as the primary liaison between Luxembourg and the AR Team in Morocco.
• Occasional travels to Morocco to strengthen collaboration, monitor performance, deliver training and ensure consistent application of Finance procedures.

This position is for you if:

Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or equivalent.
• Minimum 7 years' experience in Accounts Receivable, Credit Control or Cash Management.
• Experience in a professional services environment is an asset.
• Team management.

Technical Skills

• Strong accounting and credit management knowledge.
• Advanced Excel skills; IA, Power BI and ERP experience are an advantage.
• Knowledge of Luxembourg accounting and VAT principles.

Personal Skills

• Analytical and results-oriented.
• Strong negotiation and communication skills.
• Excellent stakeholder management.
• Organized, proactive and detail-oriented.
• Continuous improvement mindset with the ability to build collaborative relationships across teams and cultures.

Languages

• English and French required.
• German and/or Luxembourgish are considered assets.
…then this offer is probably made for you!


What´s in it for you:

• Competitive remuneration package including
- a 13th month (representing a mobility budget offering a car leasing opportunity),
- a discretionary performance bonus
• Pension plan
• Lunch vouchers
• Extra days of annual leave
• Flexible working hours and homeworking options
• Parking spots available for a fee within our building
• Possibility to charge electric vehicles in our parking
• On-site employee restaurant with preferential prices
• Free access to our fitness room
• Sports sessions for small additional charge
• Internal sports groups (e.g. running, cycling and football)
• Career development opportunities through a wide range of trainings (e.g. technical and soft skills, language courses)

Our main office is ideally located in the modern and rapidly expanding Cloche d'Or area. This dynamic area offers easy access to public transport, stores and park-and-ride facilities.

Are you willing to grow your career in a multicultural, pleasant and dynamic environment? Then, take your chance!

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

title: Senior infrastructure Engineer (m/f)
employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description:
Description:

You will collaborate closely with IT Operations, Information Security, Applications and Development teams, researchers, external service providers and other stakeholders to ensure secure, reliable and efficient IT services

You will manage your activities in accordance with LIST's project-management methodology by planning and prioritizing tasks, estimating effort, tracking progress, managing dependencies and risks, coordinating stakeholders and delivering agreed outcomes. Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!

·          Ability to work in accordance with internal IT policies, security requirements and operational standards.
·          Experience using project-management and collaboration tools such as Asana, Jira, Microsoft Planner or equivalent.


Soft skills:

·          Strong analytical, diagnostic, and troubleshooting abilities
·          Collaborative and service-oriented approach, with the ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary teams.
·          Project-oriented and delivery-focused mindset, including the ability to plan, prioritize, coordinate and report on activities.
·          Strong documentation, communication, planning and organizational skills.
·          Proactive approach and willingness to continuously improve infrastructure reliability, security, efficiency and user experience.
·          Ability to prioritize tasks and respond effectively to incidents and operational requirements.
·          Ability to explain technical issues clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
·          Ability to work independently while recognizing when to seek guidance or involve specialist colleagues.


Language skills:

•               Fluency in English (Luxembourgish, German and especially French are considered as an asset), both oral and written.


Your LIST benefits:

·          Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society

·          Multicultural and international work environment with more than 60 nationalities represented in our workforce
·          Diverse and inclusive work environment empowering our people to fulfil their personal and professional ambitions

Apply online

req1167

title: Lower School Teaching Assistant (Gr2 Classrooms) 6-months contract (m/f)
description:

The role?
At ISL, we believe our young learners are capable, curious and full of ideas. They learn through relationships, play, inquiry and meaningful exploration of the world around them. We are seeking a Lower School Classroom Teaching Assistant to assist our Grade 2 teachers (students ages 7-8) in creating caring, inclusive environments where every student feels a sense of belonging, develops agency and independence, and experiences the joy of learning.

Working in partnership with the classroom teacher and wider Lower School team, the Teaching Assistant is an important resource for students and parents.

What will you do?

Working alongside the Grade 2 classroom teachers, you will:

• help create a caring and inquiry-rich learning environment;
• support individuals and small groups during student-initiated and teacher-directed learning;
• encourage curiosity, communication, collaboration, creativity and problem-solving;
• observe and document students' learning and emerging needs;
• prepare materials and learning spaces that invite exploration;
• support arrival, dismissal, transitions, specialist lessons, lunch, playground and other daily routines;
• help children develop positive relationships, independence and a sense of responsibility; and
• supervise and accompany students during activities, field trips and other experiences beyond the classroom.

What skills do you bring?

We are interested in what you can do, how you work with others and your potential to learn and grow. Your skills may have been developed through education, employment, volunteering, or community activities.

You will be able to demonstrate your ability to:

• Build trusting relationships with young students, helping them feel safe, known and valued.
• Support learning through inquiry, using conversation, thoughtful questions and exploration to extend students' thinking.

• Collaborate effectively with teachers and colleagues and build positive, professional relationships with
• families.
• Support students' wellbeing, relationships, routines, transitions and self-management in developmentally appropriate ways.
• Adapt and take initiative in the dynamic environment of a classroom.
• Reflect and grow, welcoming feedback and taking responsibility for your own professional learning.

Who you are?

You genuinely enjoy being with young students and see them as capable learners. You are patient, curious, dependable and proactive. You understand that learning happens throughout the day—from a student's question to developing independence during routines or navigating a disagreement with a friend. You communicate thoughtfully, value different perspectives and cultures, and know that excellent support sometimes means stepping forward and sometimes stepping back.
Above all, you bring care, curiosity, collaboration and a commitment to helping every student participate, learn and belong.

ISL is committed to safeguarding and prioritising the wellbeing of children and young people and expects you to share this commitment. independence, and working collaboratively with colleagues and families in culturally diverse communities. Experience in an IB PYP or another child-centred, inquiry-based setting is an advantage, but is not essential.

title: Research Scientist in Economics of Sustainability (m/f)
description:
Description:


Language: English (UK)
Location: Esch-sur-Alzette
Country: Luxembourg

Organisation data: Luxembourg Centre for Socio-Environmental Systems
Job Number: UOL08508
Contract Type: Permanent
Expected Start Date: 01/11/2026

Job Level: level 1
Functions: Researcher
Role Type: Cluster
Expertise: Researcher / Postdoctorant
Job (internal): Research scientist


Your role:

The successful candidate will establish internationally visible research at the interface of economics, sustainability science and global environmental change, developing new quantitative approaches to understand and steer transformations across food, land, water and natural-resource systems.
The candidate's research will combine economic theory, fine-scale spatial data, empirical evidence and computational modelling to explain trade-offs, synergies and spillovers that remain hidden in single-scale analyses. Relevant research may address at least three of the following fields: agricultural production, labor markets, natural-resource scarcity, food security, climate change, technological change, impacts of demographic transition, social cohesion, resilience of supply chains, environmental policy, and the distributional consequences of sustainability transformations.
A key ambition is to move beyond diagnosing unsustainable trajectories towards designing effective and equitable transformation pathways, exploring how policy, innovation and global interconnectedness can reconcile environmental sustainability with food security, livelihoods and economic development.


Your profile:

The successful candidate holds a strong academic background in economics, agricultural or environmental economics, together with an internationally recognized research record. They have demonstrated expertise in economic theory and quantitative modelling, complemented by experience with spatially explicit data, empirical estimation, computational methods or other approaches capable of linking processes across scales.
Additionally, they can translate theoretical concepts into transparent, empirically grounded models and integrate economic analysis with insights and data from other disciplines. Experience in interdisciplinary research on food, land, water, climate, natural resources or related sustainability challenges can be proven by documented participation within interdisciplinary networks and projects.
The successful candidate is an intellectually independent researcher with the ambition to build a collaborative, interdisciplinary research team, attract competitive research funding, develop innovative methodological approaches and contribute to policy-relevant sustainability science. A commitment to open, reproducible research, excellent communication across disciplinary boundaries, and the ability to engage effectively with policy and practice are essential.


The ideal candidate will have:

• A PhD in a relevant field and a minimum of 4 years Postdoc experience demonstrating ability to independently develop a research agenda
• A strong capability to think out of the box and shape their research around the challenges posed by interdisciplinary questions
• A strong record of research excellence, evidenced by impactful publications and success in securing external research funding
• Willingness to contribute to teaching programmes at the undergraduate and graduate levels in areas related to environmental change and socio-environmental systems


Language requirements:

The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired for this position must have an excellent command of English. The University encourages its staff to learn additional languages and provides access to language courses to this end.


We offer:

• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs
• Attractive salary and benefits packages with excellent opportunities for external funding. Support for career development and mentoring. Services to promote staff well-being and a healthy work-life balance


How to apply:

Applications should contain:

• CV; you may include any periods of absence from work, such as family-related leave or career breaks, if you consider them relevant for the fair assessment of your experience
• Cover letter detailing your motivation for applying to the advertised research topic and/or project, including how your background, interests, and career goals align with its objective
• Short description of profile, key achievements and impact, summarizing main publications and projects
• Lists of publications, research projects, PhD theses supervised and subjects taught if applicable


All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence. Applications by post or e-mail cannot be considered. Early application is highly encouraged, as the applications will be processed upon reception.


General Information:

• Reference: UOL08508 (to be mentioned in all correspondence)
• Publication date: -
• Contract Type: Permanent
• Working Hours:  
• Location: Belval Campus
• Planned starting date: 01/11/2026


Gender equality:

In line with our values, the University of Luxembourg encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity, diversity and a working and learning environment in which the rights and dignity of everybody is respected. The University is committed to achieving gender parity among its academic staff. Should candidates present equivalent CVs, preference will be given to female candidates in all departments where gender parity is not yet achieved.

We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the Removals Seller Experience within EU FBA Supply Chain. You're analytical, curious, and relentless. You ask "why" five times, work across org boundaries with ease, and obsess over the seller and customer experience. You bring high judgment, deep conviction, and the grit to turn complex, cross-functional problems into durable solutions.

Key job responsibilities

• Own the removals SX roadmap. Define product and program strategy to overhaul the end-to-end removal experience, from order creation through FC processing, carrier handoff, and delivery. Prioritize across three core seller frictions (damages, speed, and consolidation/traceability), balancing seller trust against cost-to-serve and FC capacity guardrails.
• Bring EU voice to the S-Team working group. Serve as a key member of the cross-team working group with WW FBA and all partner teams to finalize the S-Team Removals overhaul goal and feeder goals. Own and deliver on the EU feeder goals, reporting progress through the working group's mechanisms.
• Eliminate defects, damages, and cancellations. Build mechanisms to identify and resolve recurring defects at the root cause. Own the strategy to reduce inaccurate removals from system gaps. Deliver Seller-facing tools for damage reporting, claims resolution, and proactive communication.
• Fix removals speed and traceability. Drive removal lead time reduction by partnering with FC Operations and enable end-to-end removal tracking so sellers have full visibility from order creation to delivery.
• Scale automated removals. Drive auto-removal adoption by defining the engagement tiers (default, agentic, guided self-service) and the guardrails that give sellers control while enabling automation.
• Be the metric and mechanism owner. Define, instrument, and reporting on Removals SX metrics. Decompose into actionable drivers and size each opportunity. Build the business case, write the narratives (PRFAQ, OP1/OP2 inputs, MBR/QBR updates), and manage the review cadence with senior leadership.

About the team

Today, over 60% of worldwide purchases on Amazon are for products from third-party businesses, mostly from Small- and Medium-sized businesses. Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) enables these businesses (our Selling Partners) to hand over the heavy lifting of warehousing, payment processing, delivery returns and customer service to Amazon, utilizing the capabilities that Amazon has built over the last 25+ years. Sellers can list and sell their products across all of our European sites from a single account. This frees them to concentrate on what they do best - finding and developing new products and marketing them to potential customers.

- Experience in leading large, cross functional projects
- Experience presenting complex ideas in writing in the form of authoring white papers, proposals, or other formal strategy documents

- Master's degree or above in a quantitative field such as statistics, mathematics, data science, business analytics, economics, finance, engineering, or computer science, or experience applying quantitative analysis to solve business problems and making data-driven business decisions
- Experience building cross-functional partnerships and influencing stakeholders across the organization to act without having a direct reporting relationship

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

title: Executive Assistant & Business Management Support - CEO Office (m/f)
description:
Description:


Executive Assistant


Pour l'un de nos clients, acteur bancaire de premier plan au Luxembourg, nous recherchons un(e) Executive Assistant & Business Management Support pour rejoindre l'environnement direct du CEO et de son Executive Office.


A PROPOS DU POSTE

Vous avez déjà acquis une première expérience solide dans un environnement exigeant, idéalement au sein d'un Big4, d'un cabinet de conseil, d'un cabinet d'avocats ou du secteur financier, et vous souhaitez aujourd'hui vous rapprocher du cœur des décisions d'une organisation ?

Cette opportunité va au-delà d'un poste classique d'Executive Assistant.

Aux côtés du CEO et de son environnement exécutif, vous combinez support de haut niveau, coordination, préparation de supports et suivi de sujets stratégiques et opérationnels.

Votre rôle : permettre au CEO d'être organisé, préparé et concentré sur ses priorités, tout en assurant un suivi rigoureux des informations, demandes et actions qui gravitent autour de l'Executive Office.

Il s'agit d'une fonction particulièrement intéressante pour un profil ayant environ 5 années d'expérience, souhaitant continuer à apprendre, gagner en exposition et évoluer progressivement vers des responsabilités plus larges de Business Management / Executive Office.


VOTRE RÔLE ET RESPONSABILITES:
Executive Support & organisation

Vous assurez un support quotidien fluide et structuré auprès du CEO et de son environnement exécutif :

    gestion proactive d'un agenda complexe et mouvant ;
    organisation et coordination des réunions internes et externes ;
    préparation des rendez-vous, agendas et documents nécessaires ;
    anticipation des échéances et identification des priorités ;
    coordination des déplacements professionnels et de leur logistique ;
    gestion des notes de frais, factures et autres sujets administratifs associés.

Vous ne vous contentez pas d'organiser : vous anticipez, identifiez les conflits de priorité et proposez des solutions.
Business Management & coordination

Une partie importante de votre rôle consiste à faciliter le fonctionnement de l'Executive Office.

À ce titre, vous :

    assurez le suivi des actions et décisions prises lors des réunions ;
    sollicitez les différentes parties prenantes afin d'obtenir les informations attendues ;
    consolidez des informations provenant de plusieurs interlocuteurs ;
    structurez ces éléments afin de les rendre immédiatement exploitables par le CEO ;
    maintenez des trackers et outils de suivi permettant de donner de la visibilité sur l'avancement des différents sujets ;
    contribuez à la coordination de projets et initiatives transverses ;
    identifiez les échéances ou sujets nécessitant une attention particulière et les faites remonter de manière proactive.

Votre capacité à comprendre rapidement un sujet, structurer l'information et assurer le suivi jusqu'à sa finalisation fera réellement la différence.
Executive Communication & préparation de supports

Vous contribuez directement à la qualité des informations et documents utilisés au niveau exécutif :

    préparation et mise en forme de présentations PowerPoint ;
    préparation de briefings, notes de synthèse et meeting packs ;
    consolidation de données et préparation de reportings simples sous Excel ;
    rédaction, relecture et adaptation de communications en français et en anglais ;
    préparation et organisation de documents destinés à des réunions de management ou de gouvernance.

Vous savez transformer une quantité importante d'informations en un support clair, synthétique et orienté décision.
Coordination & stakeholder management

Positionné(e) au cœur de l'organisation, vous êtes en interaction avec de nombreux interlocuteurs internes et externes.

Vous assurez une communication fluide et professionnelle, relancez lorsque nécessaire et savez adapter votre approche à des interlocuteurs de niveaux de séniorité différents.

La confidentialité, la diplomatie et la qualité de votre communication sont essentielles dans cette fonction.


Vous avez idéalement :

    un Bachelor ou Master en gestion, économie, management ou formation équivalente ;
    environ 5 années d'expérience professionnelle dans une fonction d'Executive Assistant, Business Support, PMO, Executive Office ou une fonction comparable ;
    une expérience acquise dans un Big4 ou un environnement de conseil/professional services exigeant, fortement appréciée ;
    l'habitude de travailler directement avec des Partners, Managing Directors, membres de direction ou autres senior executives ;
    une excellente maîtrise de PowerPoint, avec la capacité de produire des présentations professionnelles et structurées ;
    une bonne maîtrise d'Excel et des outils de suivi/reporting ;
    d'excellentes capacités rédactionnelles et de synthèse ;
    une parfaite maîtrise professionnelle du français et de l'anglais ; le luxembourgeois constitue un atout.

Au-delà de votre expérience, nous recherchons surtout une personnalité.

Vous êtes structuré(e), fiable et extrêmement organisé(e), mais également curieux(se) et capable de comprendre ce qui se joue derrière une demande.

Vous savez travailler dans un environnement où les priorités peuvent changer rapidement, sans perdre en qualité ni en précision.

Vous êtes à l'aise avec des interlocuteurs seniors tout en conservant une posture professionnelle et naturelle.

Enfin, vous recherchez un poste dans lequel vous pourrez apprendre, prendre progressivement davantage de responsabilités et développer une compréhension transverse du fonctionnement d'une banque et de son Executive Management.

Fixed term contract | Belval | 2.5 Months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

We are looking for a skilled and hands-on VR User Interface Developer to join a short-term research and development project. The successful candidate will design and implement an immersive user interface running on a VR headset and connect it to a robot digital twin. The interface will enable users to visualise the robot, access relevant operational information, and interact with the digital-twin environment in an intuitive and reliable way. The role combines virtual-reality development, user-interface engineering, 3D interaction design, and integration with robotics or simulation software.

Key tasks:

·       Designing and developing an immersive user interface for a VR headset.
·      Implementing intuitive 3D interactions, menus, dashboards, status indicators, controls, and notifications.
·      Integrating the VR interface with a robot digital twin and its underlying simulation or robotics platform.
·       Visualising relevant robot and system information, such as robot position, operating mode, sensor data, alerts, and task progress.
·       Supporting user interaction with the robot digital twin, including monitoring, exploration, and, where applicable, control functionalities.
·       Developing the application using a suitable real-time 3D engine, such as Unity or Unreal Engine.
·       Testing and optimising the interface on the target VR headset, with particular attention to usability, reliability, and performance.
·       Collaborating with researchers, robotics engineers, software developers, and user-experience specialists.
·       Maintaining the source code and preparing technical documentation covering the architecture, installation, configuration, and integration procedures.
·       Delivering a functional and demonstrable prototype within the three-month assignment.

·          Knowledge of software development, 3D visualisation, virtual reality, and user-interface design.

·          32 days' paid annual leave, 11 public holidays, 13-month salary, statutory health insurance
·          Flexible working hours, home working policy (not remote) and access to Digital lunch vouchers

Apply online

Your application must include:

·          A motivation letter oriented towards the position and detailing your experience
·          A CV with contact details
Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by email will not be considered.

Application procedure and conditions

We kindly request applicants to provide their nationality for statistical purposes only, as part of our commitment to promoting diversity and ensuring equal opportunities in our workforce. This information will be kept confidential and will not be used for any discriminatory purposes.
LIST is dedicated to maintaining an inclusive work environment and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, hiring, and retaining a diverse workforce. All applicants will be considered for employment without discrimination based on national origin, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, religion, age, or disability.
Applications will be continuously reviewed until the position is filled. An assessment committee will thoroughly evaluate applications, adhering to guidelines designed to ensure equal opportunities. The primary criteria for selection will be the alignment of the applicant's existing skills and expertise with the requirements mentioned above.
As part of our recruitment process, the selected candidate might be subject to a background check in accordance with applicable laws and institutional policies. Further checks and restrictions might apply to candidates in compliance with export controls requirements
