title: Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory (h/f)
description:
Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory (H/F) – Région Liège-Luxembourg

Reference: LU879641
Luxembourg
Permanent
Legal and Professional Services

Notre client est un cabinet de conseil international fondé au début des années 2000 et aujourd'hui présent dans plusieurs pays européens.
Sa mission est d'accompagner les entreprises dans l'atteinte de leurs objectifs en délivrant des résultats mesurables et concrets.
Son expertise couvre l'excellence opérationnelle, l'optimisation de la supply chain, la data, la conduite du changement, la transformation digitale et la transition durable.

Le cabinet intervient auprès d'organisations de premier plan dans des secteurs variés tels que l'industrie, les sciences de la vie, le secteur public, les services financiers, le retail et la construction.
Dans un contexte où les transformations numériques s'accélèrent et où les DSI, CIO et CTO jouent un rôle croissant dans la définition de la stratégie des entreprises, notre client souhaite aujourd'hui franchir une nouvelle étape avec la création et le développement d'une practice CIO Advisory.

Cette practice a vocation à devenir un axe majeur du développement du cabinet, en accompagnant les dirigeants IT et les directions générales dans leurs réflexions et transformations stratégiques, organisationnelles et technologiques.
Pour accompagner sa croissance et participer à des projets de transformation et d'excellence opérationnelle, notre client recherche actuellement un(e) Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory (H/F).

Votre rôle

En tant que Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory, vous aurez la responsabilité de piloter et délivrer des missions de transformation IT à fort impact, tout en contribuant au développement de la practice, de son portefeuille clients et de ses équipes.
Vous interviendrez directement auprès des CIO, CTO, DSI et Directions Générales, de la définition des orientations jusqu'à leur mise en œuvre, avec une forte exigence de résultats, de qualité de delivery et d'impact durable.

Pilotage et delivery des missions clients

Vous jouerez un rôle central dans la conduite et la réussite des missions de la practice :

• Piloter des missions complexes de stratégie et transformation IT, de leur cadrage jusqu'à leur mise en œuvre.
• Accompagner les clients dans la définition de leur vision cible IT et sa déclinaison en feuilles de route concrètes et opérationnelles.
• Superviser les diagnostics, analyses, recommandations et plans de transformation réalisés par les équipes.
• Challenger les organisations, processus, architectures et modes de fonctionnement IT afin d'identifier les leviers de performance et de transformation.
• Assurer la qualité des livrables, le respect des engagements et l'atteinte des résultats attendus.
• Intervenir directement auprès des instances de direction et accompagner les clients dans leurs décisions stratégiques.
• Sécuriser l'exécution des transformations et accompagner les équipes clients jusqu'à l'obtention de résultats durables.
Développement et structuration de la practice

En vous appuyant sur les besoins rencontrés sur le terrain, vous contribuerez à faire évoluer et structurer l'offre CIO Advisory :

• Développer des méthodologies et approches permettant de transformer l'expertise acquise en mission en offres structurées et réplicables.
• Identifier les nouvelles problématiques rencontrées par les CIO et faire évoluer l'offre en conséquence.
• Développer des synergies avec les autres expertises du cabinet : cybersécurité, data, ERP, cloud, transformation et excellence opérationnelle.
• Contribuer au positionnement et au développement de la practice au sein de mon client.
Développement commercial et relation client
Le développement commercial s'inscrira dans la continuité de votre activité de conseil et de votre proximité avec les clients :
• Développer des relations de confiance durables avec les CIO, CTO, DSI et Directions Générales.
• Identifier de nouvelles opportunités à partir des enjeux et besoins rencontrés chez les clients.
• Construire et développer un portefeuille de missions CIO Advisory.
• Piloter les avant-ventes, propositions commerciales, appels d'offres et soutenances.
• Développer le cross-selling avec les autres practices et contribuer à la croissance du cabinet.

Leadership et développement des équipes

En tant que Directeur, vous serez également responsable de la qualité et du développement des équipes intervenant sur vos missions :

• Encadrer les équipes et leur apporter le niveau de guidance nécessaire à la réussite des missions.
• Challenger les analyses, recommandations et livrables afin de garantir un haut niveau d'exigence.
• Accompagner les consultants dans leur montée en compétences et leur capacité à prendre progressivement davantage de responsabilités en delivery.
• Transmettre votre expertise à travers le coaching, le mentoring et le partage d'expérience.
• Contribuer au recrutement et au développement des expertises nécessaires à la croissance de la practice.
• Développer une culture fondée sur l'excellence du delivery, le pragmatisme, la collaboration et l'obtention de résultats concrets.

Profil recherché

Nous recherchons avant tout un leader entrepreneurial, capable de combiner expertise technique, excellence du delivery et développement commercial.

Vous disposez idéalement de :

• Une formation de niveau Master (Bac+5), idéalement issue d'une école d'ingénieurs, d'une université ou d'une grande école avec une spécialisation IT, digitale ou technologique.
• Au moins 10 ans d'expérience dans le conseil, la transformation IT ou des environnements technologiques complexes.
• De solides compétences techniques et une forte compréhension des enjeux IT, vous permettant de challenger des architectures, des organisations, des choix technologiques et des trajectoires de transformation.
• Une expertise sur plusieurs dimensions du CIO Advisory : stratégie IT, operating model, cloud, infrastructures, architecture, cybersécurité, data, modernisation ou rationalisation des systèmes d'information.
• Une expérience significative dans le pilotage et le delivery de missions complexes, depuis le cadrage stratégique jusqu'à la mise en œuvre.
• Une expérience solide auprès de CIO, CTO, DSI et Directions Générales, avec la capacité à intervenir comme interlocuteur de confiance sur des problématiques stratégiques et techniques.
• Une réelle capacité à développer du business : identification d'opportunités, développement de comptes, construction de propositions commerciales, soutenances et développement de nouvelles missions.
• Une forte capacité à développer et entretenir des relations de confiance avec des décideurs de haut niveau.
• Un fort esprit entrepreneurial, avec l'envie de construire, structurer et faire grandir une activité.
• Une excellente communication, une forte posture de conseil et une capacité à embarquer clients et équipes.

title: Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer – Adaptive Security Systems (m/f)
description:
Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer – Adaptive Security Systems

Position: Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer – Adaptive Security Systems
Location: Esch-sur-Alzette, Luxembourg
Start Date: Immediate
Type: Full-time

Company Overview

We're LuxQuantum, a Luxembourg-based deep-tech startup developing the next generation of quantum-safe communication systems.

Our mission is to address one of the key challenges in modern cybersecurity: how to combine Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) and Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) into a unified, adaptive, and scalable security architecture.

At LuxQuantum, we believe security decisions should not be static. Different data, infrastructures, risks, trust assumptions, and operational conditions may require different protection strategies. That's why we are developing intelligent and adaptive approaches to model these complex environments and support dynamic security and orchestration decisions.

Our work brings together AI, systems modeling, cybersecurity, and quantum-safe communications, creating research challenges that span multiple scientific and engineering disciplines.

We are a small and ambitious team of researchers, engineers, and innovators who enjoy exploring difficult problems, learning across disciplines, and turning research ideas into real-world technology.

Role Overview

As a Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer, you will contribute to the research and development of the intelligence and decision-making capabilities behind LuxQuantum's adaptive quantum-safe security systems.

You will investigate how complex security and communication systems can adapt to changing risks, uncertainty, trust requirements, infrastructure conditions, and operational constraints. Your work may involve mathematical and computational modeling, optimization, probabilistic methods, AI, or other data-driven and decision-support approaches.

You will work closely with our research and engineering team to formulate research problems, explore and compare different approaches, develop models and algorithms, evaluate them through experiments and simulations, and translate promising results into working prototypes.

The research sits at the intersection of systems modeling, intelligent decision-making, cybersecurity, and quantum-safe communications.

What You'll Do

• Investigate challenging research problems in intelligent and adaptive security systems
• Formulate research questions, develop new approaches, and design experiments and simulations to evaluate them
• Develop mathematical, computational, and AI-based models for decision-making under uncertainty, risk, and changing operational conditions
• Explore adaptive approaches for the orchestration and optimization of hybrid quantum-safe systems
• Design and evaluate methods that help security systems dynamically respond to changing infrastructure, trust, and operational requirements
• Translate research ideas, models, and algorithms into working prototypes and validate them in realistic scenarios
• Collaborate closely with researchers and engineers across software, AI, cybersecurity, and quantum technologies
• Contribute to the technical direction, architecture, and documentation of LuxQuantum's research and development activities

What We're Looking For

• PhD in a quantitative, scientific, engineering, or computing-related field; or a Master's degree with strong relevant research or R&D experience
• Strong research and analytical abilities, with the capacity to investigate complex problems, develop new approaches, and evaluate them systematically
• Experience with quantitative, computational, modeling, optimization, AI/ML, or related research methods
• Good programming and computational skills in one or more languages such as Python, C++, Rust, or similar
• Ability to translate research ideas, mathematical models, or algorithms into working prototypes
• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a small multidisciplinary team
• Curiosity, adaptability, and willingness to learn and work across different technical domains
• Understanding of startup environments and research-driven innovation
• Fluent written and verbal communication in English

We welcome candidates from different scientific, engineering, and computational backgrounds, including PhD graduates, postdoctoral researchers, and researchers interested in transitioning from academia to industrial R&D. Prior experience in quantum technologies or quantum-safe cybersecurity is welcome but not required.

Nice to Have

Experience in any of the following is a plus, but not required:

• Cybersecurity, risk modeling, or security-related systems
• Quantum technologies, Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC), or Quantum Key Distribution (QKD)
• Complex or distributed systems, simulation, or system orchestration
• Research software development and building experimental prototypes
• APIs, containerization, or ML/MLOps tools such as Docker, FastAPI, MLflow, or similar

Who You Are

• Curious and motivated by difficult problems where the answer is not always known in advance
• An independent thinker who enjoys exploring, testing, and improving new ideas
• Interested in turning research and theory into working systems with real-world impact
• Comfortable taking ownership while collaborating closely with a small multidisciplinary team
• Open to learning across disciplines and applying your expertise to new technical challenges
• Excited by the pace, responsibility, and opportunity to shape technology in an early-stage
deep-tech startup

Why Join LuxQuantum

Research with Real-World Impact

Work on challenging R&D problems and help turn research ideas, models, and algorithms into technologies for next-generation secure communication systems.

High Ownership

Take meaningful ownership of your work and have the opportunity to influence technical decisions and the direction of LuxQuantum's technology.

Work Across Disciplines

Collaborate at the intersection of systems modeling, AI, cybersecurity, software engineering, and quantum-safe communications, with the opportunity to expand your expertise into new areas.

Grow with a Deep-Tech Startup

Join LuxQuantum at an early stage, with the autonomy to explore ideas, take responsibility, and contribute to the development of both our technology and our research-driven engineering culture.

How to Apply

Please send:

• Your CV
• A short cover letter describing your background, relevant research or technical experience, and interest in the role
• Links to relevant projects, technical work, GitHub, or other examples of your work, if available (optional)

to:

contact@luxquantum.lu

Join us in building intelligent, adaptive security systems for the future of quantum-safe communications.

Willkommen im Team als

(Senior) Spezialist*in Beteiligungsmanagement

Das Unternehmen:

Die Commerz Real AG ist der Asset Manager der Commerzbank Gruppe und verfügt über 50 Jahre internationale Markterfahrung. Das Unternehmen vereint umfassendes Know-how im Asset Management mit breiter Strukturierungsexpertise und entwickelt daraus sachwertorientierte Fondsprodukte sowie maßgeschneiderte Investmentlösungen in den Bereichen Immobilien und Infrastruktur. Als Leasingdienstleister des Commerzbank-Konzerns bietet die Commerz Leasing zudem bedarfsgerechte Leasingkonzepte. Seit 2025 sind die Asset-Management-Beteiligungen der Commerzbank Gruppe bei der Commerz Real AG gebündelt. Neben den Marken und Produkten der Commerz Real zählen dazu die Aquila Capital Investmentgesellschaft mit Fokus auf nachhaltige Sachwertinvestments im Bereich Energieinfrastruktur sowie Yellowfin Asset Management als Boutique für liquide Investmentstrategien. Unter dem Dach der Commerz Real AG verwalten insgesamt rund 1.000 Mitarbeitende an rund 20 Standorten Vermögenswerte von rund 55 Milliarden Euro.

Die Commerz Real Fundmanagement S.à r.l. (“CRFM“) ist ein Spezialist für die Verwaltung von Alternativen Investmentfonds. Die CRFM trägt hierdurch zum Profil der Commerz Real AG und ihren Konzerngesellschaften (“Commerz Real Gruppe“) als integrierter Investmentdienstleister bei. Die CRFM arrangiert Alternative Investmentfonds, insbesondere für Immobilien, Infrastrukturprojekte, Anlagen zur Erzeugung erneuerbarer Energien sowie Großmobilien (wie z.B.: Flugzeuge, Schiffe und Schienenfahrzeuge). Die CRFM ist eine Tochtergesellschaft der Commerz Real AG, die ihrerseits eine Tochter der Commerzbank Aktiengesellschaft, Deutschland, ist.

title: SiFa Sicherheitsfachkraft (m/w/d) (Techniker/in - Elektrotechnik (ohne Schwerpunkt)/Bachelor Professional in Technik)
description:
Dein Job in Luxemburg!

SiFa Sicherheitsfachkraft (m/w/d) in Luxembourg

OG Recruitment ist Ihre Beratungsagentur für die Vermittlung von SpezialistInnen und Führungskräften in Luxemburg und der Grenzregion. Bei uns geht es ausschließlich um direkte Personalvermittlungen zu unseren Auftraggebern.

Für unseren renommierten Auftraggeber mit Sitz in Luxemburg-Stadt suchen wir ab sofort eine Sicherheitsfachkraft (m/w/d).

Ihre Mission ist die Umsetzung und Einhaltung sowie die Risikobeurteilung der Arbeitssicherheit auf der Baustelle und im Büro.

Unser Kunde ist ein etabliertes, ausführendes Unternehmen für Technische Gebäudeausrüstung innerhalb einer namhaften luxemburgischen Firmengruppe mit spannenden Projekten und einem offenen und modernen Arbeitsumfeld.

Die Stelle wird im Rahmen der direkten Personalvermittlung mit unbefristetem Arbeitsvertrag direkt beim Auftraggeber besetzt.

Ihre Aufgaben

- Sie sind Ansprechpartner/in für alle sicherheitsrelevanten Fragen und koordinieren den Informationsaustausch zwischen verschiedenen Abteilungen und externen Partnern
- Sie überwachen und kontrollieren die Einhaltung der Sicherheitsvorschriften und -standards im gesamten Unternehmen
- Sie führen die Sicherheitsunterweisungen und Schulungen zur Arbeitssicherheit in den Büros sowie auf den Baustellen durch
- Sie sind verantwortlich für die Analysen und Auswertungen der Risiken für die Arbeitssicherheit der Mitarbeitenden
- Sie entwickeln und implementieren die Sicherheitskonzepte und -maßnahmen und sind für die Risikobewertung und Unfalluntersuchungen zuständig
- Sie führen die Gefahrenanalyse sowie die Bestandsaufnahme durch (Postes à risques, STM)
- Sie sorgen für die Umsetzung der Managementsysteme im Bereich Arbeitsschutz
- Das Sicherheitsregister wird von Ihnen gepflegt und aufrechterhalten
- Sie nehmen regelmäßig an Sicherheitsmeetings teil und verfassen und publizieren monatliche Sicherheitsanweisungen
- Sie beraten die Geschäftsführung im Bereich der Arbeitssicherheit
- Sie sind für den einwandfreien Ablauf der behördlichen Kontrollen zuständig
- Sie organisieren die internen, externen und Baustellenaudits für die Sicherheit sowie ISO 45001
- Etwa 2-3 Mal pro Woche sind Sie vor Ort auf den Baustellen, führen Dokumentationen, erstellen Berichte und erledigen weitere administrative Aufgaben

Ihr Profil

- Sie bringen eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit (Sifa) im Bauwesen mit und verfügen über eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung oder Studium mit der Fachrichtung Elektrotechnik oder haben eine Weiterbildung zum Techniker / Meister oder einen gleichwertigen Abschluss
- Sie haben die Qualifikation zum "Sicherheitsbeauftragten Gruppe C3" (Travailleur désigné) für Sicherheit und Gesundheit am Arbeitsplatz erfolgreich abgeschlossen
- Sie können mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung als Sicherheitsbeauftragte(r) vorweisen
- Sie haben fundierte Kenntnisse im Bereich Sicherheit und Gesundheitsschutz am Arbeitsplatz
- Sie haben die Qualifizierung zum Schulungsleiter (von Vorteil)
- Sie haben ein sehr gutes technisches Verständnis
- Sie sind offen und kommunikativ im Austausch mit Mitarbeitern und arbeiten gerne im Team
- Sie sprechen fließend Deutsch und haben gute Kenntnisse in Französisch

Das wird Ihnen geboten

- Ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag direkt beim Auftraggeber
- Eine attraktive Vergütung
- Gutes Betriebsklima und moderne Arbeitsumgebung
- Zukunftssichere Perspektive mit aussichtsreichen Karrieremöglichkeiten
- Flexible Arbeitszeiten
- Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

So geht es weiter

- Bewerben Sie sich gern online und klicken Sie auf Jetzt-auf-diese Stelle-bewerben
- Bei Fragen können Sie sich jederzeit telefonisch oder per Mail an uns wenden
- Wir sichten Ihre Unterlagen und vereinbaren einen telefonischen oder persönlichen Kennenlerntermin

Diskretion steht an erster Stelle

- Wir sichern Ihnen höchste Vertraulichkeit Ihrer Bewerbung zu.
- Selbstverständlich arbeiten wir verantwortungsbewusst im Sinne der DSGVO.

Klingt das gut? Dann bewerben Sie sich jetzt. Wir freuen uns auf Sie!

title: Senior Legal Counsel (m/f)
description:
Description de tâches:

Senior Legal Counsel

We are a 100% independent, family-owned Luxembourgish company with over 175 years' experience in the fast-moving consumer goods industry (tobacco products, smoking accessories, vaping, CBD and other nicotine products such as nicotine pouches). Within a dynamic environment towards more reduced risk products, we have embarked on an innovative journey to further strengthen our position in Europe, to grow worldwide and to enter new nicotine categories.

To support our current growth, we are looking for a:  Senior Legal Counsel (m/f/x)

Hollerich - Luxembourg

The Senior Legal Counsel will play a key role in providing support to all group companies, including contract review, contract management and business-relevant services throughout all legally relevant cross-departmental work as required. This role is a coordination reference point, ensuring consistent legal compliance while enabling business continuity in a challenging, but interesting, regulatory environment. You will work closely with markets, internal stakeholders, and external advisors, amongst others, to build a legally sound and compliant basis for the business needs of all parties you work with.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Work on commercial contracts initiated or requested by business owners across various departments, such as, among others, sales, promotional, distribution and manufacturing agreements as well as NDAs, intercompany agreements and finance agreements
• Provide ongoing business support on contract matters, including renewals, amendments, and contract terminations
• Ensure compliance of business contracts with applicable laws and regulations, as well as internal governance standards and operating procedures
• Provide and coordinate with the Head of Legal and the Legal Officer, legal counselling and corporate governance activities, including legal opinions, analyses (in particular regarding marketing and promotional matters), as well as maintaining relevant records
• Coordinate together with the Legal Officer and the Legal Assistant the contract management workflow and established operating procedures
• Monitor legal and regulatory changes affecting local entities and coordinating document and evidence searches for legal purposes
• Contribute to the continuous improvement and simplification of legal services and processes, in particular the work with the recently established Legal AI tool
• Prepare and draft emails, legal opinions, statements, reports, and other documentation on both a regular and ad hoc basis
• Participate in cross-departmental meetings and meetings with subsidiaries to evaluate risks and opportunities in the context of the given legal framework

YOUR PROFILE

• Master of Law or similar completed education
• Minimum 5+ years of experience working on legal matters in a commercial environment
• FMCG background preferred; experience in regulated categories is a plus
• Experience as an in-house lawyer in an international environment providing general legal support to a business entity
• Strong experience in drafting and working with commercial contracts, particularly, but not limited to, in the areas of commercial business matters
• Fluent English is mandatory, German/French or any other international language will be considered a strong advantage
• Proven knowledge of general legal principles, particularly in Civil, Commercial, Competition, Transport and EU law, with the ability to conduct legal research using various sources
• Proven ability to work pragmatically and in time to provide the relevant stakeholders with legal advice that the business can work with immediately
• Experience in forming and educating team members while working under guidelines of the Head of Legal

What We Offer:

• An exciting opportunity to join an international and growing industrial group.
• A collaborative environment focused on performance, development, and continuous improvement.
• Competitive compensation and benefits package.
• Professional growth opportunities within the Landewyck Group.

All applications will be treated in the strictest confidence.
In the context of recruitment, criminal record no. 3 will be requested.

title: Group PMO (Project Management Officer) (m/f)
description:
Description de tâches:

Group PMO (Project Management Officer)
We are a 100% independent, family-owned Luxembourgish company with over 175 years' experience in the fast-moving consumer goods industry (tobacco products, smoking accessories, vaping, CBD and other nicotine products such as nicotine pouches). Within a dynamic environment towards more reduced risk products, we have embarked on an innovative journey to further strengthen our position in Europe, to grow worldwide and to enter new nicotine categories.
To support our current growth, we are looking for a :

Group PMO (Project Management Officer) (m/f/x)
Hollerich - Luxembourg

In this position, you will be responsible for establishing, coordinating, and continuously improving the Group project and program management framework. The role provides governance, standards, transparency, reporting, prioritization support, and delivery assurance across strategic initiatives, ensuring that projects are aligned with Group objectives, resources are used effectively, risks are escalated appropriately, and executive decisions are supported by reliable information. This role applies to all Group projects and programs, excluding IT-specific initiatives.

Your Responsibilities:

• Define, maintain, and improve the Group PMO framework, including project governance, methodologies, templates, standards, tools, and reporting practices.
• Support the prioritization, selection, and monitoring of Group projects and programs in line with strategic objectives, business value, capacity, and risk profile.
• Provide portfolio-wide visibility on project status, milestones, resources, budgets, risks, dependencies, issues, and benefits realization.
• Prepare consolidated executive dashboards, portfolio reports, steering committee materials, decision papers, and escalation summaries.
• Coordinate governance bodies and project review cycles, ensuring clear decision-making, action follow-up, and timely escalation of critical topics.
• Support project and program managers with planning discipline, delivery methodology, risk management, dependency management, and issue resolution processes.
• Monitor portfolio performance and challenge inconsistencies, gaps, delays, budget deviations, or unclear ownership across initiatives.
• Promote consistent project management practices, continuous improvement, simplification, and standardization across the Group.
• Facilitate alignment between business units, functions, and local entities to ensure coordinated execution of Group priorities.
• Develop internal PMO capabilities, knowledge sharing, project management maturity, and best practices across the organization.

Your Profile:

• Master's degree in Business Administration, Management, Finance, Engineering, Project Management, or a related field.
• Minimum 10 years of experience in project management, program coordination, portfolio management, PMO, business transformation, consulting, or a related role.
• Proven experience in establishing or operating PMO frameworks in an international, multi-function, or multi-entity environment.
• Strong understanding of project governance, portfolio reporting, planning, budgeting, risk management, resource management, and benefits tracking.
• Experience preparing executive-level reporting and supporting steering committees or senior management decision-making.
• Professional certifications such as PMP, PMI, PRINCE2, Agile, Lean Six Sigma, PgMP, PfMP, or equivalent are considered an advantage.
• Fluent English is required, additional languages relevant to the Group's footprint are an asset.

What We Offer:

• An exciting opportunity to join an international and growing industrial group.
• A key role within a strategic and innovative product category.
• A collaborative environment focused on performance, development, and continuous improvement.
• Competitive compensation and benefits package.
• Professional growth opportunities within the Landewyck Group.

All applications will be treated in the strictest confidence.
In the context of recruitment, criminal record no. 3 will be requested.

title: Talent Attraction & Acquisition Coordinator - CDD 12 months (m/f)
description:
Talent Attraction & Acquisition Coordinator - CDD 12 months
Luxembourg
Line of Service Internal Firm Services
Industry/Sector Not Applicable
Specialism IFS - Human Capital (HC)
Management Level Associate

Job Description & Summary

Meet your future team

Join our Talent Attraction and Acquisition team, supporting recruitment across PwC Luxembourg.
Working closely with Talent Acquisition Advisors and Talent Acquisition Partners, you will join a collaborative team where strong coordination makes a real difference. By bringing structure, responsiveness and consistency to our activities, you will help create a smooth recruitment experience for candidates while supporting the team in working effectively with hiring teams and meeting its operational and administrative requirements.

What your role will look like

As a Talent Attraction & Acquisition Coordinator, you will combine hands-on recruitment scheduling with essential administrative responsibilities. You will manage multiple activities and priorities in parallel, ensuring that each step is handled accurately, on time and with the right level of attention.
The role requires someone who can stay one step ahead, take ownership and bring clarity, while maintaining a high standard of service and attention to detail.

You will:

• Coordinate interviews across the firm, from scheduling and invitations to sharing practical information with candidates.
• Manage Talent Acquisition team calendars and coordinate multiple schedules to ensure a smooth and efficient interview process.
• Serve as a reliable point of contact for candidates, providing clear, timely and professional communication throughout interview coordination.
• Manage the validation and follow-up of Talent Attraction and recruitment invoices and expenses.
• Manage ADEM administration, including vacancy declarations, required updates and documentation, ensuring accurate records and compliance with Luxembourg requirements.
• Track and report on key scheduling metrics, including time-to-schedule, rescheduling, no-shows, interviewer availability and bottlenecks.
• Prepare weekly and monthly activity reports and maintain accurate data for key Talent Attraction and Acquisition metrics.
• Support Talent Attraction and Acquisition projects and initiatives, ensuring effective coordination and follow-up.
• Maintain accurate and up-to-date process documentation to support consistency, knowledge sharing and business continuity.

Your growth and opportunities

This role offers the opportunity to build a strong foundation in Talent Attraction and Acquisition while gaining exposure to recruitment activities across PwC Luxembourg.
You will develop your expertise in recruitment coordination, administration, stakeholder management and reporting, while building a broader understanding of how an in-house Talent Acquisition function operates.
As you grow into the role, you will have the opportunity to take greater ownership, contribute ideas and improvements, and become a trusted point of reference for the team. The experience you build will provide a strong platform to continue developing within Talent Acquisition and the broader HR environment.

The skills you bring

You are organised, dependable and comfortable managing multiple priorities. You communicate with confidence and professionalism, take ownership of your responsibilities and pay close attention to the details that contribute to a well-coordinated recruitment process.

• 3 to 4 years of experience in an administrative or coordination role.
• A genuine interest in Human Resources and recruitment.
• Strong organisational and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage multiple activities while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.
• Clear, warm and professional written and spoken communication in a multicultural environment, with fluency in English and French.
• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to follow up, align expectations and challenge constructively when needed.
• A proactive and solution-oriented mindset, with a strong sense of ownership and reliability.
• Discretion and integrity when handling confidential candidate and employee information.

Ways of working

• You contribute actively to the team, build trusted relationships and understand how your work supports shared outcomes.
• You communicate with care and professionalism, adapt to different stakeholders and remain solution-focused when priorities evolve.
• You follow through on commitments, work collaboratively and handle sensitive information with discretion and integrity.

Additional skills that would support your success

• Portuguese language skills would be considered an asset.
• Previous exposure to recruitment, HR coordination or a similar environment would be an advantage.
• Confidence working with HR or recruitment systems and digital tools.
• Good command of Microsoft Excel and an interest in data and reporting.

The skills listed reflect what matters most to succeed in this role. If your experience aligns with them, even if your path looks different, we encourage you to apply and start the conversation with us.

Take your next step

Bring your organisation, communication skills and sense of service to a role where your contribution is visible and valued. You will have the opportunity to build strong recruitment expertise, take increasing ownership and become a trusted part of the Talent Attraction and Acquisition team.

If you are looking for a role where great coordination, strong relationships and attention to detail are genuinely valued, we would be happy to hear from you.

Optional Skills

Accepting Feedback, Active Listening, AI Fluency, AI-Human Collaboration, Applicant Tracking System, Behavioral Interviewing, Campus Placement, Candidate Management, Candidate Selection, Candidate Sourcing, Communication, Contract Negotiation, Digital Tooling, Direct Recruiting, Emotional Regulation, Empathy, Employee Referral Programs, End-to-End Recruitment, Escalation Management, Faculty Relations, Hiring Management, Hiring Manager Liaison, Inclusion, Intake Interviews {+ 28 more}

PwC Luxembourg (www.pwc.lu) is the largest professional services firm in Luxembourg with over 3,600 people employed from 90 different countries. PwC Luxembourg provides audit, tax and advisory services including management consulting, transaction, financing and regulatory advice. The firm provides advice to a wide variety of clients from local and middle market entrepreneurs to large multinational companies operating from Luxembourg and the Greater Region. The firm supports its clients in creating the value they are looking for by contributing to the smooth operation of the capital markets and providing advice through an industry-focused approach.

At PwC, we help clients build trust and reinvent so they can turn complexity into competitive advantage. We're a tech-forward, people-empowered network with more than 364,000 people in 136 countries and 137 territories. Across audit and assurance, tax and legal, deals and consulting, we help clients build, accelerate, and sustain momentum. Find out more at www.pwc.com and www.pwc.lu.

title: Senior in Accounting and Reporting (m/f)
description:
Senior in Accounting and Reporting

Who are we?

BDO is present in over 169 countries, and we offer an extensive range of services in the areas of Audit, Tax, Advisory, Accounting, Business Services and Outsourcing. At BDO Luxembourg, our mission is to provide our clients with our expertise of our global network tailored to the unique needs of the Luxembourgish market, delivering personalized service and building valued relationships. With over 650 people representing more than 42 nationalities, we embrace diversity and encourage skill development and ownership among our team members. Our core values, honesty, integrity, quality, respect, and responsibility define our culture. Hence, our People can expect to grow in a stimulating work environment that nurtures professional development and fosters inclusivity.

What will you do?

Being part of the team, you will:

• Meet the needs of our clients (regulated entities and management companies) with regards to accounting, tax and administrative processes, in particular by keeping day-to-day accounts, preparing tax returns and annual accounts/reports;
• Supervise the accounting performed by junior team members;
• Review and finalise the preparation of annual tax returns, linked to their respective accounts;
• Be in regular and proactive contact with your clients and be committed to building long-lasting and trusting relationships with them. Your ability to anticipate and respond to their needs makes you their preferred contact;
• Be involved in improving internal and digital processes;
• Participate in the acquisition of new clients using your knowledge of your clients, the latest trends, the market and your network;
• Perform financial analysis, prepare periodic reports and provide insights into financial performance while ensuring the accuracy and compliance of accounting information;
• Train, motivate and develop your team, because your own success is measured by that of your team.

This position is for you if:

• You possess at least 3 years of professional experience managing a portfolio of local clients within a fiduciary or Big-4 firm in Luxembourg;
• Your leadership and technical expertise are recognized by your team;
• You are highly organized, detail-oriented and able to coordinate several tasks at the same time to meet deadlines;
• You have an independent, conscientious and goal-oriented mindset;
• You are fluent in French and possess a good English level, knowledge of Luxembourgish or German can be an asset.
• Minimum required education: Master (Bac+5)

What´s in it for you:  

• Competitive remuneration package including
- a 13th month (representing a mobility budget offering a car leasing opportunity),
- a discretionary performance bonus
• Pension plan
• Lunch vouchers
• Extra days of annual leave
• Flexible working hours and homeworking options
• Parking spots available for a fee within our building
• Possibility to charge electric vehicles in our parking
• On-site employee restaurant with preferential prices
• Free access to our fitness room
• Sports sessions for small additional charge
• Internal sports groups (e.g. running, cycling and football)
• Career development opportunities through a wide range of trainings (e.g. technical and soft skills, language courses)

Our main office is ideally located in the modern and rapidly expanding Cloche d'Or area. This dynamic area offers easy access to public transport, stores and park-and-ride facilities.

Are you willing to grow your career in a multicultural, pleasant and dynamic environment? Then, take your chance!

title: International Tax Senior Advisor (m/f)
description:
International Tax Senior Advisor
Locations Luxembourg
time type Full time
job requisition id JR100208

Operating as an internationally integrated partnership in over 100 countries and territories, Forvis Mazars Group specialises in audit, tax and advisory services. The partnership draws on the expertise and cultural understanding of over 40,000 professionals across the globe to assist clients of all sizes at every stage in their development.

Joining our team as a Senior Tax Advisor means taking on a pivotal role within a dynamic and fast-paced advisory environment, where technical excellence and high-quality client service are at the core of everything we do.
You will operate in a stimulating and demanding consulting environment where excellence, ownership and continuous development are expected.

You will lead complex assignments aligned with our clients' strategic priorities, bringing technical expertise and a pragmatic approach to problem-solving. As a key point of contact for both clients and junior team members, you will contribute to high-quality deliverables while ensuring deadlines and expectations are consistently met.

You will play an active role in client interactions, developing strong relationships, understanding their challenges and providing tailored, value-added advice. Beyond client work, you will play an important role in the development of our team. You will coach and mentor junior team members, review their work and contribute to fostering a collaborative and high-performing culture. Your experience and leadership will help shape both individual careers and the continued growth of our practice.

In return, we offer a stimulating and intellectually challenging environment that encourages initiative and provides genuine opportunities for career progression. Through ongoing training, exposure to complex international projects and increasing leadership responsibilities, you will be empowered to continuously develop your expertise and advance your professional ambitions.

Responsibilities:

As part of our International Tax team, you will take on a central role in delivering high-quality advisory services within a dynamic and client-driven environment.

Your role will include:

• Advising clients on complex International and Luxembourg tax matters, ensuring technical accuracy and relevance in a constantly evolving regulatory landscape;
• Leading and reviewing in-depth tax analysis, and translating technical findings into clear, strategic and actionable recommendations;
• Managing client engagements, including planning, execution and timely delivery of high-quality outputs;
• Acting as a potential point of contact for clients, starting building trusted relationships with the aim of ensuring  full client satisfaction;
• Supervising, mentoring and reviewing the work of junior team members, fostering their development and ensuring quality standards;
• Contributing indirectly to business development initiatives, including proposals and pitches with the support of a highly experienced advisory team ;
• Collaborating closely with  your management team and actively contributing to the growth and positioning of your service line.
You will be expected to demonstrate high dedication to work, a high level of rigor in all aspects of your work and substantial capacity to share your knowledge with your team members.

Your Profile:

• Master's degree in Economics, Finance, Accounting or Law (with a specialization in Tax Law);
• 2-4 years of relevant experience in International Tax, preferably within a consulting or professional services firm;
• Strong technical expertise in International and Luxembourg tax frameworks;
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure and simplify complex matters;
• Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver under pressure;
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with first experiences in client interactions;
• Demonstrated ability to supervise and coach junior team members;
• Proactive, results-driven and committed to continuous learning and professional growth;
• Fluent in French and English (written and spoken).

What We Offer

• A high-impact role with increased autonomy, responsibility and potential client exposure depending on your skills and behavior;
• A key learning process over the long term in business developments initiatives;

The focus on documented testing, remediation tracking, and assessment of first-line controls reflects current Luxembourg monitoring roles, where the Bank specifically seek experience in second-line testing and assessment of control effectiveness.

Responsibilities:

• Execute scheduled Financial Crime Compliance monitoring reviews in accordance with the approved annual Compliance Monitoring Programme.

 Customer Due Diligence (CDD/KYC).
 Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD).
 PEP and sanctions screening.

description:
Mitsubishi UFJ Investor Services and Banking (Luxembourg) S.A. (MIBL) is a Bank incorporated in Luxembourg and is fully owned by Mitsubishi UFJ Trust and Banking Corporation, member of   the    Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group, one of the largest financial groups worldwide.

MIBL provides a wide range of financial services to institutional investors including depositary, custody, fund administration, and other banking-related services.

MIBL now has an opening in its Compliance Department for a:

                                                                                                                                                                                            
Senior Financial Crime Compliance Officer (CDI)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   (Ref:MIBLSFCCO_092026)

About the Role

The role focuses on coordinating the collection, consolidation, and analysis of compliance information, performing oversight reviews, assessing compliance governance arrangements, and supporting the implementation and maintenance of effective compliance and reporting frameworks across the organization.

Responsibilities

• Coordinate the collection, consolidation and analysis of compliance information received from affiliated entities and internal stakeholders for governance, oversight, and reporting purposes.
• Perform oversight reviews to assess compliance with group policies, regulatory requirements, internal standards, and governance frameworks.
• Review periodic compliance reports, key risk indicators, incidents, breaches, complaints, regulatory developments, and remediation actions to identify trends, emerging risks and areas requiring escalation.
• Assess the adequacy and effectiveness of compliance governance arrangements, policies, procedures, and internal control frameworks.
• Conduct thematic reviews and targeted assessments covering governance, conduct, regulatory compliance, outsourcing oversight, conflicts of interest, regulatory reporting, and related compliance risk areas.
• Support the implementation and maintenance of an effective information collection, escalation, and reporting framework across the organization.
• Evaluate whether identified findings represent isolated issues, recurring deficiencies or broader governance and control weaknesses.
• Ensure timely escalation of material issues, overdue actions, and significant compliance matters.
• Review and challenge information submitted by stakeholders to ensure completeness, accuracy, and consistency.
• Support the implementation of regulatory change initiatives and assess the impact of new regulatory requirements on the compliance framework.
• Assist in maintaining governance documentation, compliance inventories, registers, frameworks, and oversight records.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives aimed at strengthening compliance oversight, transparency, reporting quality and regulatory readiness.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Law, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

Required Skills

• Typically, 4–5+ years of relevant experience in Compliance Monitoring, Internal Audit, Risk, or a comparable control function within financial services, including demonstrable experience performing independent monitoring or control testing.
• Knowledge of Luxembourg and EU regulatory requirements and supervisory expectations including on CRD/CRR, Outsourcing, ICAAP/ILAAP, Financial Crime, PSR/PSD.
• Experience supporting multi-entity governance models, cross-border oversight, or consolidated compliance frameworks.
• Sound judgement when determining the materiality and severity of findings.
• Ability to challenge stakeholders constructively and independently.
• Strong report-writing and senior stakeholder communication skills.
• High standards of integrity, independence, and professional judgement.
• Fluency in English.


Salary range:

• €87,000


If you are interested in taking up this opportunity, please send your application letter with detailed curriculum vitae to:

Mitsubishi UFJ Investor Services & Banking (Luxembourg) S.A.
Attention: Human Resources Department
287, Route d'Arlon
L – 1150 Luxembourg
e-mail : recruitment@lu.tr.mufg.jp

Please be aware that in accordance with the law of July 23rd, 2016, the selected candidate will be requested to provide a criminal record (section 3).

title: Digital Risk Oversight Expert (m/f/d)
description:
Digital Risk Oversight Expert (m/f/d)

Job Description

Find your purpose at KPMG Luxembourg
We see a world of opportunity. From uncovering ways to digitalize, to enabling new sectors to take off, to building sustainability and resilience into economies, we know insights reveal new opportunities for all.

We are diverse and dedicated problem solvers, part of the worldwide network of high-quality audit, tax and advisory services.

We offer excellent career prospects that balance autonomy, flexibility, and responsibility. Our comprehensive benefits inspire our people do and feel their best.

Right now, we have more than 1800 employees from over 70 nationalities. Join our growing group of young and youthful innovators to uncover a world of opportunity together.

Job Description

We are seeking for a Digital Risk Oversight Expert.

The Digital Risk Oversight Expert will play a crucial role in ensuring that the organization's digital security risks are effectively identified, monitored, and managed. This position focuses on oversight and governance, ensuring that solutions, processes, and behaviors align with KPMG policies, standards, and security best practices. The expert will provide independent oversight and advisory support to the first line of defense, contributing to a robust digital risk management framework.
What you will be working on

Independent Reviews

• Conduct independent reviews of security controls and provide actionable recommendations for improvement.
• Assess and validate the adequacy of security measures implemented by the first line of defense.

Security Processes Implementation

• Elaborate, implement, and monitor security-related processes to ensure compliance with established standards.
• Lead investigations on security incidents, containing, mitigating, and reporting the impact effectively. Ensure root cause analysis and lessons learned are addressed effectively.

Reporting & Metrics

• Produce regular reports on the state of information security and key risks for senior management and stakeholders.
• Track key performance indicators (KPIs) and key risk indicators (KRIs) to evaluate security effectiveness.
• Identify, evaluate, and report on the criticality of identified vulnerabilities and prioritize remediation based on potential business impact.

Training & Development

• Elaborate and deliver training sessions to all stakeholders to strengthen the security culture within the organization.
• As an Expert, coach, motivate and review the work done by junior team members.

Collaboration & Liaison

• Work closely with the first line of defense to address security gaps and vulnerabilities.
• Liaise with third parties, auditors, and regulators on security matters, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations.

What we look for

Technical Skills & Qualifications

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT, ideally with a specialty in Information Security.
• At least 8 years of experience with information security concepts and practices.
• Knowledge of IT security standards (ITIL, ISO27001, OWASP, etc.).
• Proficiency in IT security tools (Firewall, EDR, IPS N/H, WAF, SIEM, DLP, Compliance, etc.).
• Strong knowledge in network security and incident management.
• Strong Cloud security knowledge and IT Security certifications are an advantage e.g. CCSP, AZ- 500
• Strong Knowledge on development technologies and languages.

Experience & Knowledge

• Ability to lead security assessments and audits.
• Strong understanding of cybersecurity threats and vulnerabilities
• Experience in vulnerability management and cloud security.
• Excellent communication and management skills.
• Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.
• Motivated and organized, capable of taking ownership of projects from A to Z while respecting tight deadlines and being receptive to new ideas.
• Strong issue resolution skills with a focus on risk controls and client focus.

What will you get

We offer more than jobs. With our flexible work model, you can enjoy work and rest and recharge. Our competitive compensation packages, paid time away from work, recognition bonuses and dedicated programs for personal development and wellbeing help to keep everyone refreshed and motivated.

Can you combine strategic thinking, leadership and a strong understanding of technical, industrial and financial challenges to help shape a company's future?

OUR CLIENT:

Our client is an internationally active industrial company recognised for its technical expertise, product quality and long-standing relationships with leading industrial customers worldwide.
Operating in demanding and technically complex markets, the company has built its reputation on strong industrial know-how, a loyal international customer base and a lean organisation that encourages collaboration, responsiveness and efficient decision-making.
As its markets evolve and competition intensifies, the company is looking to bring fresh momentum to its international development.
We are therefore seeking a Head of International Sales who can build on established customer relationships while bringing fresh perspectives, new growth opportunities and a meaningful contribution to the company's strategic direction.
Reporting directly to the CEO and sitting on the Executive Committee, you will play a key role in shaping the company's future direction and performance.

Your responsibilities will extend well beyond managing international sales.
You will be entrusted with protecting and developing a portfolio of strategic industrial accounts while helping the company strengthen its positioning in a changing market.
You will act as a trusted partner to customers, a driver of business growth, a team leader and an active contributor to strategic decisions.
The role combines a strong focus on developing existing customer relationships (approximately 75% of the activity) with identifying and securing new business opportunities (approximately 25%).

Shape the Sales Strategy and Drive Transformation:

Lead strategic negotiations and secure sustainable, profitable customer relationships.


Identify and Convert New Business Opportunities:

Explore new markets, customers and applications with sustainable growth potential.

Understand customers' technical and industrial challenges and translate them into compelling value propositions.
Work closely with R&D, Production, Procurement and Quality teams to develop realistic, competitive solutions.
Ensure that customer commitments remain aligned with the company's industrial capabilities.
Prepare and manage sales budgets, forecasts, revenue targets and margin objectives.
Develop pricing strategies and continuously improve account and business profitability.


Lead the Team and Contribute to the Executive Committee:

Lead and develop an international sales team, promoting accountability, ownership and performance.
Provide the Executive Committee with clear insights into customer expectations, competitive dynamics and market developments.
Contribute to strategic discussions on investment priorities, innovation, industrial capabilities and future growth opportunities.
Constructively challenge existing approaches and bring forward new ideas to support the company's transformation.


Experience and Expertise:

You have at least 10 years of experience in international B2B sales within a technical industrial environment, including significant commercial leadership responsibilities.
You have a proven track record in managing and developing major international industrial accounts in demanding, competitive markets.
You are experienced in complex technical sales cycles, involving multiple stakeholders, qualification processes, testing and long-term negotiations.
You have a solid understanding of industrial environments, including manufacturing processes, value chains, production capacity, supply chain constraints and operational challenges.
You are comfortable working with complex technical products and engaging with technical experts, without necessarily being the technical specialist yourself.
You have a strong grasp of pricing, margins, forecasting and profitability management.
Experience in highly technical industrial sectors, particularly materials, components or manufacturing processes, would be a valuable asset.
Professional fluency in both French and English is essential. German would be an additional advantage.
You are willing and able to travel internationally on a regular basis, approximately 15 weeks per year.


Leadership and Personal Qualities:

Beyond your professional background, we are looking for a leader who can combine strategic vision with a hands-on approach.


You will stand out through:

Your ability to preserve and grow long-standing customer relationships while introducing new ways of working.
Your intellectual curiosity and ability to understand technological and economic changes.
Your willingness to challenge established thinking, bring fresh ideas and turn them into practical solutions.
Your interpersonal skills and ability to build credibility with both technical specialists and senior executives.
Your pragmatic, entrepreneurial mindset and strong focus on results.
Your ability to engage, empower and develop a team.
Your confidence in working within a lean, agile organisation where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have a visible impact.

title: POST-DOC SOIL HEALTH AND REMEDIATION (m/f)
employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description:
SD-26155- POST-DOC SOIL HEALTH AND REMEDIATION

Fixed term contract | Belvaux | 24 Months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defense technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

As part of LIST's SUSTAIN unit (Environmental Sustainability Assessment and Circularity), the Environmental Policies (EPS) group provides science-based input to the definition and implementation of environmental policies at national and EU level, in particular policies around chemical safety, soil pollution, circular (bio-)economy (e.g. construction, textile, water), and climate - and feeds, at the interface of science, technologies and policies, the regulatory perspective into RDI projects around these topics.

As postdoc (R&T Scientist), you will further strengthen the activities around soil health and the management of contaminated sites via contributing to:
• The further development (implementation-phase) of an Urban Soil Living Lab in Luxembourg (Horizon Europe project URSOILL - Innovative Solutions for Sustainable Urban Soil Restoration Through Living Labs) and participation in a working group on soil remediation and stabilization with nature-based solutions, especially phytoremediation and phytomanagement. Main tasks: literature review; design of field experiments and monitoring protocols across multiple urban sites; support and supervision of fieldwork; data analysis and interpretation; stakeholder engagement in the Living Lab; and scientific publications and project deliverables.
• The establishment of a cross-border network of ‘Lighthouses' of phytomanagement for soil remediation, biodiversity and the regenerative economy in the Greater Region (Interreg project Light4Green),
• Scientific and regulatory support, e.g. via bibliography and the preparation of a review article, on nature-based remediation solutions for Persistent organic pollutants (POPs) contamination (Interreg project Naturem),
• The set-up of a laboratory for testing and evaluating soil remediation technologies (especially bioremediation and phytoremediation),
• Support the definition, submission and implementation of research and collaborative project proposals of the group, and participate to the network of LIST's different activities around soil protection.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!
Education

• You hold a Master's degree and a PhD in soil or environmental sciences/engineering, or another relevant natural science or engineering domain.
• You have practical and solid experience in the design, testing, evaluation and application of nature-based soil remediation technologies, e.g. phytoremediation, bioremediation, mycoremediation.
• Interdisciplinary thinking, well-developed communication skills (oral and written) and team spirit to successfully integrate into the multicultural, multilingual and multidisciplinary work environment at LIST and effectively communicate with LIST's partners,
• Client orientation mindset and great sense of service are required. The candidate should be highly motivated, pro-active and open for new challenges and can work independently,
• Not mandatory but considered an asset:
o First experience in an RTO/academic environment, scientific/technical consulting, authorities, or industry on contaminated site management, pollution risk assessment or remediation
o Knowledge of Luxembourg and the Greater Region

Language skills

• Fluency in English, both oral and written. Other relevant languages, especially French, German, or Luxembourgish are a strong asset.

Your LIST benefits

• An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects
• Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society
• Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square metres, including innovations in all that we do
• An environment encouraging curiosity, innovation and entrepreneurship in all areas
• Personalized learning programme to foster our staff's soft and technical skills
• Multicultural and international work environment with more than 60 nationalities represented in our workforce
• Diverse and inclusive work environment empowering our people to fulfil their personal and professional ambitions
• Gender-friendly environment with multiple actions to attract, develop and retain women in science
• 32 days' paid annual leave, 11 public holidays, 13-month salary, statutory health insurance
• Flexible working hours, home working policy (not remote) and access to Digital lunch vouchers

Apply online

Your application must include:

• A motivation letter oriented towards the position and detailing your experience
• A scientific CV with contact details
• List of publications (and patents, if applicable)
• Contact details of 2 references
Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by email will not be considered.

Application procedure and conditions

We kindly request applicants to provide their nationality for statistical purposes only, as part of our commitment to promoting diversity and ensuring equal opportunities in our workforce. This information will be kept confidential and will not be used for any discriminatory purposes.
LIST is dedicated to maintaining an inclusive work environment and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, hiring, and retaining a diverse workforce. description:
Description des tâches:

XXXX-112 Senior Data Steward - Subsidy Projects
Luxembourg - Esch-sur-Alzette
Full-time
Fixed-term
69,000 - 77,000 € per year

Who we are

XXXX (XXXX) is a brand of PNED G.I.E. an organisation created by the Luxembourg Government, to implement Luxembourg's strategies in research, innovation, and digitalisation. XXXX enables value creation from secondary use of data, for public and private partners and supports the sharing and re-use of public sector data, in a trustable manner. The XXXX service portfolio includes know-how, capabilities, tools, infrastructure, and data services. Through efficient & responsible use of data and improving the secondary use of data, XXXX will support the acceleration of economic, ecological, and societal transitions.

www.XXXX.lu | XXXX on LinkedIn

Purpose of the job / project

Ready to play a key role in shaping the future of health data access and trusted data sharing in Luxembourg and beyond?
Join our team and contribute to strategic national and European initiatives that advance secure, compliant, and efficient access to data for research, innovation, and public policy. You will support flagship projects such as but not limited to, HDAB2-LU, which is enabling the establishment of the Luxembourg Health Data Access Body and laying the foundations for a robust health data ecosystem aligned with European data-sharing frameworks.

As a Senior Data Steward, you will contribute to the development of data governance practices, data access services, and project-related solutions that facilitate secure data sharing, strengthen health and research data ecosystems, and promote the responsible adoption of trustworthy AI. Your work will directly contribute to XXXX's mission of unlocking the value of data while ensuring transparency, compliance, and public trust.

As a Senior Data Steward, you will drive the development and delivery of the data access request management capacity. This includes the collection and validation of access conditions from different data providers, standardising the information into data request application form, defining the access review procedure and SOPs, compiling requirements of data access management tools, supporting the implementation of the tools to and implementing the data access request management workflows in the tools. You will work with the other project team members from XXXX, including Project Coordinator, Work Package Leaders, Data Protection Officer (DPO) and ethical, legal and societal implications (ELSI) experts to implement the required compliance measures related to the projects. Finally, you will interact with the information security, technology, and data teams to ensure adequate design and delivery of services.

What you will do

• Develop and deliver XXXX' DM/DS services within the scope of the projects
• Contribute to other services and the maintenance of XXXX' DM/DS toolbox.

• Implement necessary General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) accountability measures for data processing activities involving personal data required by the projects
• Perform Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIA) for data processing activities concerning sensitive data for the projects

• Develop internal processes and guidelines to support relevant information security and data protection compliances and certifications related to the projects
• Engage in (inter-)national projects related to DM/DS service development related to the projects
• Train and supervise less experienced team members working on the projects

• MSc or PhD in natural science or technology, or social science with technical skills.
• 5 to 10 years of relevant experience, including relevant ones in the following areas:
          - data stewardship
          - data management
          - community coordination, outreach and training.
• Working knowledge in data lifecycle management, FAIR data principles (Findability, Accessibility, Interoperability, and Reuse) and the GDPR
• Experience in technical writing (white papers, documentation, reports, policies) and content for dissemination to stakeholders and the public (online guides, tutorials)
• Good working knowledge of one programming language (Python or R)
• Good working knowledge of command line shell (any OS)
• Good working knowledge of basic website authoring (markdown, jinja, HTML)
• Proven experience in one of the following topics:
          - Ethical, legal and societal implications in data-driven research projects
          - Designing and implementing organisational risk management processes
          - Data requests management of sensitive data
          - DPIA
         - Community building and management
• Excellent verbal communication skills in English.
• Service and collaborative attitude
• Ability and willingness to interact closely with stakeholders
• Ability to handle multiple assignments while working independently and effectively under deadlines

About us

What we offer

• Dynamic and innovative work environment
• Collaboration with diverse stakeholders
• Inclusive and diverse culture
• European recognition and impactful projects
• Shape the future of the data revolution

What sets us apart
The XXXX is a modern and dynamic undertaking. We embrace a Lean and Agile mindset, combining the entrepreneurial spirit of a startup with the responsibility of a public body on a national mission. We will be a partner of society and industry, collaborating with a hugely diverse group of stakeholders in public research, public authorities, European institutions, academic and private institutions, and small, medium and large companies. Therefore, we have an international and multilingual character. Even in this rather ambitious context, we preserve a warm and personal atmosphere.
Inclusion and diversity are some of our key values. We ensure that everyone has employment and career opportunities in accordance with their skills and aspirations, respecting and being mindful of their individual characteristics.  
Join XXXX and revolutionise the data economy!
Be part of our dynamic team driving innovation and making a tangible impact. Collaborate on cutting-edge projects, gaining European recognition in the prestigious European Data Spaces initiative. Shape a transformative future in the data revolution.

title: Cash Management & Credit Risk Officer (m/f)
description:
Cash Management & Credit Risk Officer

BDO Luxembourg is looking for a Cash Management & Credit Risk Officer to join to the internal Finance department.

Who are we?

BDO is present in over 169 countries and we offer an extensive range of services in the areas of Audit, Tax, Advisory, Accounting, Business Services and Outsourcing. At BDO Luxembourg, our mission is to provide our clients with the expertise of our global network tailored to the unique needs of the Luxembourgish market, delivering personalized services and building valued relationships. With over 700 employees representing more than 40 nationalities, we embrace diversity and encourage skills and people development among our employees. Our core values, honesty, integrity, quality, respect and responsibility, define our culture. Hence, our People can expect to grow in a stimulating work environment that supports professional development and fosters inclusivity.

Position Summary

The Cash Management & Credit Risk Officer is responsible for optimizing the Company's cash flow by managing accounts receivable, reducing credit risk, improving collection performance, and supporting treasury activities. The role combines operational cash collection, credit risk management, reporting, business partnering, legal recovery coordination, and continuous process improvement.

What will you do?

Cash Collection & Accounts Receivable

• Manage customer accounts, handle accounts receivable, and ensure the timely collection of outstanding invoices.
• Coordinate reminder campaigns and follow up on payment commitments.
• Escalate overdue cases in line with the Cash Recovery Policy.
• Negotiate payment arrangements and coordinate legal recovery when required.
• Resolve payment issues in collaboration with Partners, Project Managers and client teams.

Credit Risk Management

• Implement a client credit rating system.
• Maintain and update client and group risk ratings.
• Monitor payment behaviour, financial exposure and insolvency indicators.
• Recommend credit terms, collection strategies and risk mitigation actions.
• Monitor customer insolvency risks, in particular by conducting checks with the Luxembourg Commercial Register (LBR).

Cash Management & Reporting

• Produce dashboards and KPI reports (DSO, ageing, cash collection, risk ratings, exposure, legal recovery and forecast accuracy).
• Contribute to the preparation of PowerBI reports.
• Present analyses and recommendations to Management and the Cash Recovery Committee.

Business Partnering

• Advise Partners and business teams on receivable management and credit risk.
• Promote timely billing, proactive collections and effective dispute resolution.
• Ensure compliance with the Company's Cash Recovery Policy and applicable legislation.

Process Improvement & Governance

• Continuously improve collection processes, reporting, workflows and internal controls.
• Contribute to the digitization of processes, particularly through AI.
• Maintain the Cash Recovery Policy, credit procedures and risk models.
• Coordinate with Partners, Treasury, Finance and external legal advisors.

Shared Service Center Coordination

• Act as the primary liaison between Luxembourg and the AR Team in Morocco.
• Occasional travels to Morocco to strengthen collaboration, monitor performance, deliver training and ensure consistent application of Finance procedures.

This position is for you if:

Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or equivalent.
• Minimum 7 years' experience in Accounts Receivable, Credit Control or Cash Management.
• Experience in a professional services environment is an asset.
• Team management.

Technical Skills

• Strong accounting and credit management knowledge.
• Advanced Excel skills; IA, Power BI and ERP experience are an advantage.
• Knowledge of Luxembourg accounting and VAT principles.

Personal Skills

• Analytical and results-oriented.
• Strong negotiation and communication skills.
• Excellent stakeholder management.
• Organized, proactive and detail-oriented.
• Continuous improvement mindset with the ability to build collaborative relationships across teams and cultures.

Languages

• English and French required.
• German and/or Luxembourgish are considered assets.
…then this offer is probably made for you!


What´s in it for you:

• Competitive remuneration package including
- a 13th month (representing a mobility budget offering a car leasing opportunity),
- a discretionary performance bonus
• Pension plan
• Lunch vouchers
• Extra days of annual leave
• Flexible working hours and homeworking options
• Parking spots available for a fee within our building
• Possibility to charge electric vehicles in our parking
• On-site employee restaurant with preferential prices
• Free access to our fitness room
• Sports sessions for small additional charge
• Internal sports groups (e.g. running, cycling and football)
• Career development opportunities through a wide range of trainings (e.g. technical and soft skills, language courses)

Our main office is ideally located in the modern and rapidly expanding Cloche d'Or area. This dynamic area offers easy access to public transport, stores and park-and-ride facilities.

Are you willing to grow your career in a multicultural, pleasant and dynamic environment? Then, take your chance!

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.
