title: Division Controller & Commercial Manager High Speed (m/f/d) (80-100%)
description:
Accelleron is accelerating sustainability in the marine and energy industries as a global technology leader in turbocharging, fuel injection, and digital solutions for heavy-duty applications. Building on a heritage of over 100 years as a trusted industry partner, the company serves customers in more than 100 locations in over 50 countries. Accelleron’s 3,000 employees are continuously innovating to deliver best-in-class products, services, and solutions that are mission-critical for the energy transition. You will join a team of experts in an exciting international environment, committed to excellence and innovation. Together, we support our customers in driving the transition toward sustainable industries with cutting-edge technology, deep expertise, and smart solutions. At Accelleron, we foster diversity and inclusion, welcoming and celebrating individual differences as a source of strength.

In this role, you will serve as a strategic Finance Business Partner for the High Speed Division, supporting the Division President and Leadership Team in driving profitable growth, operational excellence, and strategic decision-making across a global business. Working closely with stakeholders across Sales, Operations, and Technical Development in Europe, the US, and China, you will ensure financial transparency, performance management, and value creation while translating business insights into impactful actions. Reporting directly to the Chief Financial Officer (CFO), you will lead planning, forecasting, reporting, and business performance processes, while actively contributing to the division's strategic development and future growth.

Your responsibilities:


Support the definition and execution of the High Speed strategy, ensuring alignment between strategic priorities and financial targets.
Own the strategic five-year planning, budgeting and forecasting processes for the High Speed Division globally.
Own monthly, quarterly and annual financial closing and reporting, ensuring compliance with internal and external requirements.
Lead the monthly financial performance review with the Division President, providing transparency on key P&L and operational performance drivers.
Ensure transparency on customer, product and lifecycle profitability and provide actionable insights to improve financial performance.
Drive cost and working capital performance across the Division and initiate corrective actions where required.
Act as financial business partner for strategic initiatives, investments and major development projects, including active participation in business cases, design reviews and steering committees.
Partner with Sales on commercial and financial risk management, including risk reviews, insurance claims and escalation mechanisms.
Ensure effective financial governance and internal controls, including implementation and adherence to the Table of Authority.
Drive continuous innovation and improvement, simplification and standardization of financial processes and reporting.
Actively contribute to the strategic development of the High Speed division as member of the Division’s Leadership Team
Contribute to cross-divisional and Group Finance initiatives, supporting the development of the global Finance function.

Your background:


Strong financial background with expertise in controlling, planning and internal controls
Results-oriented finance leader with strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Strong business partnering and communication skills, with the ability to challenge and influence and implement solutions across the organization
Strong cross-cultural collaboration skills in a global organization
Ability to translate financial and operational insights into actions
10+ years of relevant experience, complemented by strong digital & financial tool capabilities
Digital mindset with proof record on digital innovations

Your benefits:


Attractive compensation & benefits
Employee Assistance Program Global
Parental Leave Program



We look forward to receiving your application. If you want to discover more about Accelleron, take another look at our website accelleron.com.

title: Asystent rodziny K/M
employer: Gminny Ośrodek Pomocy Społecznej w Nowej Rudzie
description:
Zakres obowiązków: 1) opracowanie i realizacja planu pracy z rodziną we współpracy z członkami rodziny i w konsultacji z pracownikiem socjalnym;
2) opracowanie, we współpracy z członkami rodziny i koordynatorem rodzinnej pieczy zastępczej, planu pracy z rodziną, który jest skoordynowany z planem pomocy dziecku umieszczonemu w pieczy zastępczej;
3) udzielanie pomocy rodzinom w poprawie ich sytuacji życiowej, w tym w zdobywaniu umiejętności prawidłowego prowadzenia gospodarstwa domowego;
4) udzielanie pomocy rodzinom w rozwiązywaniu problemów socjalnych;
5) udzielanie pomocy rodzinom w rozwiązywaniu problemów psychologicznych;
6) udzielanie pomocy rodzinom w rozwiązywaniu problemów wychowawczych               z dziećmi;
7) wspieranie aktywności społecznej rodzin;
8) motywowanie członków rodzin do podnoszenia kwalifikacji zawodowych;
9) udzielanie pomocy w poszukiwaniu, podejmowaniu i utrzymywaniu pracy zarobkowej;
10) motywowanie do udziału w zajęciach grupowych dla rodziców, mających na celu kształtowanie prawidłowych wzorców rodzicielskich i umiejętności psychospołecznych;
11) udzielanie wsparcia dziecku przez towarzyszenie mu podczas posiedzenia albo rozprawy z jego udziałem, o których mowa w art. 76a § 1 ustawy z dnia 6 czerwca 1997 r. - Kodeks postępowania karnego
12) podejmowanie działań interwencyjnych i zaradczych w sytuacji zagrożenia bezpieczeństwa dzieci i rodzin;
13) prowadzenie dokumentacji dotyczącej pracy z rodziną;
14) dokonywanie okresowej oceny sytuacji rodziny, nie rzadziej niż co pół roku;
15) monitorowanie funkcjonowania rodziny po zakończeniu pracy z rodziną;
16) sporządzanie, na wniosek sądu, opinii o rodzinie i jej członkach;
17) współpraca z jednostkami administracji rządowej i samorządowej, właściwymi organizacjami pozarządowymi oraz innymi podmiotami i osobami specjalizującymi się w działaniach na rzecz dziecka i rodziny;
18) współpraca z zespołem interdyscyplinarnym lub grupą roboczą lub innymi podmiotami, których pomoc przy wykonywaniu zadań uzna za niezbędną;
19) koor

regionalnych i lokalnych problemów pomocy społecznej ukierunkowanych na podniesienie jakości życia;

zgodnie z ustawą o pomocy społecznej i przepisami wykonawczymi;
11) realizacja świadczeń;
12)rozpatrywanie spraw osób zobowiązanych do zwrotu nienależnie pobranych świadczeń oraz prowadzenie w tych sprawach postępowań;
13)prowadzenie procedury Niebieskie Karty;
14)udzielanie pomocy zgodnie z zasadami etyki zawodowej;
15)opracowanie i realizacja projektów socjalnych;
16)obsługa programów

Trade is the lifeblood of the global economy, creating opportunities and improving the quality of life for people around the world. DP World exists to make the world’s trade flow better, changing what’s possible for the customers and communities we serve globally.

With a dedicated, diverse and professional team of more than 120,000 employees spanning 75 countries on six continents, DP World is pushing trade further and faster towards a seamless supply chain that’s fit for the future.

We’re rapidly transforming and integrating our businesses -- Ports and Terminals, Marine Services, Logistics and Technology – and uniting our global infrastructure with local expertise to create stronger, more efficient end-to-end supply chain solutions that can change the way the world trades.

What's more, we're reshaping the future by investing in innovation. WE MAKE TRADE FLOW
To Change What's Possible For Everyone

SENIOR NETWORK SECURITY ENGINEER (M/F/D)

Lódz, Poland | Hybrid (3-4 days onsite)

Career development opportunities within an international tech company
Work in a collaborative, international team and gain exposure to cutting-edge technology

title: Job i Portugal med firmabolig - Kunderådgiver for Audi - Opstart den 1. november - Book en samtale i dag!
description:
Kundeservicerådgiver for Audi. Vi har opstart den 1. november med mulighed for firmabolig.

Er du klar til at tage springet og blive en del af en global digital organisation, der leverer support i verdensklasse?

Vi søger en kunderådgiver til en spændende rolle med Audi – en af Europas mest ikoniske bilproducenter. Stillingen er 100 % remote fra Portugal, og du bliver en nøglespiller i et internationalt team, der sikrer en ekstraordinær kunderejse for Audi’s brugere.

Hvad laver en Kundeservicerådgiver?

Som kundeservicerådgiver er du kundens direkte kontaktpunkt og hjælper med alt fra bilteknologi til digitale funktioner og serviceydelser. Du skaber en professionel oplevelse med struktur, empati og høj kvalitet i centrum.

Dine opgaver inkluderer bl.a.:

  • Besvarelse af henvendelser via telefon, e-mail og chat

  • Fejlsøgning af tekniske problemer og vejledning i bilsystemer

  • Registrering af kundeinteraktioner i CRM-systemet

  • Opdatering på Audi’s produkter og politikker

  • Aktiv deltagelse i teamets deling af best practices

Dine kvalifikationer:

Vi leder efter dig, hvis du:

  • Taler og skriver dansk + har et minimum B2-niveau i engelsk

  • Har erfaring med kundeservice – gerne fra bilbranchen

  • Har teknisk flair og interesse for digitale løsninger

  • Kan kommunikere tydeligt, løse problemer og skabe tillid

Du behøver ikke opfylde alle krav – vi opfordrer dig stadig til at søge!

Vi tilbyder:

  • Mulighed for firmabolig i Braga

  • Konkurrencedygtig grundløn plus bonusordning

  • Professionelle udviklingsmuligheder

  • Et samarbejdende og støttende arbejdsmiljø

  • Adgang til eksklusive rejsefordele og rabatter

  • Restaurantkort

  • Privat sundhedsforsikring

  • 14 lønudbetalinger om året

Fordele ved at arbejde i en international virksomhed i Portugal

  • Udvidelse af dine faglige kompetencer gennem globalt samarbejde

  • Forbedring af kommunikation og salgsteknikker i et internationalt miljø

  • Mulighed for karriereudvikling inden for kundeservice, salg og rejsebranchen

  • Adgang til et netværk af internationale kolleger og brancheeksperter

  • Erfaring med moderne digitale værktøjer til kundehåndtering

Dette er en unik mulighed for at kombinere en stærk erhvervserfaring med en fleksibel arbejdsmodel.

Fordele ved at arbejde fra Portugal

  • Mildt klima året rundt – Portugal har et behageligt middelhavsklima med varme somre og milde vintre, hvilket gør det til en attraktiv destination for dem, der ønsker at bo og arbejde i et solrigt land

  • Lavere leveomkostninger – Sammenlignet med mange andre europæiske lande er leveomkostningerne i Portugal relativt lave, hvilket giver mulighed for en høj livskvalitet til en rimelig pris.

  • Høj livskvalitet – Portugal er kendt for sin afslappede livsstil, gode mad og venlige lokalbefolkning, hvilket skaber et positivt og behageligt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Internationale karrieremuligheder – Arbejde i Portugal giver mulighed for at udvikle internationale færdigheder og samarbejde med kolleger fra forskellige nationaliteter, hvilket kan være en fordel for din fremtidige karriere.

  • God infrastruktur og moderne faciliteter – Portugal har en stærk digital infrastruktur, moderne kontorfaciliteter og gode transportmuligheder, hvilket sikrer en behagelig arbejdsdag.

  • Adgang til smukke strande og natur – Portugal tilbyder nem adgang til fantastiske strande, naturskønne områder og en rig kulturarv, som kan opleves både i fritiden og weekenderne.

  • Attraktiv skattepolitik for udlændinge – For internationale medarbejdere findes der skattefordele, der kan gøre det økonomisk fordelagtigt at arbejde i Portugal.

  • Voksende erhvervsliv og økonomi – Portugal har en blomstrende erhvervssektor, hvor flere internationale virksomheder etablerer sig, hvilket skaber gode jobmuligheder og karriereveje.

  • Stærkt netværk af expats og internationale virksomheder – Mange internationale virksomheder har kontorer i Portugal, hvilket gør det nemt at integrere sig i et globalt arbejdsmiljø.

Arbejdet i Portugal giver både professionel og personlig udvikling samt mulighed for at opleve en spændende livsstil med stor kulturel og økonomisk værdi.

Er du interesseret? Kontakt os på Rene@jobhuntworldwide.com eller Cathrine@jobhuntworldwide.com for at høre mere, vi vender retur indenfor 24 timer.

description: Procuramos um empregado de quartos responsável e meticuloso para integrar a equipa de housekeeping. Funções incluem: limpeza e arrumação de quartos e casas de banho, mudança de roupa de cama e toalhas, reposição de amenities e mini-bar, verificação do estado de conservação do quarto e reporte de anomalias. title: PINTOR À PISTOLA DE SUPERFÍCIES
description:
A Requintasfalto Lda pretende admitir um profissional de pintura automóvel para reforço da sua equipa.

Procura-se candidato com experiência profissional na área da pintura automóvel e capacidade para executar de forma autónoma as diferentes etapas do processo de preparação e pintura de viaturas.

As principais funções incluem preparação de superfícies para pintura, lixagem, aplicação de betumes e primários, preparação e afinação de tintas, aplicação de tinta e verniz, pintura em cabine, polimento, acabamentos finais e correção de imperfeições.

Pretende-se um profissional responsável, assíduo, pontual, cuidadoso e com atenção ao detalhe, com capacidade de trabalho em equipa e autonomia na execução das tarefas.

Valoriza-se experiência comprovada na função, bons conhecimentos técnicos de pintura automóvel e disponibilidade para entrada imediata ou a curto prazo.

title: Italian Social Media Content Moderator (m,f) (Callcenteragent/in)
description:
Start: 03.08. or 10.08.26

We are working with a leading Outsourcing/BPO consultancy to recruit Italian-speaking Content Moderators for an on-site TikTok project in Lisbon.

In this role, you will ensure that content posted by users meets community guidelines and policies. You will work in a fast-paced, international environment, reviewing videos, posts, and comments, and helping to maintain a safe and positive online experience for users worldwide.

Your Role
Review and moderate user-generated content in Italian, including videos, posts, and comments
Identify and escalate inappropriate, harmful, or sensitive content
Apply professional judgment and ensure consistent moderation decisions
Collaborate with team members to resolve complex cases and identify recurring trends
Document moderation actions and maintain accurate records
Contribute to process improvements and knowledge sharing within the moderation team

Your Qualifications
Native or fluent Italian (C1/C2)
Good command of English (B2) for internal communication
Strong attention to detail and analytical skills
Comfortable handling sensitive content professionally and consistently
Previous experience in content moderation, social media, or customer support is a plus
Ability to work in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment
Empathetic, professional, and resilient under pressure
Team player with a proactive and adaptable attitude

The Offer
Full-time, on-site position in Lisbon
Flights to Lisbon covered
Option to live in one of Teleperformance’s fully equipped, shared apartments, located 20–60 minutes from the workplace
Guidance and support throughout the relocation process
Paid professional training and structured onboarding
Health insurance and meal allowances from day one
Career growth and development opportunities in an international, multicultural environment

title: 3D Production Manager (m/f/d) (3-D-Artist)
description:
We`re fast. We‘re colorful. We are loud and quiet. We love what we do and make an important contribution to our customers‘ success every day. We create quality and are one of the leading media and IT service providers in Europe. From Germany and our locations in Asia, we advise and support international clients in several sectors such as advertising, photography, trade and industry. SCHNELLMEDIA stands for know-how and future. Our passion is professional image editing, online and print production as well as real 3D/AI visualization.

We are SCHNELLMEDIA and have a lot of plans.

A strong team needs strong personalities, therefore we are looking for a

3D Production Manager (m/f/d)
Hanoi, Vietnam, Hamburg, Berlin, Amsterdam, Paris, Madrid, Lissabon, Mailand, London, Stockholm
YOUR TASKS:

- Leadership of a motivated 3D production team (Home & Living, Fashion, Retail Industry)
- Oversee daily 3D asset production operations, ensuring smooth delivery and efficient workflows
- Building, developing and motivating the team in Hanoi
- Monitoring, ensuring, and optimizing processes
- Organizing and coordinating between the local branch and the German headquarters
- Actively contributing to the further development of our company
YOUR PROFILE:

- Experience in leadership
- Experience in 3D software such as Blender and/or 3DsMax, Vray for good understanding of 3D workflows
- Experience in photorealistic 3D visualizations of products (focus on furniture) is a plus
- Enjoy working with people and communicating in a solution-oriented manner
- High social and communication skills, flexibility and reliability
- Structured, independent, and goal-oriented working style
- Strong sense of responsibility and assertiveness
- Fluent English (business level)
OUR TOP 3 REASONS:

- Corporate culture characterized by cooperation and co-design
- Responsibility right from the start
- Short decision-making processes in a growing and international company

After an intensive induction phase, we will of course support you with your relocation to Hanoi and be on hand to answer any questions you may have. Apply now with your complete application documents, your earliest possible starting date and your salary expectations.
WE LOOK FORWARD TO RECEIVING YOUR APPLICATION.

-------------------

Wir sind schnell. Wir sind farbenfroh. Wir sind laut und leise. Wir lieben, was wir tun, und leisten täglich einen wichtigen Beitrag zum Erfolg unserer Kunden. Wir schaffen Qualität und zählen zu den führenden Medien- und IT-Dienstleistern in Europa. Von Deutschland und unseren Standorten in Asien aus beraten und unterstützen wir internationale Kunden aus verschiedensten Branchen – etwa Werbung, Fotografie, Handel und Industrie. SCHNELLMEDIA steht für Know-how und Zukunft. Unsere Leidenschaft gilt der professionellen Bildbearbeitung, der Online- und Printproduktion sowie der echten 3D- und KI-Visualisierung.

Wir sind SCHNELLMEDIA und haben viel vor. Ein starkes Team braucht starke Persönlichkeiten – daher suchen wir einen

3D Production Manager (m/w/d)
Hanoi (Vietnam) sowie Hamburg, Berlin, Amsterdam, Paris, Madrid, Lissabon, Mailand, London, Stockholm

DEINE AUFGABEN:

Führung eines motivierten 3D-Produktionsteams (Bereiche: Home & Living, Fashion, Einzelhandel)
Steuerung der täglichen 3D-Asset-Produktion sowie Sicherstellung reibungsloser Abläufe und effizienter Workflows
Aufbau, Weiterentwicklung und Motivation des Teams in Hanoi
Überwachung, Sicherstellung und Optimierung von Prozessen
Organisation und Koordination der Zusammenarbeit zwischen dem Standort vor Ort und der deutschen Zentrale
Aktive Mitgestaltung der Weiterentwicklung unseres Unternehmens

DEIN PROFIL:

Führungserfahrung
Erfahrung mit 3D-Software wie Blender und/oder 3ds Max sowie V-Ray für ein fundiertes Verständnis von 3D-Workflows
Erfahrung in der fotorealistischen 3D-Produktvisualisierung (Schwerpunkt Möbel) ist von Vorteil
Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Menschen und lösungsorientierter Kommunikation
Hohe soziale Kompetenz und Kommunikationsstärke, Flexibilität sowie Zuverlässigkeit
Strukturierte, eigenständige und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise
Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Durchsetzungsstärke
Fließende Englischkenntnisse (verhandlungssicher)

UNSERE TOP-3-GRÜNDE:

Eine von Zusammenarbeit und Mitgestaltung geprägte Unternehmenskultur
Verantwortung von Anfang an
Kurze Entscheidungswege in einem wachsenden, internationalen Unternehmen
Nach einer intensiven Einarbeitungsphase unterstützen wir dich selbstverständlich bei deinem Umzug nach Hanoi und stehen dir bei Fragen jederzeit zur Seite. Bewirb dich jetzt mit deinen vollständigen Unterlagen unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.

WIR FREUEN UNS AUF DEINE BEWERBUNG.

Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Visualisierungs- und Animationssoftware Blender, Grafikprogramm 3D Studio Max/3ds Max, 3-D-Design, Grafik-Design (Gebrauchsgrafik)

Procuramos um(a) Empregado(a) de Mesa dinamico(a), simpatico(a) e com gosto pelo atendimento ao cliente para integrar a nossa equipa.
Principais Funções:
- Receber e acompanhar clientes durante toda a experiência no restaurante;

- Apoiar em tarefas gerais do restaurante sempre que necessário.

- Experiência na função (preferencial);
- Boa capacidade de comunicação e simpatia;
- Espírito de equipa e atitude proativa;
- Capacidade de trabalhar em ambientes dinâmicos;
- Sentido de responsabilidade e organização;
- Conhecimentos de inglês serão valorizados;

Integração em equipa profissional e ambiente hospitalar de referência

title: Forward Deployed Engineer: Ai Solution Architect (f/m/d) (Informatiker/in)
description:
As a Senior AI Solution Architect in our Forward Deployed Engineering team, you see the whole board before a single line of code is written. You partner directly with business leaders across Siemens to map complex challenges to existing data, design cross-platform architectures spanning cloud and enterprise systems, and make critical build-versus-buy decisions in days rather than quarters. You bridge deep technical AI expertise with systems thinking, acting as a force multiplier that enables agile engineering teams to deliver high-impact solutions reliably and repeatedly.

What we offer you:

- An attractive remuneration package- Access to Siemens share plans- 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .
The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.

You’ll make an impact by:

- Driving rapid solution architecture as the first technical expert in every engagement, translating complex business problems into viable technical blueprints within days. - Designing interconnected solutions across the entire enterprise landscape, leveraging SDC for workloads while integrating seamlessly with SAP, Salesforce, and cloud-native services. - Owning crucial architecture decisions regarding cost, latency, scalability, and stack selection, while documenting clear justifications for every trade-off. - Evaluating emerging AI technologies with rigorous skepticism, providing evidence-backed adoption recommendations and having the courage to say "not ready yet." - Staying actively involved in the codebase through technical spikes, prototype development, and pull-request reviews to ensure your architectures remain grounded in reality. - Designing from day one for seamless handover, establishing explicit interface contracts, evaluation harnesses, and operational runbooks so domain teams can run systems autonomously.

Your defining qualities:

- Education: You hold a university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI/ML, or a comparable quantitative field, where a proven track record of shipped systems outweighs advanced degrees. - Experience & Skills:- You bring 8 or more years of experience in software architecture, AI/ML systems design, or solution architecture, including at least 3 years focused on complex enterprise AI solutions. - You demonstrate a robust history of customer-facing delivery and technical leadership, especially when navigating demanding or high-pressure stakeholder environments. - You posses hands-on coding capabilities in Python alongside TypeScript or JavaScript, allowing you to write production-grade code and build functional prototypes. - You provide expertise in cross-platform system design by successfully integrating disparate enterprise environments like SAP, Salesforce, and modern cloud services. - You exhibit deep knowledge of the modern AI stack, covering LLM failure modes, RAG architectures, evaluation metrics, vector stores, and prominent agent frameworks. - You bring working knowledge of at least one major cloud provider (Azure, AWS, or GCP) sufficient to design scalable multi-platform workloads.
- Ways of working:- You demonstrate the critical ability to evaluate emerging technologies objectively, separate genuine value from hype, and communicate technical realities clearly. - You display exceptional live communication skills to sketch defensible architectures in real-time meetings and explain them fluently in business terms.
- Languages: You have fluent English language skills, complemented by strong German proficiency as an advantageous asset for local stakeholder engagements.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!
At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.
As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.

About us
We know that our business thrives only when our people thrive and unlock their full potential. That’s why you are always our top priority. Our global, diverse team is ready to support, challenge, and inspire you, helping you grow in countless ways. Together, we’ll embark on an exciting journey of discovery. Who knows where this path will lead? Join us and take an active role in shaping your future!

description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.
Výhody:Hradené, vlastná doprava zamestnávateľa

description:

providing network equipment administration at multiple data centers;
performing the routine and emergency maintenance works on network equipment;
dealing with requests from external and internal clients;
directly participating in internal projects (developing network, connecting new locations, implementing new equipment, automation).

Requirements:
proficiency in LAN/WAN principles;
strong understanding of dynamic network protocols (BGP/OSPF);
understanding L2-networking: VLANs, xSTP family, LACP, Redundancy (LACP/VRRP/etc);

title: Špecialisti v oblasti počítačových sietí
description:
Key responsibilities
Configure, administer, and monitor network equipment deployed across multiple data centres.
Carry out scheduled maintenance and respond to urgent network incidents.
Diagnose network problems and restore affected services.
Process technical requests from both customers and internal teams.
Participate in the expansion and modernization of the company’s network infrastructure.
Support the deployment of new network equipment and technologies.
Assist with connecting new data centres and other infrastructure locations.
Contribute to network automation and the improvement of operational processes.
Maintain accurate technical documentation and network records.
Cooperate with other engineering and operational teams on infrastructure projects.

Requirements
Good knowledge of LAN and WAN concepts and technologies.
Strong understanding of dynamic routing protocols, particularly BGP and OSPF.
Understanding of Layer 2 networking, including VLANs, the xSTP protocol family, and LACP.
Familiarity with network redundancy technologies such as VRRP and link aggregation.
Ability to carry out basic network diagnostics and troubleshoot connectivity issues.
At least an intermediate level of English, sufficient for reading technical documentation and communicating with customers.
Strong learning ability and an interest in developing technical expertise.
Good communication and teamwork skills.
Ability to understand, organize, and analyze large volumes of new technical information, primarily in English.

Nice to have
Practical experience working with Extreme Networks, Juniper, or Nokia equipment.
Knowledge of EVPN and/or MPLS technologies.
Relevant certifications issued by networking equipment or software vendors.
Previous experience in telecommunications, data-centre networking, or a similar infrastructure environment.

title: Špecialisti v oblasti počítačových sietí
description:
About the position

We are seeking a Network Engineer to support and develop our network infrastructure across several data centres.
You will be involved in the daily operation of the network, the investigation of connectivity issues, and the implementation of infrastructure changes. The role also includes participation in projects related to network expansion, new site connectivity, equipment deployment, and automation.

What you will do:
Operate and maintain networking equipment located in multiple data centres.
Configure network devices and monitor the availability and performance of network services.
Perform planned maintenance and take part in resolving emergency situations.
Investigate connectivity problems and other network-related incidents.
Handle requests submitted by customers and internal departments.
Work with other technical teams to implement network changes and improvements.
Participate in expanding the existing network and connecting new locations.
Assist with the selection, testing, and deployment of new networking equipment.
Contribute to the automation of routine network operations.
Create and update technical documentation.

What we are looking for:
Confident understanding of LAN and WAN fundamentals.
Good knowledge of routing technologies and dynamic routing protocols, particularly BGP and OSPF.
Understanding of Layer 2 technologies, including VLANs, xSTP, and LACP.
Familiarity with network availability and redundancy mechanisms such as VRRP and link aggregation.
Ability to diagnose common network issues and perform initial troubleshooting.
English at Intermediate level or higher, sufficient for working with technical documentation and communicating with customers.
Ability to learn new technologies and process a significant amount of technical information in English.
Clear communication skills and the ability to work effectively as part of a team.
Analytical thinking and a responsible approach to technical tasks.

title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v oblasti informačných a komunikačných technológií
description:
The Support Team Leader will coordinate daily team activities, monitor service quality, support engineers with complex cases, and work closely with other technical and operational teams.

Responsibilities
Lead, support, and develop a team of Support Engineers.
Organize daily operations, distribute workload, and ensure sufficient shift coverage.
Monitor support queues, response times, resolution times, and compliance with SLAs.
Coordinate the handling of critical incidents and escalated technical cases.
Provide guidance to team members on complex customer and infrastructure-related issues.
Conduct regular one-to-one meetings, performance reviews, and feedback sessions.
Support the onboarding, training, and professional development of new and existing employees.
Maintain and improve internal support procedures, documentation, and knowledge base materials.
Analyze recurring issues and identify opportunities to improve support processes and service quality.
Cooperate with Network, Infrastructure, Billing, Provisioning, and other internal teams.
Prepare operational reports and communicate team performance, risks, and staffing needs to management.
Ensure professional and consistent communication with customers.
Participate in recruitment and candidate assessment when required.
Promote accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement within the team.

Requirements
At least 3 years of experience in technical support, system administration, hosting, cloud infrastructure, or a related IT field.
Previous experience as a Team Leader, Shift Leader, Senior Support Engineer, or mentor.
Good understanding of Linux and/or Windows server environments.
General knowledge of networking, DNS, virtualization, cloud technologies, and server hardware.
Experience working with ticketing systems and service-level agreements.
Strong troubleshooting, prioritization, and decision-making skills.
Ability to coordinate incident response and remain calm under pressure.
Strong leadership, communication, and conflict-resolution skills.
Ability to provide constructive feedback and support employee development.
Good written and spoken English.
Willingness to participate in shift-based operations or provide escalation support when necessary.

Nice to have
Experience in the hosting, data-centre, telecom, SaaS, or cloud industry.
Knowledge of ITIL or other IT service-management practices.
Experience with monitoring and incident-management tools.
Experience managing distributed or multicultural teams.

title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

title: Dizajnéri a správcovia databáz
description:
Design, develop, and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards translating complex operational data into actionable insights for business operations stakeholders; ensure models are performant, scalable, and governed.

Build and maintain automated workflows and business applications using Power Automate and Power Apps, reducing manual effort across core operations processes (approvals, data collection, escalation routing).

Own the data layer: write and optimize DAX measures and Power Query transformations; connect to sources including SharePoint, Dataverse, SQL, and Snowflake where applicable.

Collaborate with business operations teams to gather, challenge, and translate requirements into technical solutions — including scope control and managing change requests.

Administer production and distribution of internal financial reports, compile various cross functional reports. Drive the reporting simplification and efficiency.

Prepare, clean, and analyze large datasets from various sources (ERP, operational, and financial systems).

Maintain solution documentation, workspace governance, and RLS (row-level security) configurations in line with organizational data access policies.

Troubleshoot and resolve incidents across the Power Platform environment; support end-user adoption through training and hands-on guidance.

Contribute to the Centre of Excellence (CoE) standards for naming conventions, deployment pipelines, version control, and template reuse across the team.

Work within a GBS or shared-services operating model, balancing multiple stakeholder demands with clear SLA management and transparent prioritization.

Collaborate with senior management and provide update on financial reports, progress and modifications. Explain the variances to senior leadership team.

Support data governance and documentation of data sources, logic, and model results.

Communicate findings and analytical results in a clear and actionable way to non-technical stakeholders.

Keep up to date with emerging trends in AI, machine learning, and Power Platform technologies.

title: Opatrovatelia a asistenti v zariadeniach pre staršie osoby a osoby so zdravotným postihnutím
description:
Ak Ti nie je ľahostajný život ľudí ohrozených stratou bývania a s nepriaznivým zdravotným stavom, príď do Útulku a zariadenia opatrovateľskej služby sv. Lujzy de Marillac a pridaj sa k nám do tímu opatrovateľov! Ako opatrovateľ, opatrovateľka budeš mať možnosť: ​ • prispievať k zlepšeniu zdravotného stavu klienta formou starostlivosti o osobnú hygienu klienta, či pomoci pri presune na lôžko či invalidný vozík • zabezpečovať výdaj stravy, ako aj nevyhnutného ošatenia a obuvi • asistovať pri sprevádzaní klienta k lekárovi a bežných denných aktivitách • podporovať klienta pri každodenných činnostiach • vykonávať administratívne činnosti spojené s poskytovaním služieb klientom • podieľať sa na tímových poradách a skupinových supervíziach Láka Ťa práca opatrovateľa, ale máš obavu, či to zvládneš? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude sprevádzať šikovný kolega a neskôr budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať certifikovaný opatrovateľský kurz hradený organizáciou. Okrem toho Ťa počas roka čakajú vzdelávacie programy, ktoré Ti pomôžu pri práci s klientom Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce, ktorí by radi počas štúdia pretavili svoje doterajšie vedomosti pri priamej práci s klientom v praxi Týždenný pracovný čas je 37,5h (za mesiac to je 13-14 pracovných zmien). Práca je rozložená na denné a nočné zmeny (v priemere 5-6 nočných zmien mesačne). Denná služba v čase 7:45 - 20:15h a nočná služba v čase 19:45 - 8:15h. ☝️Čo je Útulok a ZOS sv. Lujzy de Marillac a aký Ťa čaká pracovný tím? V zariadení sociálnych služieb sa už 15 rokov venujeme pomoci ľuďom ohrozeným stratou bývania alebo skúsenosťou so životom na ulici, ktorí majú zdravotné ťažkosti a častokrát nemajú dostupné možnosti k doliečeniu svojho stavu. Práve u nás im poskytujeme celodennú starostlivosť s víziou zlepšenia či stabilizovania ich zdravia. V zariadení máme kapacitu 35 klientov, väčšinou v staršom veku. Aj napriek ťažkým životným skúsenostiam našich klientov neopúšťa radosť a snaha o riešenie svojho stavu. Počas týždňa sa klienti zapájajú do rôznych aktivít, ako ranné rozcvičky, prechádzky, návšteva galérie, trhov, spoločné varenie, výroba bezodpadových podpaľovačov a iné. Náš tím opatrovateľov aktuálne tvorí osem kolegov a kolegýň spolu s vedúcou opatrovateľkou, počas dňa sa stretneš aj s vedúcim a zástupkyňou zariadenia, ako aj so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, zdravotnou sestrou a koordinátorkou aktivít. Ak chceš vidieť ako to vyzerá za dverami útulku, pozri si videjko: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PWIuYGiNTqE

title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - title: Pomocní pracovníci inde neuvedení
description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá by ti dávala zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Deapul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! Ako pomáhajúci pracovník/pomáhajúca pracovníčka budeš s tímom skúsených kolegov a kolegýň pracovať v nízkoprahovej Nocľahárni sv. Vincenta de Paul. Na starosti budeš mať najmä: - pomocné činnosti pri poskytovaní sociálnych služieb a zabezpečovania chodu prevádzky nocľahárne - administratívne činnosti spojené s registráciou klienta, vedenie požadovanej evidencie - pripravovanie hygienických potrieb, pranie uterákov, výdaj čistých plachiet pre klientov, pranie oblečenia - upratovacie práce priestorov počas dennej služby a príprava služby na nočnú zmenu - vo výnimočných prípadoch asistencia pri sprevádzaní imobilného klienta v zariadení, pomoc pri presúvaní, atď - výdaj a/alebo príprava stravy (raňajky), výdaj potravín a ošatenia Pozri si, ako vyzerá práca za dverami nocľahárne: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1AfN4dSNk5/ :) Rozvrh pracovného času Ide o prácu na nočné (18:45h – 7:45h) a denné zmeny (7:30h – 20:00h) v nepretržitej prevádzke s týždennou pracovnou dobou 37,5h. Mesačný priemer je spravidla 9 nočných služieb a 4 denné služby. Rozvrhnutie zmien môže byť aj individuálne podľa dohody so zamestnancom​ Kto sme? Nocľaháreň sv. Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity. Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude v práci sprevádzať skúsený tím kolegov. Postupne budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať školenia a supervízie, ktoré ti pomôžu pri práci s klientmi. Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe. Náš tím tvorí viacero pomáhajúcich pracovníkov a počas dňa stretneš aj skvelých sociálnych pracovníkov, koordinátorky dobrovoľníkov a komunitné organizátorky či vedúcu nocľahárne s jej zástupkyňami. Viac informácií o nocľahárni a útulku nájdeš na našej webovej stránke https://depaul.sk/, v časti Naše služby, alebo vo video vizitke: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9IufpprxiqU Tešíme sa na teba :) !

title: Feelgood-Manager / Kundenberater (all genders) - Fokus Financial Wellbeing - auf den kanarischen Ins (Feelgood-Manager/in)
description:
EinleitungDu liebst es, Menschen zu unterstützen, Orientierung zu geben und komplexe Themen verständlich zu erklären ?
Finanzielle Sicherheit und Wohlbefinden sind für dich ein zentraler Bestandteil von Lebensqualität – und du möchtest dieses Wissen nutzen, um andere nachhaltig zu stärken?
Dann ist diese Position genau das Richtige für dich! Als Feel-Good-Manager / Kundenberater (all genders) mit Fokus Financial Wellbeing bist du die erste Anlaufstelle für Mitarbeitende unserer Kund:innen, wenn es um finanzielle Benefits, Absicherung und Vorsorge geht. Du verbindest empathische Beratung mit fachlicher Expertise und sorgst dafür, dass sich Mitarbeitende gut informiert, wertgeschätzt und finanziell gut begleitet fühlen.Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte Financial Wellbeing erlebbar – menschlich, verständlich und auf Augenhöhe.
Deine Aufgaben
• Du berätst Mitarbeitende unserer Kund:innen individuell zu Financial Wellbeing , Versicherungen, Vorsorge und finanziellen Benefits (B2C).
• Du betreust Kund:innen telefonisch, schriftlich und virtuell und sorgst für eine positive Service- und Nutzererfahrung.
• Du bearbeitest Kundenanfragen und Serviceprozesse eigenständig – von der Beratung bis zur Umsetzung.
• Du erklärst komplexe Finanz- und Versicherungsthemen verständlich und kundenorientiert.
• Du bringst dich aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung von Services und Prozessen im Bereich Financial Wellbeing ein.

Dein Profil
• Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder ein Studium im Finanz-, Versicherungs- oder Bankbereich (z. B. Versicherungskaufmann/-frau, Fachwirt:in für Finanzanlagen, Bankausbildung, Steuerberater:in).
• Du bringst Berufserfahrung in der Kunden- oder Finanzberatung (B2C) mit.
• Du verfügst über eine ausgeprägte Service- und Kundenorientierung sowie Freude an beratender Tätigkeit.
• Du gehst sicher mit IT-Systemen, CRM-Tools und digitalen Anwendungen um.
• Du arbeitest selbstständig, sorgfältig und kundenorientiert und verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Was Dich erwartet
• Flexible Arbeitszeiten, modernes Büro auf Fuerteventura oder remote auf den kanarischen Inseln
• Workation mit Extras: Bis zu 4 Wochen EU-Workation pro Jahr – inkl. Flug & Unterkunft bei Wahl des Standorts München
• Faire Konditionen: 30 Urlaubstage, unbefristeter Vertrag & private Zusatzkrankenversicherung
• Attraktive-Vergütung: Überdurchschnittliches Gehalt im Landesvergleich
• Einfacher Start: Unterstützung bei der NIE-Nummer & Behördengängen und ein herzliches Team vor Ort

Bitte beachte: Das Bewerbungsverfahren wird zentral über die ValueNet Group koordiniert.

Wir laden Menschen aller Hintergründe ein, sich zu bewerben – unabhängig von Hautfarbe, Nationalität, Religion, Weltanschauung, sexueller Orientierung, Geschlechtsidentität, Alter oder Behinderung. Denn Vielfalt bereichert unser Team und schafft Raum für Innovation und gemeinsame Erfolge.

Begeisterung, Vertrauen, Mut und Verantwortung prägen unsere Kultur. Wir setzen uns aktiv für ein inklusives Umfeld ein, das die Individualität jedes Einzelnen respektiert und unsere gemeinsamen Ziele stärkt.

description:
FUNCIONES: Atender a las personas usuarias y al público en general del Complejo deportivo de Corvera. Información sobre temas relacionados con las actividades realizadas en la instalación. Las plazas destinadas a las personas mayores de 45 años, deberán poseer esa edad a fecha de inicio de contrato. No podrán participar en la presente convocatoria aquellas personas con una relación laboral con el Ayto. Corvera de duración superior a 122 días (4 meses), formalizada al amparo de los siguientes programas de subvenciones: Convocatoria 2024 y 2025 en la línea de Planes de Empleo recogidos en la base Cuarta y Quinta de la convocatoria. title: German speaking Google Ads Sales Executive (m/w/d), Barcelona Spain (Sales-Manager/in)
description:
Join a dynamic team as a Google Ads Sales Executive, where you’ll drive growth for our valued clients. We’re seeking a resilient individual to focus on providing exceptional service-oriented Google Ads solutions to emerging businesses and established local enterprises. If you have a proven sales track record, excel at building relationships quickly, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

- Engage with regional clients, understanding their needs and providing tailored service solutions.
- Manage a high volume of accounts, focusing on delivering exceptional service and sales support.
- Drive revenue growth by effectively selling and convincing clients, using strong sales techniques.
- Work with performance targets and KPIs to consistently meet or exceed objectives.
- Quickly adapt to changing customer needs and business priorities.
- Cultivate relationships with clients, ensuring their satisfaction and fostering long-term loyalty.
- Provide excellent customer service, addressing inquiries, concerns, and providing timely resolutions.

Requirements

- C2 level of German and C1 level of English (both written and spoken).
- 2 years of proven sales experience, with the ability to win people over and convince clients rapidly.
- Proficient at creating digital marketing strategies for all customers sizes.
- Education: BA/BS degree required; Master’s degree or advanced professional certification is highly desirable.
- High-Impact Target Attainment: Extensive history of consistently achieving and surpassing challenging sales quotas. Must possess deep expertise in persuasive negotiation and a demonstrated capacity for driving significant individual revenue and market share gains in high-velocity sectors of different verticals. Proficient resilience and ability to handle a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
- Advanced Client Advocacy: Significant experience as a senior, customer-facing subject matter expert, specifically designing and implementing service protocols that resolve systemic client friction and substantially enhance customer retention and lifetime value.
- Operational Versatility: Exceptional ability to thrive through periods of ambiguity and rapid change, swiftly implementing process improvements and recalibrating priorities to ensure continuous business momentum.

Specialized Skills for the German Market:

- Deep German market and cultural understanding.
- Strategic thinking to target high-growth companies.
- Strong problem-solving, analytical, and relationship-building skills.
- Ability to unlock substantial expansion opportunities.
- German cultural awareness for building client trust.
- Stakeholder management, including skeptical clients and multiple agencies.
- Deep understanding of the German digital marketing ecosystem to position Google Ads effectively.
- Proficiency in managing sophisticated ROI and integration queries.
- Knowledge of local regulations, especially GDPR, to ensure compliance and tailor data-privacy-focused outreach strategies.

Desirable Skills

- Process Excellence: Systematically improving organizational processes to enhance efficiency, effectiveness, and quality
- Collaboration: Working effectively with others, sharing ideas and resources to achieve common goals
- Communication: Exchanging information, ideas, and messages between individuals or groups through various channels and mediums.
- Emotional Intelligence: Understanding and managing one’s own emotions and the emotions of others to foster positive relationships and enhance the impact of actions
- Open Mindedness: Considering and appreciating diverse perspectives and ideas, fostering collaboration
- Critical Thinking: Evaluating information and arguments, leading to informed and effective decisions based on data insights
- Solution Orientation: Approaching problems and challenges with a focus on finding practical and effective solutions
- Entrepreneurship: Having a mindset characterized by innovation, creativity, risk-taking, and a proactive approach to problem-solving and opportunity identification

Benefits

- Full-time (39 hours/week) hybrid position in Barcelona with a salary of 24.310,00 € gross/year + up to 4.290,00 € gross/year in bonus.
- Relocation Support
- Private Health Insurance.
- Continuous skill development and certifications.
- Clear career growth opportunities
- Engaging workplace with bi-weekly, monthly, or quarterly contests and dynamic business casual culture.
- Prime office location at the World Trade Center, Barcelona, surrounded by the sea.

title: Job i Barcelona - Er du kreativ og har arbejdet med salg, telemarketing eller marketing i mere end et år?

Engelsktalende arbejdsmiljø er standard, og du får fuldt betalt oplæring, personlige coaches og adgang til certificeringer. Stillingen åbner døre til intern karriereudvikling og spændende projekter inden for digital markedsføring.

  • Fast fuldtidsstilling (39 timer/uge) med hybridmodel i Barcelona

  • Kontor med havudsigt i World Trade Center, Barcelona

Barcelona byder på solrige dage, strandliv og kreativ energi. Her kan du nyde tapas ved havet, arbejde med banebrydende teknologi og udvikle dig både personligt og professionelt i et byliv, der aldrig står stille. Derudover får du:

title: Chargé(e) d'Affaires Construction Métallique (H/F)
description:
Barcelone - Espagne
Rejoindre le futur pôle d'ingénierie et développement du groupe AXOR
Dans le cadre de son développement, AXOR Ingénierie souhaite faire de Barcelone son futur pôle d'ingénierie, de coordination et de développement pour l'ensemble du groupe.
Déjà implanté sur plusieurs marchés, le groupe accompagne ses clients dans la conception, l'ingénierie, la fabrication et le déploiement de structures métalliques destinées aux bâtiments industriels, tertiaires et résidentiels.
Nous recherchons aujourd'hui un(e) Chargé(e) d'Affaires Construction Métallique capable de suivre les projets de manière autonome, de coordonner les différents intervenants et de contribuer au développement commercial du groupe.
Votre mission
En lien direct avec la Direction, les équipes techniques et les partenaires du groupe, vous prenez en charge le suivi des affaires depuis l'analyse du besoin client jusqu'à la coordination de la réalisation.
Votre rôle consiste à faire le lien entre les clients, les bureaux d'études, les équipes commerciales, les partenaires techniques et les unités de production afin de garantir le bon déroulement des projets.
Ce poste est basé à Barcelone, avec une activité tournée principalement vers le développement et le suivi des affaires en France et sur les autres marchés du groupe.
Vos principales responsabilités
Suivi des affaires et coordination technique
- Analyser les demandes clients, les dossiers techniques, plans et cahiers des charges ;
- Participer à l'étude de faisabilité technique et commerciale des projets ;
- Préparer, suivre et relancer les offres commerciales ;
- Coordonner les échanges entre clients, bureaux d'études, partenaires techniques et équipes internes ;
- Suivre l'avancement des projets, les délais, les priorités et les points de blocage ;
- Assurer un reporting régulier auprès de la Direction ;
- Veiller à la bonne transmission des informations nécessaires à la production et à la réalisation des projets.
Développement commercial et relation partenaires
- Développer et entretenir un portefeuille de clients et partenaires ;
- Représenter AXOR auprès des acteurs du secteur : entreprises, bureaux d'études, architectes, maîtres d'œuvre, partenaires industriels ;
- Identifier de nouvelles opportunités d'affaires sur les marchés ciblés ;
- Participer à la structuration des méthodes commerciales et du suivi client ;
- Contribuer au développement des activités liées aux structures métalliques, à l'enveloppe du bâtiment et aux solutions constructives.
Profil recherché
- Expérience confirmée en chargé d'affaires, conduite de projets, développement commercial BTP, construction métallique, ingénierie ou environnement similaire ;
- Bonne compréhension des dossiers techniques, plans, métrés, chiffrages et contraintes chantier ;
- Capacité à piloter plusieurs affaires en parallèle avec rigueur et autonomie ;
- Aisance dans la relation client, la négociation et la coordination d'interlocuteurs variés ;
- Esprit entrepreneurial, sens de l'organisation et capacité à structurer son activité ;
- Profil terrain, réactif, fiable et orienté solutions ;
- Une expérience dans la construction métallique, le bâtiment industriel, l'enveloppe du bâtiment ou les structures métalliques serait fortement appréciée.
Langues
- Français courant indispensable ;
- Espagnol professionnel indispensable ;

Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

title: German speaking Google Ads Sales Executive (m/w/d), Barcelona Spain (Sales-Manager/in)
description:
Join a dynamic team as a Google Ads Sales Executive, where you’ll drive growth for our valued clients. We’re seeking a resilient individual to focus on providing exceptional service-oriented Google Ads solutions to emerging businesses and established local enterprises. If you have a proven sales track record, excel at building relationships quickly, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you.

- Engage with regional clients, understanding their needs and providing tailored service solutions.
- Manage a high volume of accounts, focusing on delivering exceptional service and sales support.
- Drive revenue growth by effectively selling and convincing clients, using strong sales techniques.
- Work with performance targets and KPIs to consistently meet or exceed objectives.
- Quickly adapt to changing customer needs and business priorities.
- Cultivate relationships with clients, ensuring their satisfaction and fostering long-term loyalty.
- Provide excellent customer service, addressing inquiries, concerns, and providing timely resolutions.

Requirements

- C2 level of German and C1 level of English (both written and spoken).
- 2 years of proven sales experience, with the ability to win people over and convince clients rapidly.
- Proficient at creating digital marketing strategies for all customers sizes.
- Education: BA/BS degree required; Master’s degree or advanced professional certification is highly desirable.
- High-Impact Target Attainment: Extensive history of consistently achieving and surpassing challenging sales quotas. Must possess deep expertise in persuasive negotiation and a demonstrated capacity for driving significant individual revenue and market share gains in high-velocity sectors of different verticals. Proficient resilience and ability to handle a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
- Advanced Client Advocacy: Significant experience as a senior, customer-facing subject matter expert, specifically designing and implementing service protocols that resolve systemic client friction and substantially enhance customer retention and lifetime value.
- Operational Versatility: Exceptional ability to thrive through periods of ambiguity and rapid change, swiftly implementing process improvements and recalibrating priorities to ensure continuous business momentum.

Specialized Skills for the German Market:

- Deep German market and cultural understanding.
- Strategic thinking to target high-growth companies.
- Strong problem-solving, analytical, and relationship-building skills.
- Ability to unlock substantial expansion opportunities.
- German cultural awareness for building client trust.
- Stakeholder management, including skeptical clients and multiple agencies.
- Deep understanding of the German digital marketing ecosystem to position Google Ads effectively.
- Proficiency in managing sophisticated ROI and integration queries.
- Knowledge of local regulations, especially GDPR, to ensure compliance and tailor data-privacy-focused outreach strategies.

Desirable Skills

- Process Excellence: Systematically improving organizational processes to enhance efficiency, effectiveness, and quality
- Collaboration: Working effectively with others, sharing ideas and resources to achieve common goals
- Communication: Exchanging information, ideas, and messages between individuals or groups through various channels and mediums.
- Emotional Intelligence: Understanding and managing one’s own emotions and the emotions of others to foster positive relationships and enhance the impact of actions
- Open Mindedness: Considering and appreciating diverse perspectives and ideas, fostering collaboration
- Critical Thinking: Evaluating information and arguments, leading to informed and effective decisions based on data insights
- Solution Orientation: Approaching problems and challenges with a focus on finding practical and effective solutions
- Entrepreneurship: Having a mindset characterized by innovation, creativity, risk-taking, and a proactive approach to problem-solving and opportunity identification

Benefits

- Full-time (39 hours/week) hybrid position in Barcelona with a salary of 24.310,00 € gross/year + up to 4.290,00 € gross/year in bonus.
- Relocation Support
- Private Health Insurance.
- Continuous skill development and certifications.
- Clear career growth opportunities
- Engaging workplace with bi-weekly, monthly, or quarterly contests and dynamic business casual culture.
- Prime office location at the World Trade Center, Barcelona, surrounded by the sea.

title: German speaking Google Ads Sales Executive (m/w/d), Barcelona Spain (Sales-Manager/in)
description:
Join a dynamic team as a Google Ads Sales Executive, where you’ll drive growth for our valued clients. We’re seeking a resilient individual to focus on providing exceptional service-oriented Google Ads solutions to emerging businesses and established local enterprises. If you have a proven sales track record, excel at building relationships quickly, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

- Engage with regional clients, understanding their needs and providing tailored service solutions.
- Manage a high volume of accounts, focusing on delivering exceptional service and sales support.
- Drive revenue growth by effectively selling and convincing clients, using strong sales techniques.
- Work with performance targets and KPIs to consistently meet or exceed objectives.
- Quickly adapt to changing customer needs and business priorities.
- Cultivate relationships with clients, ensuring their satisfaction and fostering long-term loyalty.
- Provide excellent customer service, addressing inquiries, concerns, and providing timely resolutions.

Requirements

- C2 level of German and C1 level of English (both written and spoken).
- 2 years of proven sales experience, with the ability to win people over and convince clients rapidly.
- Proficient at creating digital marketing strategies for all customers sizes.
- Education: BA/BS degree required; Master’s degree or advanced professional certification is highly desirable.
- High-Impact Target Attainment: Extensive history of consistently achieving and surpassing challenging sales quotas. Must possess deep expertise in persuasive negotiation and a demonstrated capacity for driving significant individual revenue and market share gains in high-velocity sectors of different verticals. Proficient resilience and ability to handle a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
- Advanced Client Advocacy: Significant experience as a senior, customer-facing subject matter expert, specifically designing and implementing service protocols that resolve systemic client friction and substantially enhance customer retention and lifetime value.
- Operational Versatility: Exceptional ability to thrive through periods of ambiguity and rapid change, swiftly implementing process improvements and recalibrating priorities to ensure continuous business momentum.

Specialized Skills for the German Market:

- Deep German market and cultural understanding.
- Strategic thinking to target high-growth companies.
- Strong problem-solving, analytical, and relationship-building skills.
- Ability to unlock substantial expansion opportunities.
- German cultural awareness for building client trust.
- Stakeholder management, including skeptical clients and multiple agencies.
- Deep understanding of the German digital marketing ecosystem to position Google Ads effectively.
- Proficiency in managing sophisticated ROI and integration queries.
- Knowledge of local regulations, especially GDPR, to ensure compliance and tailor data-privacy-focused outreach strategies.

Desirable Skills

- Process Excellence: Systematically improving organizational processes to enhance efficiency, effectiveness, and quality
- Collaboration: Working effectively with others, sharing ideas and resources to achieve common goals
- Communication: Exchanging information, ideas, and messages between individuals or groups through various channels and mediums.
- Emotional Intelligence: Understanding and managing one’s own emotions and the emotions of others to foster positive relationships and enhance the impact of actions
- Open Mindedness: Considering and appreciating diverse perspectives and ideas, fostering collaboration
- Critical Thinking: Evaluating information and arguments, leading to informed and effective decisions based on data insights
- Solution Orientation: Approaching problems and challenges with a focus on finding practical and effective solutions
- Entrepreneurship: Having a mindset characterized by innovation, creativity, risk-taking, and a proactive approach to problem-solving and opportunity identification

Benefits

- Full-time (39 hours/week) hybrid position in Barcelona with a salary of 24.310,00 € gross/year + up to 4.290,00 € gross/year in bonus.
- Relocation Support
- Private Health Insurance.
- Continuous skill development and certifications.
- Clear career growth opportunities
- Engaging workplace with bi-weekly, monthly, or quarterly contests and dynamic business casual culture.
- Prime office location at the World Trade Center, Barcelona, surrounded by the sea.

title: Customer Service Representative (Swedish - Speaking) - Onsite AM03
description:

Career growth and personal development  



This is a great opportunity to experience the power of what’s next and develop “friends for life” at the same time. We’ll give you all the training, cutting-edge technologies, and the continuing support you’ll need to succeed.

  

What you will do in this role  



In everything we do, we believe in doing right by and for people – our clients, their customers, our people, our community, and our planet.  



As a Customer Service Representative on our team, you will:  



- Handle incoming customers contacts (via telephone, email, chat or other automated alerts) and solve users’ demands

- Maintain service and product knowledge and expertise associated with applications specific to individual customers
