title: Account Executive
description:
A little about ADP

We are a global leader in human resources technology, offering the latest AI and machine learning-enhanced payroll, tax, human resources, benefits, and much more. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive, down-to-earth culture that welcomes ideas, encourages innovation, and values belonging. We've received recognition as a global Best Places to Work and a recipient of many prestigious awards for diversity, equity, and inclusion, including a DiversityInc® Top 50 Company, Best CEO and company for women, LGBTQ+, multicultural talent, and more.

Sales at ADP

It's what drives our global growth as a world-wide leader of workforce solutions. With us, you can achieve your best within a Sales-centric, performance-oriented environment. We give you the tools to succeed, with continuous opportunities to train and advance. And as you develop the relationships that fuel our growth, you can enjoy the rewards and recognition you deserve.


Position Summary:

As our Field Sales Manager for our Swiss market,
•    You will be representing ADP and all the local & international services and products that we can offer to our clients.
•    Your main responsibility is on creating new business opportunities and make sure you close the deal.
•    You will be directly reporting to the Sales Director and will have tight relationships with other local & international District Managers, Global Sales Managers, and important stakeholders in the ADP organization (Implementation, Customer Service, Sales Support etc) to orchestrate the service excellence value proposition delivered to the customer.
•    You will be the owner and plan your territory or account approach in accordance with the Sales strategy.
•    Provide visibility on Sales activities, providing accurate monthly forecast and ensuring maintenance of Salesforce.com with all new account, opportunity, contact and adhere to the current defined Sales processes.


Profile:

We're looking for someone with:
–    a demonstrated Sales aptitude in complex Sales cycle and excellent closing skills;
–    a strong Sales background in business, financials, payroll, HCM & Saas products/services;
–    a deep understanding of the needs/challenges of the Swiss market;
–    an ability to develop their ecosystem;
–    an entrepreneurial mindset.


Experience :

We are looking for a enthusiastic candidate who can bring in:
•    Must-Have: 5-10 years of Sales experience in the Swiss market, within the HCM, payroll industry and vendors, large technology companies, partners, preferred in the environment of Global Enterprise Sales;
•    Fluent in French, German & English;
•    Proven proficiency in "Account Plan" development and implementation of related complex sales strategies to secure large Accounts;
•    Experienced in new business closure at international level with C-level interactions;
•    Driven by success, results and overachieving;
•    Excellent communication skills, personal integrity and positive attitude;
•    Knows how to act within an international matrix organization. 


What we can offer:

•    Highly competitive salary and benefit package (engaging accelerators once you reached 100% Sales quota) and car allowance.
•    Guaranteed bonus within the first months, to cover your tailored training.
•    Coaching and mentorship program to help you progress your career (opportunity to join our LDP -- Leadership Development Program in the U.S)
•    Opportunity to qualify for our legendary Superstars Club & Presidents Club in Exotic Destinations.

title: OT Integration Delivery Lead
description:
Location: Basel, Switzerland (project scope includes Portsmouth, UK)  
Contract Duration: Until 31 October 2027  

Lead OT integration delivery for a large\-scale manufacturing data platform, connecting automation systems with secure, scalable data

OT Integration Delivery Lead

Job description:

We are looking for an experienced OT Integration Delivery Lead to oversee the delivery of operational technology integrations and plant\-side applications as part of a strategic Operations Data Hub (ODH) programme.

In this role, you will lead a dedicated technical workstream, collaborating with automation teams, IT stakeholders, engineering partners and external vendors to deliver secure, scalable and maintainable manufacturing integrations.

Your key responsibilities will include:

* Lead the design, configuration, development, testing and deployment of OT integrations across DeltaV, Syncade MES, PI Historian and laboratory systems.
* Configure and develop integration services using Ignition, HiveMQ, MQTT, industrial gateways and connectors.
* Define interface specifications, message structures, data mappings and transformations for manufacturing information, including batch, equipment, material and quality data.
* Coordinate the delivery of plant\-side operational applications and visualisation solutions.
* Collaborate with architecture, semantic modelling and source\-system teams to ensure consistent and traceable manufacturing data integration.
* Assess existing OT connectivity, integration capabilities and technical constraints across manufacturing systems.
* Develop reusable integration blueprints, engineering standards and implementation patterns for future deployments.
* Apply secure development, version control, testing, release management and monitoring practices appropriate for regulated OT environments.
* Prepare technical specifications and test evidence, supporting CSV/C\&Q activities, hypercare and operational handover.
* Manage technical delivery against agreed project scope, timelines, resources, quality standards and budgets.
* Coordinate external technology providers, system integrators and equipment vendors, ensuring delivery quality and technical compliance.


About the customer:

Location: Basel, Switzerland (project scope includes Portsmouth, UK) Contract Duration: Until 31 October 2027

Job One\-Liner

Lead OT integration delivery for a large\-scale manufacturing data platform, connecting automation systems with secure, scalable data solutions.

Requirements:

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Control Systems, Software Engineering or a related technical discipline.
* Proven experience delivering production\-grade OT integrations in industrial or manufacturing environments.
* Hands\-on experience with Ignition, MQTT, HiveMQ, industrial gateways and message brokers.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing automation systems, including DCS, MES, historians and industrial data platforms.
* Knowledge of ISA\-88, ISA\-95, OT/IT architecture and manufacturing data contextualisation.
* Experience designing APIs, industrial connectors, data interfaces, message models and reusable integration architectures.
* Familiarity with secure deployments, DevSecOps, cybersecurity, version control and change management.
* Understanding of GMP, CSV/CSA and data integrity requirements in regulated environments.
* Proven ability to coordinate technical teams, vendors and external integration partners.
* Strong troubleshooting, stakeholder management and technical delivery skills.
* Business\-fluent English.


Nice to have:

* Advanced experience with DeltaV, Syncade MES and AVEVA PI.
* Previous experience delivering OT integration programmes within pharmaceutical or biotechnology manufacturing.
* Experience supporting validation, qualification and regulatory compliance activities.
* Knowledge of reusable integration architectures for multi\-site manufacturing deployments.

title: Cloud Operations Lead (m/f) 80–100%
description:
AutoForm offers software solutions for sheet metal forming and BiW assembly process. With over 500 employees dedicated to this field, AutoForm is recognized as the leading provider of software for product manufacturability, tool and material cost calculation, die face design and virtual stamping as well as BiW assembly process optimization. All of the Top 20 automotive OEMs and most of their suppliers have selected AutoForm as their software of choice. Besides its headquarters in Switzerland, AutoForm has offices in Germany, The Netherlands, France, Spain, Italy, Czech Republic, Sweden, USA, Mexico, Brazil, India, China, Japan and Korea.

Following the launch of our first real cloud product, we are creating a new key role to lead and coordinate AutoForm’s global cloud operations, based in Zurich.

**Cloud Operations Lead (m/f) 80–100%**

As Cloud Operations Lead, you will:

* Coordinate the deployment and operations of AutoForm’s cloud offerings across the portfolio
* Define our commitments for each cloud product by specifying responsibilities, service levels, and cost structure
* Report directly to the Head of R\&D and work closely with the Executive Committee on cloud strategy, risk, and security priorities
* Be the single point of accountability for cloud service readiness: security, reliability, compliance, and cost transparency
* Define and enforce cloud standards, policies, and operating procedures across all involved teams and partners and ensure they are applied consistently
* Align Development, IT, Product Management and external partners to deliver stable and secure cloud products
* Lead incident response, vulnerability management, and disaster recovery planning for cloud environments


**Your Responsibilities**

* Establish and run the cloud operating model including ownership, escalation paths, runbooks, and partner collaboration
* Govern identity and access management
* Maintain a secure and auditable AWS multi\-account foundation
* Coordinate security operations across the involved organizations with the authority and accountability to set standards and drive remediation
* Ensure compliance and audit readiness
* Ensure disaster recovery readiness
* Define and improve observability standards and service level objectives
* Drive cost and capacity management
* Manage and steer external partners


**Your Profile**

* Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a closely related field
* Several years of experience in cloud operations, platform operations, or cloud security governance
* Strong AWS knowledge, able to set standards, challenge decisions, and drive quality, even if you’re not the primary implementer
* Proven ability to lead through coordination and influence across teams and stakeholders
* Confident communication with executive stakeholders on risk, priorities, trade\-offs, and status
* Experience with other cloud providers is a plus, including Azure/GCP and Chinese providers such as Alibaba Cloud or Tencent Cloud
* Certifications are a plus: AWS DevOps Engineer, AWS Security Specialty, CISSP/CISM/CCSP, ITIL
* Fluent in English; German is a plus


**Our offer**

* A challenging role in a respectful and global working environment


* Being part of a world\-leading, high\-end CAE software company


* Working on cutting edge technologies for the automotive industry


* Professional development and continuous education


* Excellent balance between your working life and your private life through flexible working hours


Start of work is as soon as note that we only consider applicants that have the legal right to work in the respective location. We will only consider direct applications.

Lead end\-to\-end computerised system validation and qualification for an innovative manufacturing data pl

E2E CSV/C\&Q Lead

Job description:

We are seeking an experienced E2E CSV/C\&Q Lead to take ownership of the end\-to\-end validation and qualification strategy for a strategic Operations Data Hub (ODH) programme.

The position covers integrated manufacturing systems, IT/OT interfaces, infrastructure, semantic data models, data products and operational applications. You will collaborate with Engineering, Automation, Quality, IT/OT and business stakeholders to ensure that solutions meet regulatory, quality and data integrity requirements.

Your key responsibilities will include:

* Define, implement and maintain an integrated, risk\-based Computerised System Validation (CSV) and Commissioning \& Qualification (C\&Q) strategy.
* Establish validation boundaries, intended use, GxP classifications and appropriate controls across the manufacturing data platform.
* Develop modular qualification frameworks, documentation standards and reusable validation approaches for future implementations.
* Coordinate end\-to\-end validation execution, including requirements traceability, testing, documentation and release readiness.
* Define validation approaches for operational applications supporting batch traceability, process monitoring and customer data sharing.
* Evaluate data integrity, data lineage, interoperability and auditability across integrated manufacturing systems.
* Ensure alignment with ALCOA\+ principles and relevant GMP requirements.
* Prepare and coordinate validation documentation for independent Quality review and approval.
* Define supplier assurance strategies, including the use of vendor testing and previously qualified components.
* Ensure that validated\-state maintenance requirements are incorporated into operational support processes.
* Develop qualification templates, implementation prerequisites and resource, cost and timeline estimates for future site rollouts.
* Facilitate cross\-functional risk assessments, manage validation dependencies and escalate programme\-level compliance risks.
* Support release readiness assessments and coordinate with business and Quality stakeholders throughout implementation.


About the customer:

Our client is an internationally established organisation within the pharmaceutical and biotechnology sector, specialising in complex, highly regulated manufacturing operations. As part of its digital transformation initiatives, the organisation is implementing advanced manufacturing data solutions to improve connectivity, traceability and operational efficiency across production environments.

Requirements:

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Automation, Computer Science, IT, Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Quality Management or a related discipline.
* Proven experience leading end\-to\-end CSV/C\&Q activities for integrated IT/OT systems, manufacturing data platforms or regulated operational applications.
* Strong understanding of GMP, CSV/CSA, Commissioning \& Qualification and risk\-based validation methodologies.
* Practical experience managing change control, deviations, CAPA and maintenance of the validated state.
* Solid expertise in validation documentation, requirements traceability, testing strategies and supplier assurance.
* Strong understanding of data integrity principles, including ALCOA\+.
* Knowledge of manufacturing automation environments, MES, historians, system interfaces, infrastructure and data transformations.
* Experience collaborating with Quality, Engineering, Automation, IT/OT and external suppliers.
* Ability to develop pragmatic, risk\-based validation strategies while maintaining regulatory compliance.
* Strong coordination, communication, stakeholder management and problem\-solving skills.
* Business\-fluent English.
Nice to Have

* Previous validation leadership experience within pharmaceutical or biotechnology manufacturing.
* Experience with enterprise\-wide manufacturing data integration or digitalisation initiatives.
* Familiarity with ISA\-95 architecture and complex manufacturing data flows.
* Experience developing reusable qualification frameworks for multi\-site deployments.
* Exposure to validation of data platforms, semantic data models and manufacturing analytics applications.

title: Embedded Software Engineer
description:
**Role Overview**

As Embedded Software Engineer you write the software that runs the bike: The firmware of its control units and the embedded Linux platform behind its connected features.

You have the opportunity to take a product through its entire life, from the very first power\-on on the lab

bench, through test rides on the bike, to the production line and beyond.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Embedded Software for the Bike**

* Turn system requirements into embedded software designs and help build a robust architecture across the bike’s control units
* Implement system\-level functions in C/C\+\+
* Build the foundations of a connected, always\-online bike: Low\-power modes and wake\-up, secure over\-the\-air updates, Bluetooth links to phone and more


**Bring\-up, Integration \& Debugging**

* Bring up new boards and component from first power\-on in the lab to the complete bike
* Integrate supplier systems such as drive unit, battery and others over CAN and validate their interfaces
* Track down faults across software, electronics and wiring


**Quality \& Testing**

* Keep the codebase maintainable through reviews, refactoring, unit tests and documentation
* Automate firmware integration tests on test benches and hardware\-in\-the\-loop setups
* Support validation, EMC and homologation testing


**Path to Production**

* Develop test scripts, end\-of\-line tests and flashing for series production
* Support our manufacturing partner during production ramp\-up


**Working Across Teams**

* Work hand in hand with hardware, system engineering, app and backend teams
* Collaborate with development partners and suppliers


**Profile \& Experience**

**Qualification**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering or similar
* At least five years of hands\-on embedded development in C/C\+\+, ideally in automotive, e\-mobility or other series\-produced products


**Experience**

* Experience building distributed systems with multiple microcontrollers and low power designs
* Solid knowledge of embedded Linux and of real\-time operating systems such as Zephyr
* Comfortable at the lab bench, whether reading schematics, debugging with an oscilloscope and logic analyzer, or picking up the soldering iron
* A plus: CAN, Bluetooth, Wi\-Fi, cellular and GNSS, secure boot, bootloader


**Mindset**

* Takes initiative and drives topics to a solution
* Enjoys working in interdisciplinary teams
* Thrives in fast\-moving, early\-stage product development
* Enjoys finding root causes in complex interdisciplinary systems


**What Makes This Role Unique**

Central role connecting quality, testing, and engineering across the entire product.

Opportunity to shape quality, validation, and problem\-solving processes from the ground up.

Broad exposure across mechanical, electrical, software, connectivity and system integration – rather than ownership of a single component.

High impact on product reliability, compliance, and launch readiness.

A hands\-on role where you will work directly with prototypes and real product issues, not just manage processes from a distance.

**What We Offer**

* The opportunity to shape a pioneering premium e\-bike brand from the ground up.
* Collaboration with world\-class innovators, engineers, designers, and partners.
* Competitive compensation package, including performance\-based incentives, value sharing
* A culture built on passion, performance, and innovation
* Opportunity to build something truly new in mobility
* Join a highly ambitious international team
* Modern working location in Bern

Global Head of Regulatory Strategy
==================================

**The Opportunity**


NonStop Consulting is partnering with an established international pharmaceutical organisation to appoint a Global Head of Regulatory Strategy.

This is a high\-impact senior leadership opportunity for an accomplished Regulatory Affairs executive to shape and drive global regulatory strategy across an international pharmaceutical portfolio.

The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in defining regulatory direction, influencing critical development and commercial decisions, and ensuring the successful execution of regulatory strategies across key international markets.

In this senior leadership position, you will combine strategic oversight with hands\-on leadership, guiding an experienced international team and collaborating closely with key cross\-functional stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities
--------------------

* Global Regulatory Strategy: Define, lead and execute comprehensive regulatory strategies across multiple assets, from clinical development through registration, commercialisation and lifecycle management.
* Strategic Leadership: Provide senior\-level regulatory guidance to global development teams, ensuring regulatory considerations are embedded in key portfolio and business decisions.
* Regulatory Authority Engagement: Oversee high\-level interactions and negotiations with major international health authorities, including the FDA, EMA, PMDA and other relevant regulatory bodies.
* Global Team Leadership: Lead, develop and mentor an international team of senior regulatory professionals, fostering accountability, collaboration and high performance.
* Portfolio Oversight: Direct regulatory strategy and execution across key markets, including the US, Europe and selected international territories.
* Executive Collaboration: Contribute to global regulatory leadership decisions, resource allocation, risk management and long\-term functional strategy.
* Business Development Support: Provide strategic regulatory input into due diligence activities, potential licensing opportunities and portfolio assessments.
* Operational Excellence: continuous improvement, innovation and the responsible adoption of new technologies to enhance regulatory effectiveness.
* Cross\-Functional Partnership: Collaborate closely with Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, Quality, Commercial and other global functions to support business objectives.


**Your Profile**
----------------


We are seeking an experienced, commercially aware and strategically minded Regulatory Affairs leader with the credibility to operate at the highest levels of an international pharmaceutical organisation.


**Essential experience and qualification**s:

* Extensive experience in Regulatory Affairs within the pharmaceutical industry.
* Significant leadership and organisational management experience, ideally within an international regulatory function.
* Proven experience defining and delivering global regulatory strategies across complex pharmaceutical portfolios.
* Extensive experience engaging with major regulatory authorities, particularly the FDA and EMA, with broader international regulatory exposure.
* Strong understanding of global drug development, registration, commercialisation and product lifecycle management.
* Demonstrated ability to build, lead and develop international teams, including senior regulatory leaders.
* Excellent stakeholder management, influencing and negotiation skills, with experience contributing to executive\-level decision\-making.
* Strong strategic judgement, regulatory risk management capabilities and the ability to navigate complex development challenges.
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant scientific discipline required; PharmD, PhD or equivalent advanced qualification preferred.
* Fluency in English.
* Experience with specialised therapies, complex development programmes or niche therapeutic areas would be advantageous


Why Consider This Opportunity?
------------------------------

* Executive\-level influence: Play a key role in shaping global regulatory strategy and contributing to high\-level business decisions.
* International scope: Take ownership of regulatory strategy across multiple markets and a diverse pharmaceutical portfolio.
* Leadership impact: Lead and develop an established team of experienced regulatory professionals.
* Strategic visibility: Work closely with senior leadership and influence the direction of a global regulatory function.
* Innovation and transformation: Drive continuous improvement and contribute to the evolution of regulatory strategy and operational excellence.
* Meaningful impact: Support the development and successful commercialisation of innovative therapies for patients worldwide.


Confidential Application Process
--------------------------------


This search is being managed on a strictly confidential basis by NonStop Consulting.  
Further details regarding the organisation, leadership structure and strategic priorities will be shared with suitably qualified candidates during a confidential discussion.

Chez move im, on ne gère pas « des dossiers », on accompagne des personnes et des immeubles. Si tu aimes que les choses soient carrées (et les locataires bien logés), on doit se parler.

**Ta mission, si tu l’acceptes**

Assurer, sous la supervision du Directeur d’agence, la gestion administrative, locative, technique et financière d’un parc immobilier composé de bâtiments résidentiels, mixtes et commerciaux.

**Tes tâches, en un coup d’œil**

* Participer aux conseils que nous donnons aux propriétaires, avec professionnalisme, exactitude et assurance ;
* Rédiger des baux à loyers solides et irréprochables ;
* Gérer les résiliations et toutes les démarches administratives associées, avec efficacité ;
* Créer les annonces, tenir les visites et relouer les objets, comme un metteur en scène. Objectif relocation : 100 % – Objectif vacance : 0 %, parce qu’un bien vide, c’est une offense à tes compétences ;
* Réaliser les états des lieux d’entrée et de sortie, sans trembler (formation possible) ;
* Établir et suivre les décomptes finaux avec précision ;
* Commander et suivre les travaux courants via le logiciel de gérance ;
* Piloter les travaux extraordinaires (rénovations, transformations, ou autres aventures immobilières) avec le même sérieux et toujours sous la supervision du Directeur d’agence ;
* Refacturer les travaux aux locataires avec diplomatie et bienveillance ;
* Gérer les sinistres comme un·e pompier·ère du quotidien : réactif·ve, calme et toujours orienté·e solution ;
* Rédiger la correspondance, scanner et classer les documents selon les règles internes (et parfois, selon ton instinct, car ici le mot d’ordre c’est « adapter » et non « adopter ») ;
* Participer à l’administration de nos PPE en assistant l’administrateur/trice, dans le but de varier les plaisirs et d’entretenir ta polyvalence, en ajoutant un petit challenge ;
* Être le point de contact de tout ce petit monde : locataires, concierges, maîtres d’état, copropriétaires et propriétaires — conforter les positions de nos clients, instaurer la paix dans les relations, enfin, sécuriser le portefeuille.


**Ton profil**

* Tu as déjà une belle expérience en gérance immobilière (résidentiel, commercial, ou les deux, d’ailleurs, pourquoi choisir …) ;
* Les outils digitaux ne te font pas peur : tu cliques, tu gères, tu maîtrises ;
* Tu es autonome et entreprenant·e, du type à ne pas attendre qu’on te dise qu’une ampoule est grillée pour t’apercevoir qu’il fait nuit ;
* Tu combines sens du service, rigueur et organisation, tout en restant humain·e, diplomate et plutôt sympa ;
* Tu parles français couramment (heureusement), et si tu maîtrises une autre langue — surtout l’anglais — That’s applause\-worthy in our book ;
* Tu es un·e joueur·euse d’équipe, à la fois bienveillant·e, communicatif·ve, organisé·e.

The British Embassy in Berne is part of a world\-wide network representing British political, economic and consular interests. We are recruiting a Corporate Services Intern.



Corporate Services Intern
=========================







The British Government is an inclusive and diversity\-friendly employer. We value difference, promote equality and challenge discrimination, enhancing our organisational capability. We welcome and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds. We do not discriminate on the basis of disability, race, colour, ethnicity, gender identity, religion, sexual orientation, age, veteran status or other category protected by law. We promote family\-friendly flexible working opportunities, where operational and security needs allow. The FCDO operates an agile workforce and to facilitate this, you may be required to undertake other duties from time to time, as we may reasonably require.









**Main purpose of job:**





The Corporate Services Intern at the British Embassy in Berne provides hands\-on office management and administrative support to the Corporate Services team, with a particular focus on invoice processing, financial administration systems, and general office administration. The role is central to processing supplier invoices and payments, maintaining ERP and financial systems and trackers, and supporting procurement\-to\-pay processes, HR administration, logistics for arrivals and departures, and inventory management. The internship offers a practical grounding in business administration and office management, and is best suited to candidates with a genuine interest in finance, systems and administrative processes.



**Roles and responsibilities:**



* Process supplier and contractor invoices end\-to\-end, including checking accuracy against purchase orders/contracts, entering and tracking payments on internal finance systems, resolving queries, ensuring payments are made accurately and on time, and resolving issues with payment processes or records.
* Act as first point of contact for office administration, HR and finance queries; log and redirect requests using internal tracking systems; signpost to guidance and escalate where needed.
* Information management for Corporate Services, including internal management systems and online guidance, sharing and maintaining information on local Sharepoint pages.
* management of IT/facilities items; support periodic stock checks and flag discrepancies; provide first line IT support where required.
* Support budget administration by maintaining finance system records, and helping compile routine inputs for invoice reconciliation, charging instructions, and cash accounting and reporting.
* Support contract/supplier administration and procurement by maintaining registers, tracking renewal dates, collating quotes and preparing simple summaries.
* Undertake other reasonable duties as required in line with the FCDO’s agile workforce approach.



**Essential qualifications, skills and experience**





* Full professional proficiency in English (written and spoken, minimum of C1 level for CEFR\*);
* Strong interest in business administration, office management, human resources or finance operations, and enthusiasm for developing invoice\-processing and systems administration skills.
* Strong organisational skills and attention to detail; ability to prioritise tasks and meet deadlines.
* Strong IT and numeracy skills (e.g. Sharepoint, Outlook, Excel) and willingness to learn new systems quickly.
* Confidence handling invoices, figures, administrative/financial systems, and supplier relationships.
* Professional communication skills, with a helpful, customer\-focused approach.
* Problem\-solving mentality with a readiness to take ownership of end\-to\-end processes.
* Ability to handle information sensitively and maintain confidentiality.



**Desirable qualifications, skills and experience**





* Additional language skills ( and/or French);
* Any prior exposure to invoice processing, bookkeeping, finance administration, or office management environments (paid, unpaid, academic or placement\-based).
* Degree or Certified qualification in Office Management, Business Administration, Finance, HR or related field.



Working hours per week: 40



Monthly allowance: CHF 2,190



Preferred start date: 14 December 2026







**Other benefits and conditions of employment:**





This is a full\-time, 6 months internship contract of 40 hours per week inclusive of four compulsory 45\-minute lunch breaks.



Embassy opening hours are 0730 – 1830 hrs (Monday – Thursday) and 0730 – 1330 hrs (Friday).



The annual leave entitlement is 25 days per year, and the Embassy also enjoys 13 Swiss/ UK public holidays per year. These are prorated.



The successful candidate will be subject to professional background and security clearances before a contract is offered.



FCDO is committed to continual learning and development. The Embassy will provide funding in line with L\&D requirements, and a variety of learning and development is provided throughout the year both directly at post and virtually through the FCDO International Academy. There will be opportunities to attend training, lectures etc. on the job.



Visa/work permit requirements: The successful candidate must have pre\-existing work authorisation for Switzerland in order to apply. All applicants should have the right to live and work in Switzerland.



**Equal employment:**



We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity. We particularly encourage applications from candidates with protected characteristics. FCDO want to maximise the potential of everyone who chooses to work for us, regardless of their background.



**Additional information:**





Please note that the deadline for applications is 23:55 on the day mentioned in the above field “Application deadline”.



We advise you to allow enough time to complete and submit your full application, since only applications completed and submitted before the deadline will be considered.



Please be aware that the deadline for submitting applications is considered to be the time zone for the country where the vacancy has arisen.



The British Diplomatic Missions will not be able to meet the travel costs incurred when travelling to the interview, nor the costs connected with relocation if offered a job.

Project Quality Manager (m/w/d)
===============================

As Project Quality Manager, you will lead the quality function on complex, large\-scale construction projects, ensuring the highest standards of compliance, execution, and continuous improvement throughout the project lifecycle. Managing a dedicated quality team, you will drive a strong quality culture, oversee QA/QC processes, and work closely with project stakeholders to deliver successful project outcomes in a fast\-paced environment.

Project Quality Manager (m/w/d)
===============================

Our client is a well\-established international company based in Zurich, delivering complex technical projects across a variety of industries.

The organisation offers an innovative and collaborative environment where employees can contribute to large\-scale developments while benefiting from excellent long\-term career opportunities.

**Description**

* Develop, implement, and maintain project\-specific quality strategies, procedures, and control systems.
* Lead and mentor the site quality team, fostering a strong culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
* Promote a "Right First Time" mindset across all project stakeholders.
* Establish, monitor, and report key quality metrics and performance indicators.
* Analyze quality trends, identify recurring issues, and implement sustainable corrective actions.
* Ensure quality management systems and project documentation remain accurate, accessible, and compliant.
* Coordinate inspections, testing activities, commissioning readiness, and project handovers.
* Collaborate with package managers and project teams to ensure quality requirements are integrated throughout the construction process.
* Support planning activities by proactively identifying risks, constraints, and improvement opportunities.
* Work closely with cross\-functional teams including Construction, Engineering, HSE, Planning, and Commissioning.
* Contribute to Construction and operational excellence initiatives across the project.
* Ensure the highest standards of workplace safety while promoting a 0\-incident culture.




**Profile**

* Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Quality Management, or a related technical discipline.
* Minimum 10 years of experience within quality management on large\-scale construction, engineering, industrial, data centre, or infrastructure projects.
* Proven track record of successfully leading quality teams on complex projects.
* Strong understanding of QA/QC processes, construction methodologies, commissioning activities, and project delivery.
* Experience developing quality systems, reporting frameworks, and performance metrics.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Strong leadership capabilities with the ability to motivate teams and drive accountability.
* Strategic thinker with the ability to balance long\-term objectives and day\-to\-day project delivery.
* Proficient in common project management, reporting, and document management tools.
* Fluent in English; additional European languages are considered an advantage.
* Hands\-on, delivery\-focused mindset with the willingness to go the extra mile in fast\-paced project environments.


### Nice to Have

* Professional certifications in Quality Management, Construction Management, or Project Management.
* Six Sigma Belt (or higher).
* PMP certification or equivalent project management qualification.
* Membership of relevant professional engineering or quality organizations.

**Offer**

* Private health insurance contribution up to CHF 300/month

* Temporary accommodation available when relocating

**The Perfect Candidate:**The ideal candidate is a dual\-threat product leader with at least 5 years of Martech experience, bridging long\-term marketing strategy with hands\-on Agile sprint execution. They combine deep technical literacy\-from API architecture to GDPR compliance\-with sharp business acumen to drive measurable ROI. As the sole point of accountability, they seamlessly manage backlogs, refine user stories, and ensure high\-velocity, high\-quality development cycles. Fluent in English, they excel at translating complex technical requirements into strategic value for engineering and business stakeholders alike..

This hybrid role is responsible for the entire product lifecycle\-from defining the long\-term vision and market strategy ("The What") to leading the tactical execution and sprint delivery ("The How"). title: Mission de 2 mois - Analyste KYC / AML – Revues périodiques High Risk & Medium Risk
description:
**Objectif de la mission**

Renforcer l’équipe chargée des revues périodiques des clients classés à risque élevé et moyen. Assurer la mise à jour des dossiers, documenter les analyses et préparer les recommandations pour validation, conformément aux procédures internes et au cadre réglementaire suisse applicable.

**Responsabilités principales**

* Réaliser les revues KYC du portefeuille attribué et suivre les échéances prévues en novembre et décembre.
* Vérifier l’identité des clients, les ayants droit économiques, les structures de détention et la validité des pièces justificatives.
* Actualiser le profil client : activité professionnelle, situation patrimoniale, origine de la fortune (*Source of Wealth*) et origine des fonds (*Source of Funds*).
* Examiner la cohérence des transactions avec le profil et l’activité attendue du client.
* Effectuer ou actualiser les contrôles relatifs aux personnes politiquement exposées (PEP), aux sanctions et aux informations défavorables, puis analyser les résultats pertinents.
* Réévaluer la classification du risque et documenter toute proposition de modification.
* Obtenir les informations manquantes auprès des gestionnaires de relation et assurer le suivi des demandes.
* Rédiger une conclusion motivée et soumettre les dossiers aux instances de validation compétentes.
* Escalader les anomalies et les situations sensibles à Compliance selon les procédures internes.


**Approche selon le niveau de risque**

* **High Risk :** conduire une analyse approfondie des facteurs de risque, de l’origine de la fortune et des fonds, des structures complexes et des opérations inhabituelles ; documenter les clarifications complémentaires et préparer les validations requises.
* **Medium Risk :** réaliser une revue proportionnée aux risques identifiés, actualiser les informations et justificatifs, et signaler tout élément justifiant un examen renforcé ou une reclassification.


**Profil recherché**

* Expérience confirmée en KYC, AML ou revues périodiques, idéalement en banque privée suisse.
* Bonne connaissance du cadre suisse de lutte contre le blanchiment d’argent et des obligations de diligence bancaire.
* Capacité à analyser des patrimoines internationaux et des structures de détention complexes.
* Excellentes capacités rédactionnelles, rigueur et jugement analytique.
* Autonomie, respect de la confidentialité et aptitude à travailler dans des délais courts.
* Français et anglais professionnels
* Disponibilité durant novembre et décembre 2026\.

description:

ALBEDIS est un partenaire de recrutement suisse de premier plan, spécialisé dans la mise en relation entre talents et entreprises à travers un large éventail de secteurs, des postes de support jusqu'aux fonctions de direction. Membre d'Interiman Group, ALBEDIS s'appuie sur l'expertise combinée de ses marques partenaires pour couvrir des domaines tels que l'architecture et l'immobilier, la finance, l'IT, les sciences de la vie, le juridique ou encore les ressources humaines, avec une présence dans toute la Suisse (Berne, Genève, Lausanne, Zurich).

Responsable Systèmes ERP Finance \- 100%
=========================================

Description de l'entreprise
---------------------------

Pour le compte d'une entreprise internationale établie en Suisse romande, nous recherchons un(e) **Responsable Systèmes ERP Finance** pour prendre en charge et faire évoluer l'environnement applicatif Finance.

Au sein d'un environnement dynamique et en pleine évolution, vous jouerez un rôle d'interface entre les équipes Finance, IT, les utilisateurs métiers et les partenaires externes. Vous serez notamment responsable de la fiabilité, de l'évolution et de l'optimisation des systèmes financiers, avec un rôle central sur l'environnement SAP.

Description du poste
--------------------

**Vos responsabilités**

* Assurer la gestion, l'évolution et l'optimisation de l'environnement ERP Finance.
* Piloter les évolutions, projets, mises à jour et déploiements liés aux systèmes financiers, de l'analyse du besoin jusqu'à la mise en production.
* Garantir l'intégrité et la cohérence des données financières ainsi que des interfaces avec les systèmes Sales, CRM et Logistique.
* Administrer et faire évoluer les processus Finance et Controlling dans SAP, notamment sur les domaines **General Ledger, Accounts Payable/Receivable, immobilisations, centres de coûts et centres de profit**.
* Gérer les référentiels financiers, les données de référence et les activités de paramétrage SAP.
* Participer aux activités de clôture et aux contrôles de cohérence entre les différents systèmes.
* Analyser et résoudre les problématiques complexes rencontrées par les utilisateurs Finance et assurer un support fonctionnel de niveau avancé.
* Coordonner les activités avec les équipes IT, les métiers et les intégrateurs ou partenaires externes.
* Participer aux projets de transformation de l'ERP, notamment dans le cadre de l'évolution vers **SAP S/4HANA** et/ou d'une future transformation de la plateforme ERP.
* Contribuer à la définition de la roadmap, au pilotage des projets et à la coordination des différentes parties prenantes.
* Accompagner les changements, assurer la documentation et la formation des utilisateurs.
* Garantir le respect des exigences de sécurité, de contrôle interne, d'audit et de conformité.
* Identifier les opportunités de digitalisation, d'automatisation et d'utilisation de nouvelles technologies, notamment l'IA, pour améliorer les processus Finance.

Profil recherché
-----------------

**Votre profil**

* Formation supérieure en informatique, finance, gestion ou domaine équivalent.
* **5 à 10 ans d'expérience dans des environnements SAP**, idéalement au sein d'entreprises internationales, à forte volumétrie ou au sein d'un big four.
* Excellente maîtrise de **SAP Finance / FI\-CO** et bonne compréhension des systèmes d'information financiers.
* Solide connaissance des processus **Finance, Accounting et Controlling**.
* Bonne compréhension des interactions entre les fonctions Finance, Sales, Supply Chain et Logistique.
* Expérience confirmée dans la gestion de projets SAP ou ERP.
* Une expérience dans un projet de **transformation ERP ou de migration vers S/4HANA** constitue un réel atout.
* Expérience dans la coordination d'intégrateurs, de consultants ou de partenaires externes.
* Bonnes connaissances du **paramétrage SAP et de la gestion des master data.**
* Excellentes capacités d'analyse, de résolution de problèmes et de gestion des priorités.
* Très bonne maîtrise d'Excel et aisance avec les outils digitaux.
* Français et anglais courants, domicilié à proximité (télétravail limité)

**Ce que nous vous proposons**

* Un rôle **transversal et à forte visibilité**, à l'interface entre Finance, IT et les métiers.
* Une fonction combinant **expertise SAP, gestion de projet et transformation des systèmes d'information**.
* La possibilité de contribuer à des projets ERP structurants et à l'évolution de l'environnement Finance.
* Un environnement international et dynamique.
* Une fonction offrant une réelle autonomie et une proximité avec les équipes dirigeantes Finance et IT.

title: Senior Group Life Underwriter
description:
Are you an experienced Group Insurance or Reinsurance underwriter, used to assessing complex cases across Life, Disability, Accident and Health?
In this role, you will join Zurich’s global Group Underwriting team, working with underwriting and pricing teams across multiple markets. A large part of the job is hands-on: reviewing referrals, understanding products and market standards, challenging pricing assumptions and helping local teams find solutions.


The business is varied and global in nature. Cases may involve Group Life, Disability, Accident, Health or other forms of Group Protection. Some will be large or technically complex. Others will involve special benefits, limited data, unusual guarantees or market-specific practices. Guided by results orientation and technical excellence, you will bring independent judgement and challenge while working with local teams to help our businesses grow profitably.



What you will do



Provide expert advice on complex Group underwriting referrals from markets across Zurich’s global portfolio assessing the overall risk, pricing, claims experience, terms and reinsurance considerations.
Work with local teams to challenge proposals where needed and develop practical solutions non-standard business opportunities.
Support the development and maintenance of Group underwriting philosophies, authorities, standards and technical guidance
Contribute to Technical Underwriting Reviews and other assurance activity, identifying weaknesses and agreeing practical improvements
Support selected product, proposition and pricing initiatives, share knowledge and help strengthen underwriting capability across local teams.




What you bring



Solid experience (8+ years) in group pricing and/or scheme underwriting within life, disability and health insurance or reinsurance; Actuarial training is an advantage
Broad exposure to different markets, products and propositions, with the ability to adapt to different cultures and business environments.
Deep understanding of group protection products and scheme underwriting principles, including the ability to make confident decisions in imperfect or challenging situations
Strong communication and influencing skills, able to explain technical decisions clearly, challenge constructively and work with local teams to find practical solutions.
Fluency in English; additional languages are an advantage




You belong here.




Imagine working in one of the world’s most sustainable workplaces. At Quai Zurich Campus, you’ll enjoy an environment designed to help you thrive, with benefits that support your well-being and impact, and opportunities to perform at your best, surrounded by top talent and supportive colleagues.  
You’ll have access to healthy food options, fitness facilities, and bright, collaborative spaces that spark creativity. Located in the heart of Zurich on the shores of Lake Zurich, the campus offers excellent public transportation links, making your commute simple.
Grow with us through access to learning resources, on-the-job development, and continuous empowerment and support. Be part of a team that is creating a brighter future together.



About Us




Zurich is a leading multi-line insurer, serving over 82 million customers in more than 200 countries and territories with more than 65,000 employees.
For over 150 years, Zurich has been transforming insurance – offering not just protection, but also prevention services that promote well-being and climate resilience.
Guided by our purpose to ‘create a brighter future together,’ we aim to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world.


We look forward to receiving your online application today!





Information for recruitment agencies


Zurich does not accept any applications from recruitment agencies for this position. We refuse any responsibility for unsolicited applications, as well as any associated fees.



Why Zurich



At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right?

We are an equal opportunity employer who knows that each employee is unique - that’s what makes our team so great!
Join us as we constantly explore new ways to protect our customers and the planet.

Architecte polyvalent (h/f)
===========================

**A propos de Jouan – de Rham** 

 

Jouan –de Rham est un groupe immobilier genevois actif dans l’architecture, le conseil, le pilotage de projets,

la gérance et les transactions.

Le groupe intervient principalement sur des projets résidentiels de qualité dans le canton de Genève et la région lémanique, pour une clientèle privée et institutionnelle exigeante.

En parallèle, Jouan\-de Rham développe une activité croissante dans les aménagements de bureaux

et projets commerciaux.

 

Son organisation structurée et multidisciplinaire permet d’accompagner ses clients sur l’ensemble du cycle immobilier.

 

Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous **recherchons un(e) architecte expérimenté(e)** capable d’intervenir de manière autonome sur des projets exigeants.

Ce poste offre une vision complète du projet architectural, de la phase d’étude, à la préparation de l’exécution et de son suivi.

* Développement d’avant\-projets et projets
* Coordination des mandataires spécialisés
* Préparation et suivi des demandes d’autorisation
* Élaboration des plans d’exécution
* Participation aux appels d’offres et analyses comparatives
* Coordination technique et suivi architectural des chantiers
* Relation directe avec les maîtres d’ouvrage
* Contribution aux projets d’aménagements de bureaux et fit\-out commerciaux


 

**Votre profil**

* Diplôme d’architecte EPF / HES ou équivalent
* 3 à 5 ans d’expérience en Suisse
* Expérience confirmée en projets résidentiels
* Intérêt ou expérience en aménagements de bureaux
* Maîtrise d’Archicad
* Bonne connaissance des normes SIA et des procédures administratives genevoises / vaudoise un plus
* Capacité à gérer plusieurs projets en parallèle
* Autonomie, rigueur et sens des responsabilités
* Nous recherchons un profil solide techniquement, structuré et fiable, souhaitant s’inscrire durablement dans une structure en croissance.


 

**Ce que nous offrons**

 

* Intégration au sein d’un groupe immobilier établi et en développement
* Projets variés et exigeants
* Environnement professionnel structuré au sein d’une équipe jeune et dynamique
* Collaboration directe avec la direction
* Perspectives d’évolution selon l’implication et les responsabilité




**Informations complémentaires**

* Taux d’activité : 100 %
* Contrat : durée déterminée (CDD) – remplacement pour congé maternité
* Lieu de travail : Genève
* Mobilité selon les projets (permis de conduire un plus)
* Début : à convenir


Durée : à préciser selon la période de remplacement

description:
Stellenangebot: Physiotherapeut (m/w/d) – Temporäre Einsätze in der Schweiz

Entdecke eine neue Freiheit: Deine Fachkompetenz als Physiotherapeut (m/w/d) im Schweizer Gesundheitswesen

Suchst Du nach dem Gefühl, beruflich endlich wieder durchzuatmen? Möchtest Du spüren, wie wertvoll Deine tägliche Arbeit geschätzt wird – und dabei die beeindruckende Natur der Schweiz erleben?

Manchmal spürt man ganz deutlich, dass der Moment für eine positive Veränderung gekommen ist. Ständige Hektik, Taktverdichtung und zu wenig Zeit für den einzelnen Menschen lassen oft den Blick dafür verlieren, warum Du diesen Beruf einmal mit so viel Leidenschaft gewählt hast.

Stell Dir vor, wie es sich anfühlt, wenn Du morgens mit einem Lächeln an Deinen Arbeitsplatz kommst. Du hast Zeit für Deine Patienten, arbeitest in modernst ausgestatteten Schweizer Spitälern, Rehakliniken oder Praxen und wirst für Deinen Einsatz exzellent vergütet. Nach Feierabend genießt Du das klare Panorama der Schweizer Alpen oder die Ruhe an kristallklaren Seen.

Genau diese Balance aus beruflicher Erfüllung, persönlicher Freiheit und finanzieller Wertschätzung wartet auf Dich.

Was diese Auszeit bzw. Neuorientierung für Dich bereitgestellt hat:

- Spürbare Entlastung & Flexibilität: Du bestimmst, wie lange und wo Du arbeiten möchtest. Ob 3, 6 oder 12 Monate – gestalte Deinen Lebenslauf genau so dynamisch, wie es zu Deiner aktuellen Lebensphase passt.
- Herausragende Schweizer Rahmenbedingungen: Erlebe moderne Therapiekonzepte, interdisziplinäre Teams auf Augenhöhe und Zeit für echte Behandlungsqualität.
- Attraktive finanzielle Wertschätzung: Profitiere von sehr guten Schweizer Gehaltsstrukturen, die Dir neue Freiräume eröffnen.
- Nahtlose Organisation & Begleitung: Wir halten Dir den Rücken frei. Von der Anerkennung Deines Diploms (SRK) über die Unterkunftssuche bis hin zu administrativen Fragen begleiten wir Dich persönlich, Schritt für Schritt.

Das bringst Du mit:

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium als Physiotherapeut (m/w/d).
- Erste Berufserfahrung ist wunderbar – genauso willkommen sind Neugierde und die Bereitschaft, neue Impulse in einem top organisierten Umfeld aufzunehmen.
- Freude an der Arbeit mit Menschen und die Fähigkeit, Empathie und Fachwissen harmonisch zu verbinden.
- Aufgeschlossenheit für den Schweizer Kultur- und Arbeitsraum.

Hörst Du den Ruf nach Deiner nächsten Veränderung?

Ganz gleich, ob Du temporär neue Erfahrungen sammeln möchtest oder den Schritt in die Schweiz als Sprungbrett für Deine Zukunft siehst: Du bist hier genau richtig.

Lass uns ganz unverbindlich darüber sprechen, wie Dein persönlicher Weg in die Schweiz aussehen kann.

In this senior leadership position, you will combine strategic oversight with hands\-on leadership, guiding an experienced international team and collaborating closely with key cross\-functional stakeholders.

--------------------

* Global Regulatory Strategy: Define, lead and execute comprehensive regulatory strategies across multiple assets, from clinical development through registration, commercialisation and lifecycle management.

* Regulatory Authority Engagement: Oversee high\-level interactions and negotiations with major international health authorities, including the FDA, EMA, PMDA and other relevant regulatory bodies.
* Global Team Leadership: Lead, develop and mentor an international team of senior regulatory professionals, fostering accountability, collaboration and high performance.

* Operational Excellence: continuous improvement, innovation and the responsible adoption of new technologies to enhance regulatory effectiveness.

We are seeking an experienced, commercially aware and strategically minded Regulatory Affairs leader with the credibility to operate at the highest levels of an international pharmaceutical organisation.

* Extensive experience in Regulatory Affairs within the pharmaceutical industry.
* Significant leadership and organisational management experience, ideally within an international regulatory function.
* Proven experience defining and delivering global regulatory strategies across complex pharmaceutical portfolios.
* Extensive experience engaging with major regulatory authorities, particularly the FDA and EMA, with broader international regulatory exposure.

Senior Patent Counsel
=====================



SICPA sets *the pulse of sovereignty*, enabling governments to protect their citizens, sovereign assets, and economies. Best known for securing the majority of the world’s banknotes, SICPA operates across five continents. Today, our platform for sovereignty delivers integrated solutions safeguarding revenue mobilisation, natural resources, health, and brand protection as well as digital sovereignty and secure public services.

The primary objective of this role is to ensure that technology identification, extraction and protection are aligned with the business activities in the field of chemistry. A strong understanding of the underlying technologies and their commercial applications is therefore essential to success in this position.



The in\-house Patent Attorney will act as a hands\-on partner to the business, advising on day\-to\-day business development opportunities and ensuring that new innovations are effectively identified and protected through patents. Working closely with the Research \& Innovation (R\&I) team and the IP department, the role will focus on innovation extraction, patent drafting and prosecution.



The role requires a proactive, collaborative approach, working across R\&I, Commercial and Legal teams to ensure that intellectual property protection supports the company's broader business objectives. The ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, concise messages and communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels is essential.



**Key responsibilities**

* Work closely with the Research \& Innovation team, harvest and capture innovation. Pro\-actively look for inventions and create and maintain awareness about use and necessity of patent applications.
* Contribute to the acquisition, protection, defence and enforcement (drafting, filing, prosecution, opposition, appeal, etc.) of patent rights; prosecution of a global patent portfolio in the assigned technical areas.
* Provide comprehensive patent support to selected projects as an integral member of multidisciplinary project teams.
* Formulate strategic practice recommendations in response to commercial, legal and technical developments, this includes evaluating patent validity, patent risk management and infringement issues and reviewing IP\-related agreements.

**Essential duties**

* Analysis of the innovation and potential inventions, drafting, filing of patent applications and worldwide prosecution; therefore, drafting skills are essential here and prosecution, opposition and infringement matters offer a wide variety of work.
* Liaise prior art search reports from external providers and assess feasibility and patentability.
* Draft IP related aspects of agreements with third\-party collaborators and service providers.
* Oversee patent risk management and provide Freedom to Operate opinion and clearance studies.
* Working closely with R\&I division, sales and legal and promote patent culture with good visibility within the company. The direct contact with international colleagues and clients will require commitment, passion, strong communication skills and commercial savviness.




**Profile**

* PhD (preferred) or master’s degree in chemistry.
* Be passionate about the technology you work with and follow the developments within the industry with invested interest.
* Qualified European Patent Attorney. Minimum 3 years of relevant work experience in drafting and prosecuting patent cases after EPA qualification.
* Proactive, structured with a collaborative working style with solid team player attributes with the ability to manage relationships with different stakeholders in the company.
* Possess strong communication and interpersonal skills to work with cross\-functional teams across departments and divisions.
* Show flexibility under stress and delivers quality work with strong attention to detail in an autonomous manner.
* Fluent in English, French a strong asset is a plus

The British Embassy in Berne is part of a world\-wide network representing British political, economic and consular interests. We are recruiting a Corporate Services Intern.



Corporate Services Intern
=========================







The British Government is an inclusive and diversity\-friendly employer. We value difference, promote equality and challenge discrimination, enhancing our organisational capability. We welcome and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds. We do not discriminate on the basis of disability, race, colour, ethnicity, gender identity, religion, sexual orientation, age, veteran status or other category protected by law. We promote family\-friendly flexible working opportunities, where operational and security needs allow. The FCDO operates an agile workforce and to facilitate this, you may be required to undertake other duties from time to time, as we may reasonably require.









**Main purpose of job:**





The Corporate Services Intern at the British Embassy in Berne provides hands\-on office management and administrative support to the Corporate Services team, with a particular focus on invoice processing, financial administration systems, and general office administration. The role is central to processing supplier invoices and payments, maintaining ERP and financial systems and trackers, and supporting procurement\-to\-pay processes, HR administration, logistics for arrivals and departures, and inventory management. The internship offers a practical grounding in business administration and office management, and is best suited to candidates with a genuine interest in finance, systems and administrative processes.



**Roles and responsibilities:**



* Process supplier and contractor invoices end\-to\-end, including checking accuracy against purchase orders/contracts, entering and tracking payments on internal finance systems, resolving queries, ensuring payments are made accurately and on time, and resolving issues with payment processes or records.
* Act as first point of contact for office administration, HR and finance queries; log and redirect requests using internal tracking systems; signpost to guidance and escalate where needed.
* Information management for Corporate Services, including internal management systems and online guidance, sharing and maintaining information on local Sharepoint pages.
* management of IT/facilities items; support periodic stock checks and flag discrepancies; provide first line IT support where required.
* Support budget administration by maintaining finance system records, and helping compile routine inputs for invoice reconciliation, charging instructions, and cash accounting and reporting.
* Support contract/supplier administration and procurement by maintaining registers, tracking renewal dates, collating quotes and preparing simple summaries.
* Undertake other reasonable duties as required in line with the FCDO’s agile workforce approach.



**Essential qualifications, skills and experience**





* Full professional proficiency in English (written and spoken, minimum of C1 level for CEFR\*);
* Strong interest in business administration, office management, human resources or finance operations, and enthusiasm for developing invoice\-processing and systems administration skills.
* Strong organisational skills and attention to detail; ability to prioritise tasks and meet deadlines.
* Strong IT and numeracy skills (e.g. Sharepoint, Outlook, Excel) and willingness to learn new systems quickly.
* Confidence handling invoices, figures, administrative/financial systems, and supplier relationships.
* Professional communication skills, with a helpful, customer\-focused approach.
* Problem\-solving mentality with a readiness to take ownership of end\-to\-end processes.
* Ability to handle information sensitively and maintain confidentiality.



**Desirable qualifications, skills and experience**





* Additional language skills ( and/or French);
* Any prior exposure to invoice processing, bookkeeping, finance administration, or office management environments (paid, unpaid, academic or placement\-based).
* Degree or Certified qualification in Office Management, Business Administration, Finance, HR or related field.



Working hours per week: 40



Monthly allowance: CHF 2,190

This is a full\-time, 6 months internship contract of 40 hours per week inclusive of four compulsory 45\-minute lunch breaks.

The annual leave entitlement is 25 days per year, and the Embassy also enjoys 13 Swiss/ UK public holidays per year. These are prorated.

Quality Engineer (m/f/d)
========================

As a Quality Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring and continuously improving quality standards across complex construction and engineering projects, supporting all quality\-related activities from project execution through to final handover. Working closely with project teams, suppliers, and subcontractors, you will conduct inspections and audits, manage quality documentation, and ensure compliance with technical specifications

Quality Engineer (m/f/d)
========================

Our client is a well\-established international company based in Zurich, delivering complex technical projects across a variety of industries.  

The organisation offers an innovative and collaborative environment where employees can contribute to large\-scale developments while benefiting from excellent long\-term career opportunities.

**Description**

* Promote and maintain a strong quality culture with a "Right First Time" mindset across all project phases.
* Support the Project Quality Manager in the implementation and execution of quality processes and standards.
* Ensure compliance with project\-specific quality management systems and procedures.
* Provide training and guidance to internal teams and subcontractors on quality requirements and digital quality tools.

* Review and maintain quality documentation, inspection records, and control registers.
* Track and assess supplier and subcontractor quality performance.
* Participate in project inspections, testing activities, witness points, and handover processes.
* Support the preparation and review of quality plans, method statements, and technical submissions.
* Produce quality reports and performance metrics for project stakeholders.




**Profile**

* Bachelor's degree or higher in Engineering (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or related disciplines).
* Previous experience in Quality Assurance or Quality Control within construction, infrastructure, industrial, or engineering environments.
* Experience working on complex, multidisciplinary projects is highly desirable.
* Strong ability to interpret technical drawings, specifications, and engineering documentation.
* Familiarity with quality management systems and digital document management platforms.
* Strong understanding of industry standards, codes, and quality assurance principles.
* Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Fluent in English; is considered a strong advantage.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office and common project management/document control systems.
* Entrepreneurial and delivery\-focused mindset with the drive to take ownership, solve problems proactively, and go the extra mile when required in high\-paced project environments.

title: Senior Group Life Underwriter
description:
Are you an experienced Group Insurance or Reinsurance underwriter, used to assessing complex cases across Life, Disability, Accident and Health?
In this role, you will join Zurich’s global Group Underwriting team, working with underwriting and pricing teams across multiple markets. A large part of the job is hands-on: reviewing referrals, understanding products and market standards, challenging pricing assumptions and helping local teams find solutions.


The business is varied and global in nature. Cases may involve Group Life, Disability, Accident, Health or other forms of Group Protection. Some will be large or technically complex. Others will involve special benefits, limited data, unusual guarantees or market-specific practices. Guided by results orientation and technical excellence, you will bring independent judgement and challenge while working with local teams to help our businesses grow profitably.



What you will do



Provide expert advice on complex Group underwriting referrals from markets across Zurich’s global portfolio assessing the overall risk, pricing, claims experience, terms and reinsurance considerations.
Work with local teams to challenge proposals where needed and develop practical solutions non-standard business opportunities.
Support the development and maintenance of Group underwriting philosophies, authorities, standards and technical guidance
Contribute to Technical Underwriting Reviews and other assurance activity, identifying weaknesses and agreeing practical improvements
Support selected product, proposition and pricing initiatives, share knowledge and help strengthen underwriting capability across local teams.




What you bring



Solid experience (8+ years) in group pricing and/or scheme underwriting within life, disability and health insurance or reinsurance; Actuarial training is an advantage
Broad exposure to different markets, products and propositions, with the ability to adapt to different cultures and business environments.
Deep understanding of group protection products and scheme underwriting principles, including the ability to make confident decisions in imperfect or challenging situations
Strong communication and influencing skills, able to explain technical decisions clearly, challenge constructively and work with local teams to find practical solutions.
Fluency in English; additional languages are an advantage

title: Advocacy Specialist: Treaty Bodies
description:
The Advocacy Specialist: Treaty Bodies reports to the Advocacy Senior Manager and is responsible for the day-to-day coordination and delivery of ILGA World’s Treaty Bodies portfolio within the Advocacy Programme.

Specific to this position, this includes:
Implement ILGA World’s Treaty Bodies advocacy workplan and coordinate the organisation’s day-to-day engagement with the UN human rights Treaty Body system, serving as the organisational focal point for Treaty Bodies-related advocacy.

Monitor Treaty Body sessions, reporting cycles, country reviews, lists of Issues Prior to Reporting (LOIPRs) under the Simplified Reporting Procedure, follow-up procedures, general comments, individual communications and other developments, identifying timely and strategic opportunities for SOGIESC advocacy.

Develop and implement advocacy strategies to advance the human rights of people and communities of diverse SOGIESC through country reviews, normative development, individual communications and other relevant Treaty Body procedures.

Provide technical assistance to ILGA World members, regions, LGBTI organisations and human rights defenders engaging with Treaty Bodies, including advocacy planning, reporting, preparation of written and oral submissions, briefings and follow up strategies.

Coordinate and contribute to ILGA World and joint submissions, shadow report inputs, briefing materials, statements, position papers and other advocacy products in consultation with affected communities, members, regions, partners, and external legal experts

Facilitate the meaningful participation of human rights defenders in Treaty Body processes, including organising briefings and engagement with Treaty Body members and OHCHR staff.

Coordinate ILGA World’s strategic litigation engagement before Treaty Bodies, including identifying appropriate opportunities, supporting individual communications and third-party interventions, and contributing to follow-up on decisions in collaboration with members, partners and relevant legal experts.

Monitor, systematise and analyse SOGIESC-related concluding observations, recommendations, general comments, jurisprudence, decisions and other Treaty Body outputs, and contribute to compilations, briefings and analytical resources.

Support ILGA World members and human rights defenders to use Treaty Body recommendations, decisions and jurisprudence in national advocacy, including follow up and implementation, and document relevant results, challenges and good practices.

Develop and deliver training, webinars, guidance and other capacity strengthening resources to strengthen civil society engagement with the Treaty Body system.

Build and maintain effective working relationships with Treaty Body members, OHCHR staff, civil society organisations, legal experts, academics and other relevant stakeholders, and represent ILGA World in relevant meetings, consultations and external spaces.

Monitor and contribute to discussions concerning Treaty Body strengthening, accessibility, effectiveness and other institutional developments affecting the system.

Work across ILGA World programmes and advocacy portfolios to strengthen coherence between Treaty Bodies, the Human Rights Council, Universal Periodic Review, Special Procedures and thematic advocacy, and ensure that relevant ILGA World research and monitoring data inform Treaty Body engagement.

Contribute to planning, budgeting, monitoring, evaluation and learning, donor reporting and funding proposals relating to the Treaty Bodies portfolio, and work with the Communications team to make relevant opportunities, developments and outcomes accessible to members, partners and wider audiences.

General
Actively contribute to promoting and achieving the organisation’s objectives.
Engage and collaborate with colleagues across the Advocacy Programme and other ILGA World teams to strengthen a shared organisational culture and ensure coordinated, movement-informed work.

Ensure that all activities are carried out with full regard to ILGA World policies.
Work as a part of the ILGA World staff team.

Perform other duties as required.

title: Launch Excellence Lead FA
description:
The Global Launch Excellence Lead is a senior individual contributor accountable for the end‑to‑end governance, readiness, and execution excellence supporting the global commercial launch of SKYCLARYS in adults & pediatrics in ~50 markets globally.

This role is accountable for leading cross-functional and cross-regional matrix teams to develop and execute robust launch plans, provide launch progress updates for leadership, build and enhance organizational capabilities for launch via new methods, tools; and maximize launch excellence know-how across teams to enhance and accelerate decision-making.

The Launch Excellence Lead will work closely with G10 markets to understand performance and underlying drivers & barriers of business results. He/she will track, review, & synthesize best practices, ensuring these are disseminated across regions/countries to drive excellence in execution.

In addition, the role leads the design and implementation of critical cross-functional initiatives – spanning external engagement (HCPs, patients, caregivers) and advanced insight generation, in collaboration with cross-functional partners – to strengthen launch impact and inform strategic decision-making. Importantly, this role will partner closely with the PDC, DAT & ITAC teams to ensure strong collaboration and decision-making across functions.

Principal Accountabilities:
- Collaborate as the primary Launch Excellence partner for the Global cross-functional FA teams across Regulatory, PO&T, Global Product Strategy and Commercialization, Development, and Global Medical Affairs guiding cross-functional teams through key planning milestones to deliver impactful launch plans
- Drive strategic and operational rigor in building and managing integrated launch plans including timelines, budgets, interdependencies and risks, that support product and company strategic objectives across multiple programs (SKY in adults & SKY in pediatrics)
- Track, review & synthesize best practices, ensuring these are disseminated across regions/countries to drive excellence in execution
- Act as an integrator for the functions, program teams (PDC, DAT & ITAC), regions and key markets, driving clarity and removing barriers to enable the operational execution of launch priorities.
- Build and maintain tools to plan and track launch progress (develop and maintain launch KPI metrics), enhancing team collaboration and agility e.g., performance reporting & dashboards
- Coordinate the development of impactful presentations to facilitate strategic planning and decision-making, as well as preparing launch status updates for key governance committees.
- Define and drive the global engagement strategy across HCPs, patients, and caregivers, ensuring alignment with brand positioning and launch objective

Who You Are:

You are a highly collaborative leader who has deep understanding of the launch planning horizon from pivotal program endorsement to market introduction and the role of each function in launch planning and execution. You have proven success in leading cross-functional teams through world-class launches. The ideal candidate is a results-driven leader who excels in strategy, execution and people management. The ideal candidate has a strong background in: Global marketing / brand leadership, Product launches (global or regional), Commercial strategy in pharma/biotech. He or she will bring experience in pre-launch + launch + early in-line phases, ideally exposure to rare diseases. You are forward-thinking and digitally savvy, with demonstrated experience leveraging AI-enabled tools, advanced analytics, and data-driven approaches to accelerate decision-making, enhance launch readiness, and improve commercial execution. You embrace innovative ways of working and champion the adoption of emerging technologies to generate insights, improve productivity, and drive organizational effectiveness across global, cross-functional teams.

- Bachelor’s degree required (in a relevant field such as business, life sciences, or related discipline)
- Advanced degree preferred (e.g., MBA, MSc, PhD, PharmD)

Minimum Experience Requirements:

- Strong commercial experience, preferably in local affiliate environment, regional/global level experience is a plus
- Demonstrated AI fluency and experience applying AI-enabled tools, advanced analytics, and digital innovations to accelerate decision-making, improve operational efficiency, and enhance commercial execution.
- Experience in Rare Disease/Neuromuscular preferred
- Strong track record of delivering results while enhancing collaborative culture and high employee engagement
- Experienced in leading in a matrix organization
- Anticipated travel: up to 15% international
